### Feature `em_eme.eme_periodic` - Periodic block

Help: shared `em_eme.eme_periodic`

- Category monitor; selection none (a selection is ignored with a warning); result kind `table`

Params:
- `start` [m] (default 0) - Range start
  Lower end of the unit cell along propagation_axis (model coordinates).
- `stop` [m] (default 1e-06) - Range stop
  Upper end of the unit cell along propagation_axis; > start.
- `n_periods` (int; default 10; >= 1) - Number of periods. Help: shared `em_eme.eme_periodic.n_periods`
- `n_bloch_modes` (int; default 4; >= 1) - Reported Bloch modes
  Forward Bloch modes listed in the result table.

### Feature `em_eme.eme_bend` - Bend

Circular bend: the sections whose centre lies in [start, stop] along propagation_axis are a bend of radius R about the line coordinate reference, drawn straightened. Exact for the 2D line: each bent section solves the cylindrical operator (r / R^2) d/dr (r du/dr) + k0^2 q (r / R)^2 (r = R + line coordinate - reference; ez q = eps mu, hz with the em_fdfd_hz eps weights), so n_eff = beta / k0 at r = R, propagation e^{-j beta R theta}; straight - bent interfaces are mode-matched like any other (tight-bend radiation goes into the PML modes of cpml line faces). The field plot shows the straightened bend (the in-plane component along the axis is H_theta / E_theta); absorbed_power is the physical density, so its integral over the drawing misses the factor r / R. Ranges must not overlap.

- Category domain_condition; selection none (a selection is ignored with a warning); result none

Params:
- `start` [m] (default 0) - Range start
  Lower end of the bend along propagation_axis (model coordinates).
- `stop` [m] (default 1e-06) - Range stop
  Upper end of the bend along propagation_axis; > start.
- `radius` [m] (default 1e-05) - Bend radius
  Radius R of the reference line (the coordinate along the line axis (the other in-plane axis)); > 0 bends toward lower coordinates (centre of curvature at reference - R), < 0 the other way. Angle = range length / |R|; the centre of curvature must lie outside the section line or cross-section.
- `reference` [m] (default 0) - Reference position
  the coordinate along the line axis (the other in-plane axis) (model coordinates) of the line whose radius is R: the drawn range length is its arc length and the section n_eff its beta / k0.

### Feature `em_eme.pec_domain` - Perfect electric conductor

Perfect electric conductor: cells whose centre lies in the selected domains are inactive in every section line (ez: u = 0; hz: adjacent faces carry no tangential E), staircased.

- Category domain_condition; selection domain entities, at least 1; result none

Params: none

### Feature `em_eme.adjoint_objective` - Optimization objective

Objective term of the EME cascade adjoint: weight times a port power fraction of the excitation, recorded every solve. Output field eps_sensitivity = dJ/d eps per unit area [1/m^2] of J (ez: eps_r; hz: the sum of the eps_xx and eps_yy terms), from the forward and one adjoint cascade field (no extra mode solve; computed when the field is read, on the design-region slices, or every slice without one). Exact for a complete basis (n_modes 0), else converging with n_modes. An eme_periodic drawn cell stands for all n_periods periods (its gradient sums every period). Port modes (first and last cell layer) are held fixed; sigma_e, poles and mu_r are not differentiated. An optimization study maximises J by the design_region densities. Result 'xy' versus vacuum wavelength: series value and weighted (unit 1); extras frequency, wavelength, quantity, mode_number, weight.

- Category monitor; selection none (a selection is ignored with a warning); result kind `xy`

Params:
- `quantity` (default "transmission_mode"; transmission_mode | reflection_mode | transmission | reflection) - Quantity. Help: shared `em_eme.adjoint_objective.quantity`
- `mode_number` (int; default 1; >= 1; visible when quantity in (transmission_mode, reflection_mode)) - Mode number
  Port mode of transmission_mode / reflection_mode (eme_ports input_mode ranking); at most n_modes when n_modes > 0.
- `weight` [1] (default 1) - Weight
  Factor in J: 1 maximises the quantity, -1 minimises it, 0 only records it.

### Feature `em_eme.design_region` - Design region

Density design region on the selected domains: each window cell density rho in [0, 1] is conic-filtered and tanh-projected to rho_bar, which sets eps_r (ez) or eps_xx and eps_yy (hz, isotropic), overwriting the material permittivity; map and chain rule as the em_fdfd_* design_region. The optimization study varies rho to maximise the adjoint_objective sum J; other studies solve initial_density. Keep the region off the first and last cell layer along propagation_axis (port sections: the build refuses it). Every distinct slice of the region is its own section (one mode solve each per evaluation). Regions of one physics must not share cells. Output field design_density = rho_bar (0 outside). Result 'xy' versus iteration (0 = initial): series objective (J, unit 1) and grayness (mean 4 rho_bar (1 - rho_bar), 0 = binary); extras n_cells, eps_min, eps_max, mean_density, final_grayness, note.

- Category domain_condition; selection domain entities, at least 1; result kind `xy`

Params:
- `eps_min` [1] (default 2.085; >= 1) - Permittivity at density 0
  Void or cladding, e.g. silica 2.085 at 1.55 um.
- `eps_max` [1] (default 12.08; >= 1) - Permittivity at density 1. Help: shared `em_eme.design_region.eps_max`
- `initial_density` [1] (default 0.5; [0, 1]) - Initial density
  rho of every design cell before the first iteration (the fixed design outside an optimization study); 0.5 leaves the optimiser free both ways.
- `filter_radius` [m] (default 1e-07; >= 0) - Filter radius. Help: shared `em_eme.design_region.filter_radius`
- `projection_beta` [1] (default 0; >= 0) - Projection sharpness. Help: shared `em_eme.design_region.projection_beta`
- `projection_eta` [1] (default 0.5; [0, 1]) - Projection threshold
  eta of the projection: filtered densities above it move toward 1; 0.5 neutral, lower dilates.

## Physics type `em_eme_3d` - Electromagnetic Waves, eigenmode expansion (3D)

Bidirectional eigenmode expansion (EME) of a 3D device cut into sections along z, for waveguide devices long along z (tapers, phase shifters, couplers) where em_fdtd_3d would be large; z variations are staircases at the z mesh (refine or grade it). Each section is solved once for n_modes full-vector cross-section modes (em_modes discretisation of the xy plane, transverse bc_* faces, PML modes kept as radiation; repeated layers reuse their modes), normalised to the unconjugated <e, h> = sum (E x H).z dA = 1 (degenerate modes recombined orthogonal); interfaces are mode-matched by these overlaps and S-matrices cascaded by Redheffer star products (stable with evanescent modes), converging in n_modes. Outputs of the excitation (eme_ports), from the reconstructed E phasor at cell centres (sum of a_n e^{-j beta_n s} + b_n e^{-j beta_n (L - s)} per section; E_z of backward waves with the opposite sign): ex / ey / ez _re / _im, e_abs (primary), e_intensity, absorbed_power (1/2 omega eps0 (-Im eps) times the 3-point Gauss z mean of |E|^2, on lossy sections) and the permittivity arrays, shown as cut planes (an x or y cut shows the propagation). em_heat_joule reads absorbed_power; heat_em_thermo_optic writes eps_r, eps_xx, eps_yy. Memory: host dominates (one cross-section factorisation at a time, cached mode sets, partial cascades); GPU 28 B per cell of fields and q_abs plus the material arrays. Eigen factorization 'cudss' factorises each cross-section on the GPU (general LU: the operator is not complex symmetric), 'mumps' or 'pardiso' a MUMPS / PARDISO host LU under the SuperLU size limit. Studies: stationary and frequency_domain (each wavelength starts every section's shift-invert from its previous modes, when cached); no design_region / optimization. Cannot share the model with another EM type.

- Default instance name `eme`; studies stationary, frequency_domain (default {"type": "stationary"})
- Backends gpu, cpu; mesh kinds tensor; refinement indicator fields e_abs; dispersion poles used
- Features: eme_ports, eme_section_table, eme_length_sweep, eme_periodic, eme_bend, pec_domain, adjoint_objective

### Settings (PhysicsSpec.settings)

- `wavelength` [m] (default 1.55e-06; > 0) - Wavelength
  Vacuum wavelength of a stationary solve; a frequency_domain study solves its own wavelengths instead. Materials enter at omega (sigma_e and poles complex). A sweep with reuse_build follows it without rebuilding (not on an auto mesh sized by it). Typical 1.31e-6 or 1.55e-6 m.
- `n_modes` (int; default 20; >= 1) - Modes per section
  Cross-section modes per section (shift-invert near (k0 n_eff_guess)^2, descending Re(beta^2), PML modes kept and listed last). A truncated basis leaves a projection error, reported as the section table reciprocity_defect (run-log warning above 1e-3): raise n_modes until the port results converge. Per section: one sparse factorisation of 2 nx ny unknowns and an eigen-solve for n_modes + 6 eigenvalues (n_eff_guess unset, no bend, real eps / mu), else 2 n_modes + 10 (with cpml faces also when the n-th mode lies near the edge of the converged range). 10-40 typical.
- `n_eff_guess` [1] (> 0; nullable) - Effective index guess
  Shift-invert target (k0 n_eff_guess)^2 of every section. Empty: the largest Re sqrt(eps mu) of each cross-section (most strongly guided modes first).
- `section_tolerance` [1] (default 0; >= 0) - Section tolerance
  z layers whose material rows (eps_xx, eps_yy, eps_r, sigma_e, mu_r, sigma_m, pole regions) differ from the section's first layer by at most this fraction of each array's max |value| over the window join it (solved on that layer); 0 = identical layers only. > 0 merges smoothly varying regions into a material staircase: with a heat coupling every heated layer differs, so set e.g. 1e-5.
- `bc_x_lo`, `bc_x_hi`, `bc_y_lo`, `bc_y_hi` (default "cpml"; cpml | pec | pmc | periodic | symmetric | antisymmetric) - Left edge / Right edge / Bottom edge / Top edge
  Transverse faces of every cross-section (the xy plane of each z layer), as in em_modes. The z faces are the ports: the end z cell layers continue to infinity (no z padding). cpml: pml_cells absorbing cells outside the face. The mode solves keep the PML modes as radiation (unlike em_modes), so radiating structures converge more slowly in n_modes. periodic: on both faces of the axis; period = the meshed window (uniform mesh: rounded up to whole cells); k = 0 (normal incidence) unless the type has bloch_kx / bloch_ky (em_fdfd_nonlinear: per harmonic_channel). pec, pmc and mirrors make the outermost cell a ghost outside the wall plane, as em_modes does.
- `pml_cells` [cells] (int; default 15; >= 1; visible when any of bc_x_lo, bc_x_hi, bc_y_lo, bc_y_hi in (cpml)) - Absorbing layer thickness. Help: shared `em_eme.pml_cells`
- `pml_order` (int; default 3; >= 1; visible when any of bc_x_lo, bc_x_hi, bc_y_lo, bc_y_hi in (cpml)) - Absorbing layer grading
  Polynomial order m of the CPML sigma / kappa grading; 3-4 typical.
- `pml_sigma_factor` [1] (default 1; > 0; visible when any of bc_x_lo, bc_x_hi, bc_y_lo, bc_y_hi in (cpml)) - Absorbing layer strength. Help: shared `em_eme.pml_sigma_factor`
- `pml_kappa_max` [1] (default 15; >= 1; visible when any of bc_x_lo, bc_x_hi, bc_y_lo, bc_y_hi in (cpml)) - Absorbing layer stretch
  Peak real CPML stretch (1 = none); larger damps evanescent and grazing waves; 5-15 typical.
- `pml_alpha_max` [S/m] (default 0; >= 0; visible when any of bc_x_lo, bc_x_hi, bc_y_lo, bc_y_hi in (cpml)) - Absorbing layer low-frequency damping. Help: shared `em_eme.pml_alpha_max`

### Material properties (MaterialSpec.properties)

- `eps_r` [1] (default 1; >= 1; writes eps_r, eps_xx, eps_yy) - Relative permittivity
  Isotropic: sets eps_zz (the E_z array eps_r) and eps_xx, eps_yy unless the material sets those; may also use z. The mode solves use eps - j sigma_e / (omega eps0) + every Drude / Lorentz pole chi(omega). Dispersive material: the background eps_inf.
- `eps_zz` [1] (default 1; >= 1; writes eps_r) - Relative permittivity, z (along the guide)
  The only component E_z (along propagation) sees; overrides eps_r for E_z.
- `eps_xx` [1] (default 1; >= 1) - Relative permittivity, x. Help: shared `em_eme.eps_xx`
- `eps_yy` [1] (default 1; >= 1) - Relative permittivity, y. Help: shared `em_eme.eps_yy`
- `sigma_e` [S/m] (default 0; >= 0) - Electric conductivity
  Ohmic loss on every E component. The mode solves use eps - j sigma_e / (omega eps0) + every Drude / Lorentz pole chi(omega).
- `mu_r` [1] (default 1; >= 1) - Relative permeability
  Real relative permeability.
- `sigma_m` [Ohm/m] (default 0; >= 0) - Magnetic conductivity
  Magnetic loss: mu_r gains -j sigma_m / (omega mu0) (artificial absorbers only).

### Fields

Output fields (primary e_abs; [state] = also a state field):
- `e_abs` - |E| (V/m)
- `e_intensity` - |E|^2 (V^2/m^2)
- `ex_re` - Re E_x (phasor, centre) (V/m)
- `ex_im` - Im E_x (phasor, centre) (V/m)
- `ey_re` - Re E_y (phasor, centre) (V/m)
- `ey_im` - Im E_y (phasor, centre) (V/m)
- `ez_re` - Re E_z (phasor, centre) (V/m)
- `ez_im` - Im E_z (phasor, centre) (V/m)
- `absorbed_power` - Absorbed power density (W/m^3)
- `eps_r` - Relative permittivity (eps_zz) (1) [state]
- `eps_xx` - Relative permittivity (eps_xx) (1) [state]
- `eps_yy` - Relative permittivity (eps_yy) (1) [state]
- `eps_sensitivity` - Objective sensitivity dJ/d eps (isotropic) (1/m^3)

Scalar outputs: Power fractions (unit 1) of the excitation (eme_ports, else mode 1 from lo), last solve: transmission_<k> into port mode k of the output face (k = 1 .. n_port_modes, modes found only), transmission and reflection summed over every mode of the output / input face (|S|^2 p_out / p_in; lossless: transmission + reflection = 1, kept PML modes included). NaN plus a run-log warning when missing (evanescent input mode, too few modes). Example derived value {"name": "T1", "expression": "eme_transmission_1"}.

### Source slots

- `eps_r_update` (1): Relative permittivity eps_r: each transfer replaces the whole array (PML ring included); index couplings (heat_em_thermo_optic) add dn: eps = (n0 + sum dn)^2.
- `eps_xx_update` (1): Relative permittivity eps_xx: each transfer replaces the whole array (PML ring included); index couplings (heat_em_thermo_optic) add dn: eps = (n0 + sum dn)^2.
- `eps_yy_update` (1): Relative permittivity eps_yy: each transfer replaces the whole array (PML ring included); index couplings (heat_em_thermo_optic) add dn: eps = (n0 + sum dn)^2.

### Feature `em_eme_3d.eme_ports` - Ports

Ports (the z_lo / z_hi window planes) and excitation. Result 'table', one row per reported port mode of each face (input face first = reflection, then output face = transmission): output_face, mode_number, n_eff, n_eff_imag (Im < 0 lossy), s_abs2 = |S|^2 of the bilinear-normalised amplitudes, phase_deg = arg S (reference planes = the window z faces; each mode phased with its dominant transverse E real > 0 at its peak), power_fraction = |S|^2 p_out / p_in (p = power per unit amplitude). Port mode k = the k-th mode of the first / last section (input_mode ranking). Extras: wavelength, input_face, input_mode, input_power, transmission and reflection (summed over every mode of the face), s_matrix_real / s_matrix_imag over the reported modes (lo first), s_matrix_modes. Without this feature: mode 1 at 1 W from z_lo. At most one per physics.

- Category source; selection none (a selection is ignored with a warning); result kind `table`

Params:
- `input_face` (default "lo"; lo | hi) - Input face
  Port face of the incident mode: lo = z_lo (incident toward +z), hi = z_hi.
- `input_mode` (int; default 1; >= 1) - Input mode. Help: shared `em_eme.eme_ports.input_mode`
- `input_power` [W] (default 1; > 0) - Input power
  Incident mode power; scales only the reconstructed fields, not the S-matrix or power fractions.
- `n_port_modes` (int; default 4; >= 1) - Reported port modes
  Port modes per face in the result table and S-matrix extras; also the number of transmission_<k> scalar outputs.

### Feature `em_eme_3d.eme_section_table` - Section table

Sections of the last solve. Result 'table', one row per section from lo to hi: section (1-based), start and length [m] along z, n_slices (z cell layers), n_modes (modes found), n_eff_1 / n_eff_2 (Re n_eff of its first two modes), power_defect and reciprocity_defect of the interface to the next section (NaN for the last): power = max over propagating incident modes of |1 - power reflected and transmitted into propagating modes| (lossless lines without cpml only), reciprocity = max |S12 - S21^T| / max |S21| (0 for a complete basis; the n_modes convergence measure). Extra wavelength.

- Category monitor; selection none (a selection is ignored with a warning); result kind `table`

Params: none

### Feature `em_eme_3d.eme_length_sweep` - Length sweep

Help: shared `em_eme.eme_length_sweep`

- Category monitor; selection none (a selection is ignored with a warning); result kind `xy`

Params:
- `start` [m] (default 0) - Range start
  Lower end of the stretched range along z (model coordinates).
- `stop` [m] (default 1e-06) - Range stop
  Upper end of the stretched range along z; > start.
- `stretch_factors` [1] (float_list; default [0.5, 1, 1.5, 2]; > 0) - Stretch factors
  One re-cascade per factor (modes and interfaces reused), e.g. 0.5 .. 4 for a taper length scan.

### Feature `em_eme_3d.eme_periodic` - Periodic block

Help: shared `em_eme.eme_periodic`

- Category monitor; selection none (a selection is ignored with a warning); result kind `table`

Params:
- `start` [m] (default 0) - Range start
  Lower end of the unit cell along z (model coordinates).
- `stop` [m] (default 1e-06) - Range stop
  Upper end of the unit cell along z; > start.
- `n_periods` (int; default 10; >= 1) - Number of periods. Help: shared `em_eme.eme_periodic.n_periods`
- `n_bloch_modes` (int; default 4; >= 1) - Reported Bloch modes
  Forward Bloch modes listed in the result table.

### Feature `em_eme_3d.eme_bend` - Bend

Circular bend in the xz plane: the sections whose centre lies in [start, stop] along z are a bend of radius R about x = reference, drawn straightened. Each bent section uses the cross_section_modes bend map (model 'exact': transformation-optics image of the curved guide, eps and mu scaled by the radial factor), so n_eff = beta / k0 at the reference radius; straight - bent interfaces are mode-matched like any other (bend radiation goes into the PML modes of cpml x faces: raise n_modes). The field plot shows the straightened bend. Ranges must not overlap.

- Category domain_condition; selection none (a selection is ignored with a warning); result none

Params:
- `start` [m] (default 0) - Range start
  Lower end of the bend along z (model coordinates).
- `stop` [m] (default 1e-06) - Range stop
  Upper end of the bend along z; > start.
- `radius` [m] (default 1e-05) - Bend radius
  Radius R of the reference line (the x coordinate (the bend lies in the xz plane, about an axis along y)); > 0 bends toward lower coordinates (centre of curvature at reference - R), < 0 the other way. Angle = range length / |R|; the centre of curvature must lie outside the section line or cross-section.
- `reference` [m] (default 0) - Reference position
  the x coordinate (the bend lies in the xz plane, about an axis along y) (model coordinates) of the line whose radius is R: the drawn range length is its arc length and the section n_eff its beta / k0.

### Feature `em_eme_3d.pec_domain` - Perfect electric conductor

Perfect electric conductor cells of every cross-section (em_modes rule: E_z = 0 at the selected cell centres, E_x / E_y = 0 on faces between two of them, the normal E on the surface free), staircased; lossless in absorbed_power. Select objects: 'all' is refused.

- Category domain_condition; selection domain entities, at least 1; result none

Params: none

### Feature `em_eme_3d.adjoint_objective` - Optimization objective

Objective term of the EME cascade adjoint: weight times a port power fraction of the excitation, recorded every solve. Output field eps_sensitivity = dJ/d eps per unit volume [1/m^3] of J for an isotropic change (sum of the eps_xx, eps_yy and eps_r terms; per component: EMEPhysics3D.eps_sensitivity().cell_gradients), from the forward and one adjoint cascade field (no extra mode solve; every window z layer, computed when the field is read). Converging with n_modes (exact only for complete bases). An eme_periodic drawn cell stands for all n_periods periods (its gradient sums every period). Port modes (first and last z cell layer) are held fixed; sigma_e, poles and mu_r are not differentiated. No design_region / optimization study in 3D: the field shows where a small material change raises or lowers J. Result 'xy' versus vacuum wavelength: series value and weighted (unit 1); extras frequency, wavelength, quantity, mode_number, weight.

- Category monitor; selection none (a selection is ignored with a warning); result kind `xy`

Params:
- `quantity` (default "transmission_mode"; transmission_mode | reflection_mode | transmission | reflection) - Quantity. Help: shared `em_eme.adjoint_objective.quantity`
- `mode_number` (int; default 1; >= 1; visible when quantity in (transmission_mode, reflection_mode)) - Mode number
  Port mode of transmission_mode / reflection_mode (eme_ports input_mode ranking); at most n_modes when n_modes > 0.
- `weight` [1] (default 1) - Weight
  Factor in J: 1 maximises the quantity, -1 minimises it, 0 only records it.

## Physics type `em_fdfd_3d` - Electromagnetic Waves, frequency domain (3D)

3D finite-difference frequency-domain eigensolver on the em_fdtd_3d Yee grid (E on cell faces, H on edges). The eigenfrequency study solves curl (mu^-1 curl E) = (omega / C0)^2 eps E for the resonances nearest the target wavelength: shift-invert of the operator assembled there (materials and PML frozen) by the eigen factorization (host SuperLU, cudss / cudss_mixed on the GPU, or mumps / mumps_mixed / pardiso / pardiso_mixed on the host, the last two the LDL^T of D A), ARPACK on the squared Cayley map (static gradient solutions sent to 0), on the live E faces only (Bloch phases in the wrap entries). Materials as em_fdtd_3d, as eps(omega_t) = eps - j sigma_e / (omega_t eps0) + chi(omega_t) (face means of the two cells; solver_defaults.subpixel_smoothing: the em_fdtd_3d anisotropic average on interface faces, so curved surfaces converge smoothly) and mu_r - j sigma_m / (omega_t mu0) of the lower cell per H edge. Outputs of the selected resonance (scaled to 1 V/m real at its largest E sample): ex / ey / ez / hx / hy / hz _re / _im / _abs (H = j curl E / (omega mu0 mu) at the complex omega), e_abs (primary), e_intensity, h_abs (cell centres), w_e = eps0 / 4 sum eps_c |E_c|^2 and eps_r, shown as cut planes. Memory: host dominates, the 3D factor grows ~ n^(4/3), n = E unknowns (~3 per cell; a solver size rule warns above 1e6 and refuses 4e6); device 48 B per cell of fields plus the material arrays. heat_em_thermo_optic writes eps_r (+ eps_xx / eps_yy) as a background coupling. 'tetrahedra' mesh (finite elements): Nedelec edge elements (discretization), one material value per element, cpml faces as a PML shell of pml_cells x the maximum element size meshed with the window (complex stretch tensor), the same eigen solve (sparse mass), outputs sampled at points (cut planes on a uniform sample lattice, derived values at quadrature points); periodic faces (Bloch k: hi-side unknowns = lo side times the phase, nonsymmetric LU) need the builtin mesher; no subpixel smoothing.

- Default instance name `em`; studies eigenfrequency (default {"type": "eigenfrequency", "settings": {"n_resonances": 6}})
- Backends gpu, cpu; mesh kinds tensor, tetrahedra; refinement indicator fields e_abs; dispersion poles used
- Features: pec_domain, resonance_table

### Settings (PhysicsSpec.settings)

- `bc_x_lo`, `bc_x_hi`, `bc_y_lo`, `bc_y_hi`, `bc_z_lo`, `bc_z_hi` (default "pec"; cpml | pec | pmc | periodic | symmetric | antisymmetric) - Left edge / Right edge / Bottom edge / Top edge / Lower z face / Upper z face
  The em_fdtd_3d faces on the same Yee grid: cpml = complex stretch s = kappa + sigma / (alpha + j omega eps0) of the pml_* settings in pml_cells extra cells, frozen at the target wavelength (resonances near it see the right stretch); pec = tangential E 0 at the centres of the outermost cell layer (it becomes conductor); pmc = tangential H 0 on the outer face of the outermost cell (pec and pmc walls lie half a cell apart); periodic on both faces of an axis, Bloch phase bloch_k<axis>. Mirror planes on the domain edge itself (any face): symmetric = E mirror-even (PMC plane), antisymmetric = E mirror-odd (PEC plane); a ghost cell outside holds the image. Each mirror halves the direct-solve unknowns; the eigenfrequency setting parity_sectors solves every parity of the mirror faces in turn. Unknowns are the live E faces only (faces between two PEC cells, the normal E on a symmetric plane and ghost cells dropped).
- `pml_cells` [cells] (int; default 15; >= 1; visible when any of bc_x_lo, bc_x_hi, bc_y_lo, bc_y_hi, bc_z_lo, bc_z_hi in (cpml)) - Absorbing layer thickness. Help: shared `em_eme.pml_cells`
- `pml_order` (int; default 3; >= 1; visible when any of bc_x_lo, bc_x_hi, bc_y_lo, bc_y_hi, bc_z_lo, bc_z_hi in (cpml)) - Absorbing layer grading
  Polynomial order m of the CPML sigma / kappa grading; 3-4 typical.
- `pml_sigma_factor` [1] (default 1; > 0; visible when any of bc_x_lo, bc_x_hi, bc_y_lo, bc_y_hi, bc_z_lo, bc_z_hi in (cpml)) - Absorbing layer strength. Help: shared `em_eme.pml_sigma_factor`
- `pml_kappa_max` [1] (default 15; >= 1; visible when any of bc_x_lo, bc_x_hi, bc_y_lo, bc_y_hi, bc_z_lo, bc_z_hi in (cpml)) - Absorbing layer stretch
  Peak real CPML stretch (1 = none); larger damps evanescent and grazing waves; 5-15 typical.
- `pml_alpha_max` [S/m] (default 0; >= 0; visible when any of bc_x_lo, bc_x_hi, bc_y_lo, bc_y_hi, bc_z_lo, bc_z_hi in (cpml)) - Absorbing layer low-frequency damping. Help: shared `em_eme.pml_alpha_max`
- `wavelength` [m] (default 1.55e-06; > 0) - Target wavelength
  Vacuum target wavelength lambda_t: the eigenfrequency study returns the resonances nearest it. The operator is assembled at omega_t (sigma_e and poles as eps(omega_t), PML stretch at omega_t), so a resonance is exact for non-dispersive PML-free models, else accurate to first order in |omega / omega_t - 1|: for an accurate Q of an open or dispersive resonator set it near the resonance and re-run. It may coincide with a resonance (shift 1e-4 above lambda_t^-2). Mesh: >= 10 (better 20) cells per lambda_t / n. Typical 0.4e-6 to 2e-6 m.
- `bloch_kx` [rad/m] (default 0; visible when bc_x_lo in (periodic)) - Bloch wave vector x. Help: shared `em_fdfd_3d.bloch_kx`
- `bloch_ky` [rad/m] (default 0; visible when bc_y_lo in (periodic)) - Bloch wave vector y. Help: shared `em_fdfd_3d.bloch_kx`
- `bloch_kz` [rad/m] (default 0; visible when bc_z_lo in (periodic)) - Bloch wave vector z. Help: shared `em_fdfd_3d.bloch_kx`
- `discretization` (default "quadratic"; quadratic | linear) - Discretization
  Nedelec (first kind) degree on a tetrahedra mesh (ignored on tensor): quadratic (degree 2, 20 unknowns per element: 2 per edge and face) or linear (one per edge); straight-sided elements (curved surfaces faceted at the mesh size).

### Material properties (MaterialSpec.properties)

- `eps_r` [1] (default 1; >= 1; writes eps_r, eps_xx, eps_yy) - Relative permittivity. Help: shared `em_fdfd_3d.eps_r`
- `eps_zz` [1] (default 1; >= 1; writes eps_r) - Relative permittivity, z. Help: shared `em_fdfd_3d.eps_zz`
- `eps_xx` [1] (default 1; >= 1) - Relative permittivity, x. Help: shared `em_fdfd_3d.eps_xx`
- `eps_yy` [1] (default 1; >= 1) - Relative permittivity, y. Help: shared `em_fdfd_3d.eps_yy`
- `sigma_e` [S/m] (default 0; >= 0) - Electric conductivity
  Ohmic loss J = sigma_e E (isotropic, face mean like eps_r); model metals with a Drude pole. Counted in absorbed_power / em_heat_joule.
- `mu_r` [1] (default 1; >= 1) - Relative permeability
  Real relative permeability; each H edge takes its lower cell (i, j, k).
- `sigma_m` [Ohm/m] (default 0; >= 0) - Magnetic conductivity. Help: shared `em_fdfd_3d.sigma_m`

### Source slots

- `eps_r_update` (1): Relative permittivity eps_r: each transfer replaces the whole array (PML ring included); index couplings (heat_em_thermo_optic) add dn: eps = (n0 + sum dn)^2.

### Feature `em_fdfd_3d.pec_domain` - Perfect electric conductor

Perfect electric conductor cells, as em_fdtd_3d: every E face between two selected cells is dropped from the unknowns (E = 0; the surface lies at the centres of the outermost conductor cells), a face between a conductor and another cell takes the other cell's permittivity (normal E free). Select objects: 'all' is refused. Staircased (no conformal option).

- Category domain_condition; selection domain entities, at least 1; mesh kinds tensor, tetrahedra; result none

Params: none

### Feature `em_fdfd_3d.resonance_table` - Resonance table

Resonances of the last eigenfrequency solve, nearest the target first. Result 'table', one row per resonance: resonance_number (1-based rank by |omega - omega_target|), wavelength = 2 pi C0 / Re(omega) [m], frequency = Re(omega) / (2 pi) and frequency_imag = Im(omega) / (2 pi) [Hz] (exp(+j omega t): > 0 decays), q_factor = Re(omega) / (2 Im(omega)) (inf when |Im omega| < 1e-12 Re omega: lossless and closed; negative = growing, non-physical, usually a PML artefact), pml_fraction (share of the electric energy sum |Re eps| |E|^2 dV on E faces in PML and padding cells: > 0.5 dropped; above ~1e-2 the PML shapes the resonance: widen the cladding); extras target_wavelength [m], selected_resonance. With parity_sectors each sector has its own table (Results.sector_result). Optional domain selection = a region (e.g. a box around the cavity core): the table then ends with region_energy_fraction (the same energy share on the E faces of the selected cells, each owning its +x / +y / +z faces; a mirror-plane face counts with the ghost cell, so a region on a mirror face reads a little low; on tetrahedra the dofs of the selected elements), and resonances below min_region_fraction are dropped like PML modes (rows, snapshots and resonance numbers skip them). One region per physics; 'all' is refused.

- Category monitor; selection domain entities, at least 0; mesh kinds tensor, tetrahedra; result kind `table`

Params:
- `min_region_fraction` [1] (default 0; [0, 1]) - Minimum region fraction. Help: shared `em_fdfd_3d.resonance_table.min_region_fraction`

## Physics type `em_fdfd_bor` - Electromagnetic Waves, frequency domain (axisymmetric, azimuthal order m)

Body-of-revolution (BOR) FDFD: the drawing is the (r, z) half plane of a structure rotationally symmetric about the x_lo window edge (x = r >= 0, y = z), fields of one azimuthal order m (or an order list). Fields ~ exp(j (omega t - m phi)): shown phasors are the travelling wave at phi = 0; the standing wave (+m and -m, degenerate) has E_r, E_z ~ cos(m phi), E_phi ~ sin(m phi) with the same profiles. All six components (coupled for m != 0) on the 3D cylindrical Yee cell projected onto the half plane (finite integration, exact ring areas / volumes): E_phi, H_r at cell centres (H_r on the +z edge), E_r, H_z on +r edges, E_z on +z edges, H_phi at the +r+z corner; on the axis only the m = 0 H_z unknown (|m| = 1: E_r, H_phi recovered from cell 0). True 3D results (disks, rings, pillars, staircased spheres, lenses, vertical cavities, on-axis dipoles) at 2D cost. Host matrix, 3 unknowns per cell incl. PML; needs scipy; validation warns near and refuses beyond the host factor size limit. Role 'linear': sparse_direct = host SuperLU, one factor per wavelength and material state, reused as GMRES preconditioner after a material change (thermo-optic iteration); back_end cudss / cudss_mixed (GPU backend, nvmath-python): cuDSS LDL^T on the GPU, no size limit, its plan reused across wavelengths, material states and orders; mumps / mumps_mixed / pardiso / pardiso_mixed (python-mumps / pydiso, either backend): MUMPS / PARDISO LDL^T on the host under the size limit; cusolver_qr is refused. Role 'eigen' arpack_shift_invert (tolerance, subspace_size; complex symmetric operator): factorization cudss = GPU LDL^T without size limit, mumps / mumps_mixed / pardiso / pardiso_mixed host LDL^T, _mixed = complex64 solves + float64 Rayleigh quotients. Role 'shifted': Automatic changes nothing; line_block factors every driven system and shift-invert operator on its backend (z rows or r columns; |m| >= 2 orders of a list in one batch; frequency_domain of one order: up to 8 wavelengths per batch within 60 % of free memory; mixed or double, refined against complex128); a solve it rejects goes to host SuperLU with a run-log warning. Studies: stationary (wavelength setting; with heat via heat_em_thermo_optic / em_heat_joule, heat axisymmetric too), frequency_domain (one solve per wavelength), eigenfrequency (shift-invert resonances nearest the wavelength setting: complex omega, Q from material loss and PML radiation), optomechanics (as the optical physics an optomechanical_coupling of an axisymmetric solid_mechanics names: the eigen-solve with n_optical_resonances, then the g0 table; triangles only; an em_fdfd_bor no coupling names solves as stationary background). Outputs at cell centres: components are Re of the phi = 0 phasors; absorbed_power = state q_abs = 1/2 omega eps0 sum_c (-Im eps_c) |E_c|^2 (mean over the component points; em_heat_joule hands it to heat); eps_r = eps_phiphi, eps_xx = eps_rr, eps_yy = axial eps_zz. Resonances are scaled to 1 real at the largest component (V/m). Field derived values and powers weight by the ring volume 2 pi r dr dz (travelling wave; a standing cos(m phi) wave has half). Cannot share a model with in-plane EM types (validation error). heat_em_thermo_optic writes all three permittivity arrays. Triangles mesh: eigenfrequency / optomechanics on mixed axisymmetric elements (see discretization); driven studies, sources and monitors need a tensor mesh. Instance usually 'em'.

- Default instance name `em`; studies eigenfrequency, stationary, frequency_domain, optomechanics (default {"type": "eigenfrequency"})
- Backends gpu, cpu; mesh kinds tensor, triangles; refinement indicator fields e_intensity; dispersion poles used
- Features: point_source, field_probe, pec_domain, mode_source, flux_monitor, mode_monitor, far_field, resonance_table

### Settings (PhysicsSpec.settings)

- `geometry` (default "axisymmetric"; choice axisymmetric only) - Geometry. Help: shared `em_fdfd_bor.geometry`
- `bc_x_lo` (default "axis"; choice axis only) - Left edge. Help: shared `em_fdfd_bor.bc_x_lo`
- `bc_x_hi`, `bc_y_lo`, `bc_y_hi` (default "cpml"; cpml | pec | pmc) - Right edge / Bottom edge / Top edge. Help: shared `em_fdfd_bor.bc_x_lo`
- `pml_cells` [cells] (int; default 15; >= 1; visible when any of bc_x_hi, bc_y_lo, bc_y_hi in (cpml)) - Absorbing layer thickness. Help: shared `em_eme.pml_cells`
- `pml_order` (int; default 3; >= 1; visible when any of bc_x_hi, bc_y_lo, bc_y_hi in (cpml)) - Absorbing layer grading
  Polynomial order m of the CPML sigma / kappa grading; 3-4 typical.
- `pml_sigma_factor` [1] (default 1; > 0; visible when any of bc_x_hi, bc_y_lo, bc_y_hi in (cpml)) - Absorbing layer strength. Help: shared `em_eme.pml_sigma_factor`
- `pml_kappa_max` [1] (default 15; >= 1; visible when any of bc_x_hi, bc_y_lo, bc_y_hi in (cpml)) - Absorbing layer stretch
  Peak real CPML stretch (1 = none); larger damps evanescent and grazing waves; 5-15 typical.
- `pml_alpha_max` [S/m] (default 0; >= 0; visible when any of bc_x_hi, bc_y_lo, bc_y_hi in (cpml)) - Absorbing layer low-frequency damping. Help: shared `em_eme.pml_alpha_max`
- `wavelength` [m] (default 1.55e-06; > 0) - Wavelength
  Vacuum wavelength of a stationary solve; eigenfrequency: the target (resonances nearest it); frequency_domain ignores it (validation info when not the default). Mesh: >= 10 (better 20) cells per lambda0 / |n| and >= 2 per skin depth (validation checks both). Typical 0.4e-6 to 2e-6 m.
- `azimuthal_order` (int; default 0; [0, 10000]) - Azimuthal order
  m, fields ~ exp(-j m phi); +m and -m are degenerate (same resonances and |fields|). m = 0: rotationally symmetric, TE-like E_phi, H_r, H_z and TM-like E_r, E_z, H_phi decouple (on-axis dipoles, radial modes); m = 1: on-axis focused / plane waves, fundamental fibre and vertical-cavity modes (E_r, E_phi, H_phi non-zero on the axis); larger m: whispering-gallery modes, m ~ 2 pi R n_eff / lambda. Several orders (free spectral range, the m of a resonance, an off-axis point source): azimuthal_orders.
- `azimuthal_orders` [1] (float_list; [0, 10000]; nullable) - Azimuthal order list
  Distinct integer orders m >= 0 in one run (one material read, one assembly A(m) = K0 + m K1 + m^2 K2 - k0^2 M); a non-empty list replaces azimuthal_order, null or [] = azimuthal_order alone. Eigenfrequency: n_resonances per order near the wavelength setting, numbered order by order in list order; snapshot labels 'resonance k: m = <m>, lambda = ...'; resonance_table column azimuthal_order (lambda versus m: the free spectral range). Stationary / frequency_domain: the driven order sum, every point_source a 3D point current at phi = 0 (see point_source) expanded in exp(-j m phi), each m > 0 solved with -m (one factor: A(-m) is the phi mirror) and summed. Fields and field_probe show the phi = 0 half plane of the 3D field (their ring-weighted integrals are not 3D integrals); absorbed_power (q_abs, handed to heat) is its phi average; flux_monitor and far_field add the orders exactly and report each. List every order 0..M: far field and powers converge once M exceeds k rho_s by a few (rho_s = source radius, k = n omega / c), near fields need more. mode_source / mode_monitor need a single order (validation error). Cost: one factorisation per order and wavelength; a line_block shifted solver factorises the orders of one axis class (|m| >= 1) in one batch.
- `discretization` (default "quadratic"; quadratic | linear) - Discretization
  Element order on a triangles mesh (tensor meshes use the Yee cell). Resonance studies only: mixed axisymmetric elements (Nedelec for E_r, E_z, Lagrange for r E_phi, same degree: no spurious modes); quadratic maps curved edges isoparametrically, so disks, toroids and spheres follow the outline. linear (Whitney / P1): cheaper, error ~h^2 instead of ~h^4 in k^2, the axis element layer stiff for m = 0 / |m| = 1. ~7 (quadratic) or 2 (linear) unknowns per element; shift-invert by the eigen solver (host SuperLU; factorization cudss: GPU LDL^T; mumps / mumps_mixed / pardiso / pardiso_mixed: host MUMPS / PARDISO LDL^T, _mixed = complex64 + float64 Rayleigh quotients). Materials one value per element; a cpml face gets mesh pml_layers element layers (pml_* stretch) and a pec outer side; pec_domain removes its elements (tangential E = 0 on their outline). On triangles stationary / frequency_domain and every source / monitor feature are validation errors; resonance_table and pec_domain work.

### Material properties (MaterialSpec.properties)

- `eps_r` [1] (default 1; >= 1; writes eps_r, eps_xx, eps_yy) - Relative permittivity
  Isotropic, all three components; n^2 of a lossless dielectric (silicon ~12.1, silica ~2.1 at 1.55 um); a component property wins over it. Diagonal cylindrical components (rotationally invariant): eps_xx = eps_rr (E_r), eps_yy = axial eps_zz (E_z; drawing y = z), eps_zz = eps_phiphi (E_phi; writes the eps_r array). z-cut uniaxial crystal (optic axis on the rotation axis): eps_r = n_o^2, eps_yy = n_e^2; radially anisotropic shell: eps_xx. E_phi sees the cell value, E_r / E_z (cell edges) the ring-volume / length weighted mean of their two cells (no subpixel smoothing). Solved with the complex value at the solve wavelength: this - j sigma_e / (omega eps0) + chi(omega) of every Drude / Lorentz pole (exp(+j omega t): loss Im < 0).
- `eps_zz` [1] (default 1; >= 1; writes eps_r) - Relative permittivity, phi (azimuthal)
  eps_phiphi, the only component E_phi sees (stored in the eps_r array, overriding eps_r for E_phi only); the axial component is eps_yy.
- `eps_xx` [1] (default 1; >= 1) - Relative permittivity, r (radial)
  eps_rr, the only component E_r sees.
- `eps_yy` [1] (default 1; >= 1) - Relative permittivity, z (axial, drawing y)
  Axial eps_zz (drawing y), the only component E_z sees.
- `sigma_e` [S/m] (default 0; >= 0) - Electric conductivity
  Every component gains -j sigma_e / (omega eps0); weak absorber of index n, extinction kappa: sigma_e = 2 n kappa omega eps0. Metals: a Drude pole instead.
- `mu_r` [1] (default 1; >= 1) - Relative permeability
  Real, 1 for optical materials; H_r, H_phi, H_z take the mean of the cells around their points. Solved as mu_r - j sigma_m / (omega mu0).
- `sigma_m` [Ohm/m] (default 0; >= 0) - Magnetic conductivity
  mu_r gains -j sigma_m / (omega mu0) (artificial absorbers only).

### Fields

Output fields (primary e_intensity; [state] = also a state field):
- `er` - Re E_r (V/m)
- `ephi` - Re E_phi (V/m)
- `ez` - Re E_z (V/m)
- `hr` - Re H_r (A/m)
- `hphi` - Re H_phi (A/m)
- `hz` - Re H_z (A/m)
- `er_abs` - |E_r| (V/m)
- `ephi_abs` - |E_phi| (V/m)
- `ez_abs` - |E_z| (V/m)
- `hr_abs` - |H_r| (A/m)
- `hphi_abs` - |H_phi| (A/m)
- `hz_abs` - |H_z| (A/m)
- `e_abs` - |E| (V/m)
- `e_intensity` - |E|^2 (V^2/m^2) [state]
- `h_abs` - |H| (A/m)
- `absorbed_power` - Absorbed power density (W/m^3)
- `sigma_e` - Electric conductivity (S/m) [state]
- `eps_r` - Relative permittivity phi phi (1) [state]
- `eps_xx` - Relative permittivity rr (1) [state]
- `eps_yy` - Relative permittivity zz (axial) (1) [state]
State fields that are no output field:
- `q_abs` - Absorbed power density (W/m^3)

### Source slots

- `eps_r_update` (1): Relative permittivity eps_r: each transfer replaces the whole array (PML ring included); index couplings (heat_em_thermo_optic) add dn: eps = (n0 + sum dn)^2.
- `eps_xx_update` (1): Relative permittivity eps_xx: each transfer replaces the whole array (PML ring included); index couplings (heat_em_thermo_optic) add dn: eps = (n0 + sum dn)^2.
- `eps_yy_update` (1): Relative permittivity eps_yy: each transfer replaces the whole array (PML ring included); index couplings (heat_em_thermo_optic) add dn: eps = (n0 + sum dn)^2.

### Feature `em_fdfd_bor.point_source` - Point source

Current element in the cell containing the point (x = r, y = z): a ring in 3D with the exp(-j m phi) dependence; see component and current.

- Category source; selection point entities, object kinds point, exactly 1; result none

Params:
- `component` (default "z"; r | phi | z) - Direction
  'phi': J_phi = I / (w h) in the cell (m = 0: a current loop of radius r carrying I, a magnetic dipole on the axis); 'z' / 'r': current I through the cell's ring cross-section (2 pi r w axial, 2 pi r h radial), split onto its two edge points (axis cell: 'z' an on-axis electric dipole of moment I h, h = cell height; 'r' at |m| = 1 the rotating transverse dipole of moment I w / 2). For m != 0, I is the amplitude of the exp(-j m phi) distribution. In a driven order sum (azimuthal_orders) instead a 3D point current at phi = 0 ('phi' points out of the drawing) of moment I d (d = cell height for z, width for r / phi): each order carries ring current I (r, z) or I d / (2 pi r) (phi); in free space it radiates eta0 k^2 (I d)^2 / (12 pi) wherever it sits.
- `current` [A] (default 0.001) - Current
  Current I of the element (see component); fields are linear in it. Sign: the current is minus the textbook impressed current, so phases (and powers from probe fields) are pi off textbook formulas; moduli and fluxes agree.
- `phase` [deg] (default 0) - Phase
  Phasor phase of the current (0 = cos carrier, as the em_fdfd_* sources).

### Feature `em_fdfd_bor.field_probe` - Field probe

Phasor of one component in the containing cell per driven solve (order sum: the summed field at phi = 0). Result 'xy' versus wavelength: abs (component unit), phase (rad); extras frequency, wavelength, component, unit.

- Category probe; selection point entities, object kinds point, exactly 1; result kind `xy`

Params:
- `component` (default "ez"; er | ephi | ez | hr | hphi | hz) - Field component
  Complex phasor at the centre of the containing cell (edge points averaged there), per driven solve.

### Feature `em_fdfd_bor.pec_domain` - Perfect electric conductor

Rings in 3D: E_phi = 0 in cells whose centre lies in the domains, E_r / E_z = 0 on edges between two such cells (staircased). Triangles: its elements leave the unknowns, tangential E = 0 on their outline (curved outlines exact with quadratic).

- Category domain_condition; selection domain entities, at least 1; mesh kinds tensor, triangles; result none

Params: none

### Feature `em_fdfd_bor.mode_source` - Mode source

Launches one guided mode of a guide along the axis (fibre, pillar, metal pipe, coax) from a horizontal line in one direction: a one-sided TFSF interface between the line row and the row upstream, exact on a straight guide. Port line: horizontal (z = const; vertical lines are refused), from the axis (x0 = 0) or annular (x0 > 0: a pec end on that cell edge, e.g. from a coaxial inner conductor); it ends on the last window cell (continuing through the r_hi cpml, or on its pec / pmc wall) or inside the domain (again a pec end: extend it well into the cladding; the run log warns when the mode keeps 1% of its peak there; exact when the cells beyond are pec). Modes ~ exp(-j beta z) are full-vector solutions of the BOR operator on the line cells, re-solved at every wavelength and material change: exact for a guide invariant along z over a cell on each side of the line (run log warns otherwise). Ranked by descending Re n_eff (mode 1 highest), radiation modes with > half their energy in the PML dropped; each carries 1 W (the flux_monitor flux) in the travelling exp(-j m phi) wave. Result 'table' of the latest port solve (frequency_domain: the last wavelength), one row per mode found (up to max(mode_number + 2, 4)): mode_number, n_eff, n_eff_imag (< 0 = loss), loss_db_per_cm, n_group (pencil derivative, no material dispersion), edge_field (|field| at the line end / peak), selected; extras wavelength [m], power [W], direction, mode_number, phase [deg].

- Category source; selection line entities, object kinds line, exactly 1; result kind `table`

Params:
- `power` [W] (default 1; >= 0) - Power. Help: shared `em_fdfd_bor.mode_source.power`
- `mode_number` (int; default 1; [1, 50]) - Mode number
  1 = highest Re n_eff at this order (HE11 of a fibre at m = 1, TE11 of a metal pipe); the result table lists the modes found.
- `direction` (default "positive"; positive | negative) - Direction
  'positive': toward +z (total field on the line row and above, only what comes back below); 'negative': toward -z (total field on the row and below).
- `phase` [deg] (default 0) - Phase
  Mode amplitude sqrt(P) e^{j phase} on the line row (each mode phased with its largest field sample real and positive).

### Feature `em_fdfd_bor.flux_monitor` - Flux monitor

Time-averaged power [W] through an axis-aligned line per driven solve, ring-weighted for the travelling exp(-j m phi) wave (a cos(m phi) standing wave carries half for m != 0). Horizontal line (z = const): flux along +z through the swept annulus, pi sum [A Re(E_r H_phi*) - r w Re(E_phi H_r*)]; vertical (r = const): along +r through the cylinder, pi sum [r h Re(E_phi H_z*) - r L Re(E_z H_phi*)]. E of the line cells, H on their hi face (Yee points: exactly conserved through lossless cells, the port-mode normalisation); span ends by their share. A line from the axis across the field gives the full power, a closed box the radiated power. Result 'flux_spectrum' [W], one entry per wavelength, sorted. Driven order sum: power of the 3D field (orders add exactly), extras power_orders (n_wavelengths x n_orders, each m with -m) and azimuthal_orders. The line covers cells [cell(start), cell(end) + 1) (an end exactly on a cell edge adds a cell); its hi face must be inside the grid.

- Category monitor; selection line entities, object kinds line, exactly 1; result kind `flux_spectrum`

Params: none

### Feature `em_fdfd_bor.mode_monitor` - Mode monitor

Splits the field on a horizontal line into the upward (positive) and downward (negative) amplitudes of one guided mode per wavelength. Port line: horizontal (z = const; vertical lines are refused), from the axis (x0 = 0) or annular (x0 > 0: a pec end on that cell edge, e.g. from a coaxial inner conductor); it ends on the last window cell (continuing through the r_hi cpml, or on its pec / pmc wall) or inside the domain (again a pec end: extend it well into the cladding; the run log warns when the mode keeps 1% of its peak there; exact when the cells beyond are pec). Modes ~ exp(-j beta z) are full-vector solutions of the BOR operator on the line cells, re-solved at every wavelength and material change: exact for a guide invariant along z over a cell on each side of the line (run log warns otherwise). Ranked by descending Re n_eff (mode 1 highest), radiation modes with > half their energy in the PML dropped; each carries 1 W (the flux_monitor flux) in the travelling exp(-j m phi) wave. Result 'xy' versus vacuum wavelength: power_positive / power_negative = |a|^2 [W] toward +z / -z (discrete reciprocity of the line row and the row above: other modes drop out); with exactly one enabled mode_source also fraction_positive / fraction_negative = |a / (sqrt(P) e^{j phase})|^2 (transmission / reflection into this mode) and phase_positive / phase_negative (rad, not de-embedded); extras frequency, wavelength, n_eff, n_eff_imag, mode_number, normalized. Keep the line and the row above off the line rows of a mode_source.

- Category monitor; selection line entities, object kinds line, exactly 1; result kind `xy`

Params:
- `mode_number` (int; default 1; [1, 50]) - Mode number
  Guided mode measured (ranked as mode_source); later wavelengths follow it by overlap.

### Feature `em_fdfd_bor.far_field` - Far-field pattern

Near-to-far-field transform of the driven solution on the closed surface of a rectangle in the (r, z) drawing (z faces, outer cylinder, inner cylinder when x0 > 0; a bottom at y0 = 0 on a pec / pmc z_lo mirror is closed by the images: E_r, E_phi, H_z even for pmc, odd for pec): J = n x H, M = -n x E integrated over phi in closed form (Bessel J_(m-1), J_m, J_(m+1)); vacuum outside the box (enclose every scatterer and source). Result 'far_field', one row per wavelength: power = r^2 |E|^2 / (2 eta0) [W/sr] versus meridional angle counter-clockwise from +r (0 = equator, pi/2 = +z; cos < 0 = the phi = pi side, the same power for one order); 2 pi int power cos(angle) d angle over -pi/2 .. pi/2 = the radiated power; extras power_theta / power_phi, angle_axes, azimuthal_order. Driven order sum: the pattern of the summed 3D field in the plane through the sources (cos >= 0 at phi = 0, the others at phi = pi: no longer equal); extras power_azimuthal_mean (phi average; its integral as above is the radiated power), power_orders (n_wavelengths x n_orders x n_angles, each m with -m), azimuthal_orders instead of azimuthal_order. Needs one cell beyond x1 / y1 and below y0 inside the domain; the box covers cells [cell(lo), cell(hi) + 1) per axis (an edge exactly on a cell edge adds a cell).

- Category monitor; selection domain entities, object kinds rectangle, exactly 1; result kind `far_field`

Params:
- `n_angles` (int; default 360; >= 1) - Number of angles
  Angles evenly spaced over 360 degrees in the meridional (drawing) plane, counter-clockwise from +r (0 = equator, pi/2 = +z, pi = equator at phi = pi).

### Feature `em_fdfd_bor.resonance_table` - Resonance table

Resonances of the last eigenfrequency solve (per order of azimuthal_orders, order by order), nearest the target (wavelength setting) first; accurate only near it. Result 'table', one row per resonance: resonance_number, wavelength = 2 pi C0 / Re(omega) [m], frequency / frequency_imag = Re / Im(omega) / (2 pi) [Hz] (> 0 decays), q_factor = Re(omega) / (2 Im(omega)) (inf when lossless and closed), pml_fraction (share of the ring-volume |E|^2 in PML cells; > 0.5 dropped), azimuthal_order; extras target_wavelength [m], selected_resonance, azimuthal_orders. Q versus a parameter: derived value source '<physics>.<this feature>', expression q_factor, operation at, at = 0.

- Category monitor; selection none (a selection is ignored with a warning); mesh kinds tensor, triangles; result kind `table`

Params: none

## Physics type `em_fdfd_conical` - Electromagnetic Waves, frequency domain (out-of-plane wave number k_z)

Conical FDFD of a z-invariant structure: the drawing is its xy cross-section, fields ~ exp(j (omega t - k_z z)) with the k_z setting, so E_x, E_y, E_z, H_x, H_y, H_z all couple. Projected 3D Yee cell (em_modes layout and wall rules): E_z at cell centres, E_x, H_y on +x faces, E_y, H_x on +y faces, H_z at the +x+y corner; unknowns E (3 per cell incl. PML), (k0^2 eps - curl mu^-1 curl) E = -j omega mu0 J with d/dz = -j k_z. Host matrix; needs scipy; validation warns near and refuses beyond the factor size limit. Role 'linear': sparse_direct = host SuperLU (cusolver_qr is refused), one factor per wavelength, k_z and material state, reused as GMRES preconditioner after a material change; back_end cudss / cudss_mixed: GPU cuDSS LDL^T of the dual-area symmetrized operator (LU with a Bloch phase), no size limit, plan reused. Studies: stationary (wavelength setting; with heat via heat_em_thermo_optic / em_heat_joule), frequency_domain (one solve per wavelength at the same k_z), eigenfrequency (role 'eigen' arpack_shift_invert: squared-Cayley shift-invert resonances at k_z nearest the wavelength setting, complex omega and Q; static curl-free solutions dropped; PML and dispersion frozen at the target; factorization auto = cudss on the gpu backend with nvmath-python (superlu if cuDSS refuses the operator), else superlu; cudss: GPU LDL^T (LU with a Bloch phase), no size limit; cudss_mixed: complex64, float64 Rayleigh quotients). Walls / mirrors / Bloch / CPML as em_modes plus bloch_kx / bloch_ky. Outputs at cell centres: components Re of the z = 0 phasors; sz = 1/2 Re(E_x H_y* - E_y H_x*); absorbed_power = state q_abs = 1/2 omega eps0 sum_c (-Im eps_c) |E_c|^2 (cell means; em_heat_joule hands it to heat); eps_r = eps_zz. Resonances are scaled to 1 real at the largest E sample (V/m). Material vocabulary of em_modes (diagonal eps_xx, eps_yy, eps_zz); heat_em_thermo_optic writes all three permittivity arrays. Not yet: conical TFSF plane wave, far field, mode ports, conformal PEC. Triangles mesh: eigenfrequency on mixed finite elements (see discretization); driven studies, sources / probes / flux and periodic faces need a tensor mesh. Instance usually 'em'.

- Default instance name `em`; studies stationary, frequency_domain, eigenfrequency (default {"type": "stationary"})
- Backends gpu, cpu; mesh kinds tensor, triangles; refinement indicator fields e_intensity; dispersion poles used
- Features: point_source, line_source, field_probe, flux_monitor, pec_domain, resonance_table

### Settings (PhysicsSpec.settings)

- `bc_x_lo`, `bc_x_hi`, `bc_y_lo`, `bc_y_hi` (default "cpml"; cpml | pec | pmc | periodic | symmetric | antisymmetric) - Left edge / Right edge / Bottom edge / Top edge
  cpml: pml_cells absorbing cells outside the face. Frequency-domain CPML: stretch s = kappa + sigma / (alpha + j omega eps0), pml_* grading. periodic: on both faces of the axis; period = the meshed window (uniform mesh: rounded up to whole cells); k = 0 (normal incidence) unless the type has bloch_kx / bloch_ky (em_fdfd_nonlinear: per harmonic_channel). Walls and mirrors on the em_modes planes (same projected Yee cell): a pec / pmc wall is the inner face of the outermost cell (a ghost holding the image), half a cell off the em_fdfd_ez pec and em_fdfd_hz pmc walls; a symmetric (E even, PMC plane) / antisymmetric (E odd, PEC plane) mirror adds its ghost outside, so its plane is the domain edge. At k_z != 0 an x or y mirror stays a symmetry and halves the unknowns.
- `pml_cells` [cells] (int; default 15; >= 1; visible when any of bc_x_lo, bc_x_hi, bc_y_lo, bc_y_hi in (cpml)) - Absorbing layer thickness. Help: shared `em_eme.pml_cells`
- `pml_order` (int; default 3; >= 1; visible when any of bc_x_lo, bc_x_hi, bc_y_lo, bc_y_hi in (cpml)) - Absorbing layer grading
  Polynomial order m of the CPML sigma / kappa grading; 3-4 typical.
- `pml_sigma_factor` [1] (default 1; > 0; visible when any of bc_x_lo, bc_x_hi, bc_y_lo, bc_y_hi in (cpml)) - Absorbing layer strength. Help: shared `em_eme.pml_sigma_factor`
- `pml_kappa_max` [1] (default 15; >= 1; visible when any of bc_x_lo, bc_x_hi, bc_y_lo, bc_y_hi in (cpml)) - Absorbing layer stretch
  Peak real CPML stretch (1 = none); larger damps evanescent and grazing waves; 5-15 typical.
- `pml_alpha_max` [S/m] (default 0; >= 0; visible when any of bc_x_lo, bc_x_hi, bc_y_lo, bc_y_hi in (cpml)) - Absorbing layer low-frequency damping. Help: shared `em_eme.pml_alpha_max`
- `wavelength` [m] (default 1.55e-06; > 0) - Wavelength
  Vacuum wavelength of a stationary solve; eigenfrequency: the target (resonances nearest it at k_z); frequency_domain ignores it (validation info when not the default). Mesh: >= 10 (better 20) cells per lambda0 / |n| and >= 2 per skin depth (validation checks both). Typical 0.4e-6 to 2e-6 m.
- `k_z` [rad/m] (default 0) - Out-of-plane wave number
  Fields ~ exp(j (omega t - k_z z)) along the z-invariant structure, so all six components couple; k_z = 0 gives em_fdfd_ez (E_z, H_x, H_y) and em_fdfd_hz (H_z, E_x, E_y) at once (walls half a cell off theirs). Uses: conical / oblique incidence on gratings (k_z = k0 n sin(theta) of the z share of the wave vector, the in-plane share from bloch_kx / bloch_ky); a guide cross-section driven at beta = k_z (sources excite guided modes resonantly where omega meets their dispersion); eigenfrequency: the resonances at fixed k_z are the guided modes with beta = k_z (em_modes read the other way; sweep k_z for the dispersion). Fixed over the wavelengths of a frequency_domain study (the incidence angle changes). |k_z| > k0 n makes the field evanescent in that material. Real only (no leaky / complex k_z).
- `discretization` (default "quadratic"; quadratic | linear) - Discretization
  Element order on a triangles mesh (tensor meshes use the Yee cell). Eigenfrequency only: the em_modes mixed elements (Nedelec for E_x, E_y, Lagrange for E_z, same degree: no spurious modes) with the k_z terms; quadratic maps curved edges isoparametrically, so round guides follow the outline. linear (Whitney / P1): cheaper, error ~h^2 instead of ~h^4 in k0^2. ~7 (quadratic) or 2 (linear) unknowns per element; squared-Cayley shift-invert by the eigen solver (host SuperLU; factorization cudss: GPU LDL^T; cudss_mixed: complex64 + float64 Rayleigh quotients). Materials one value per element; a cpml face gets mesh pml_layers element layers (pml_* stretch) and a pec outer side; pec_domain removes its elements (tangential E = 0 on their outline); pec / pmc / mirror faces as em_modes. On triangles stationary / frequency_domain, every source / probe / flux feature and periodic / Bloch faces are validation errors; resonance_table and pec_domain work.
- `bloch_kx` [rad/m] (default 0; visible when bc_x_lo in (periodic)) - Bloch wave vector x. Help: shared `em_fdfd_conical.bloch_kx`
- `bloch_ky` [rad/m] (default 0; visible when bc_y_lo in (periodic)) - Bloch wave vector y. Help: shared `em_fdfd_conical.bloch_kx`

### Material properties (MaterialSpec.properties)

- `eps_r` [1] (default 1; >= 1; writes eps_r, eps_xx, eps_yy) - Relative permittivity
  Isotropic: eps_xx, eps_yy, eps_zz unless the material sets a component (it wins). n^2 of a lossless dielectric: silica ~2.085, silicon ~12.1 at 1.55 um. E_z sees the cell value, E_x / E_y on the +x / +y cell faces the width-weighted mean of the two cells sharing that face (solver_defaults.subpixel_smoothing averages interface faces anisotropically). Solved with the complex value at the solve wavelength: this - j sigma_e / (omega eps0) + chi(omega) of every Drude / Lorentz pole (exp(+j omega t): loss Im < 0).
- `eps_zz` [1] (default 1; >= 1; writes eps_r) - Relative permittivity, z (out of plane)
  Out-of-plane component, the one E_z sees at the cell centres; overrides eps_r for E_z (writes the eps_r array).
- `eps_xx` [1] (default 1; >= 1) - Relative permittivity, x
  The one E_x sees on the +x cell faces (face mean as eps_r); overrides eps_r for E_x.
- `eps_yy` [1] (default 1; >= 1) - Relative permittivity, y
  The one E_y sees on the +y cell faces (face mean as eps_r); overrides eps_r for E_y.
- `sigma_e` [S/m] (default 0; >= 0) - Electric conductivity
  All three E components gain -j sigma_e / (omega eps0); weak absorber of index n, extinction kappa: sigma_e = 2 n kappa omega eps0. Metals: a Drude pole, not their DC conductivity.
- `mu_r` [1] (default 1; >= 1) - Relative permeability. Help: shared `em_fdfd_conical.mu_r`
- `sigma_m` [Ohm/m] (default 0; >= 0) - Magnetic conductivity
  mu_r gains -j sigma_m / (omega mu0) on H_x, H_y, H_z.

### Fields

Output fields (primary e_intensity; [state] = also a state field):
- `ex` - Re E_x (V/m)
- `ey` - Re E_y (V/m)
- `ez` - Re E_z (V/m)
- `hx` - Re H_x (A/m)
- `hy` - Re H_y (A/m)
- `hz` - Re H_z (A/m)
- `ex_abs` - |E_x| (V/m)
- `ey_abs` - |E_y| (V/m)
- `ez_abs` - |E_z| (V/m)
- `hx_abs` - |H_x| (A/m)
- `hy_abs` - |H_y| (A/m)
- `hz_abs` - |H_z| (A/m)
- `e_abs` - |E| (V/m)
- `e_intensity` - |E|^2 (V^2/m^2) [state]
- `h_abs` - |H| (A/m)
- `sz` - S_z (power flow along z) (W/m^2)
- `absorbed_power` - Absorbed power density (W/m^3)
- `eps_r` - Relative permittivity zz (1) [state]
- `eps_xx` - Relative permittivity xx (1) [state]
- `eps_yy` - Relative permittivity yy (1) [state]
- `sigma_e` - Electric conductivity (S/m) [state]
State fields that are no output field:
- `q_abs` - Absorbed power density (W/m^3)

Scalar outputs: source_power (W/m): time-averaged power per unit z length the enabled point / line sources deliver in the last driven solve, 1/2 Re sum E . J* dA over their current points (drawn part only: mirror images not counted, while flux results are unfolded x mirror_factor). Equals the net flux out of closed lossless flux lines around the sources without a mirror face. NaN plus a run-log warning before a driven solve (e.g. eigenfrequency). Derived value expression <physics>_source_power.

### Source slots

- `eps_r_update` (1): Relative permittivity eps_r: each transfer replaces the whole array (PML ring included); index couplings (heat_em_thermo_optic) add dn: eps = (n0 + sum dn)^2.
- `eps_xx_update` (1): Relative permittivity eps_xx: each transfer replaces the whole array (PML ring included); index couplings (heat_em_thermo_optic) add dn: eps = (n0 + sum dn)^2.
- `eps_yy_update` (1): Relative permittivity eps_yy: each transfer replaces the whole array (PML ring included); index couplings (heat_em_thermo_optic) add dn: eps = (n0 + sum dn)^2.

### Feature `em_fdfd_conical.point_source` - Point source

Current element of any direction in the cell containing the point, modulated as exp(-j k_z z); see component and current.

- Category source; selection point entities, object kinds point, exactly 1; result none

Params:
- `component` (default "z"; x | y | z) - Direction. Help: shared `em_fdfd_conical.point_source.component`
- `current` [A] (default 0.001) - Current
  Integral of J over the cell cross-section: 'z' J = I / (dx dy), a filament I exp(-j k_z z) (k_z = 0: the em_fdfd_ez point source); x / y a line of current elements of moment I per unit z length. Fields are linear in it. Sign: the current is minus the textbook impressed current, so phases (and powers from probe fields) are pi off textbook formulas; moduli and fluxes agree.
- `phase` [deg] (default 0) - Phase
  Phasor phase (0 = cos carrier, as the em_fdfd_* sources); with a single source it only rotates every phasor.

### Feature `em_fdfd_conical.line_source` - Line source

Uniform current sheet of any direction on the cells of an axis-aligned line; across a period with bloch_k along it and k_z it launches the conical plane waves of that wave vector on both sides (see amplitude).

- Category source; selection line entities, object kinds line, exactly 1; result none

Params:
- `component` (default "z"; x | y | z) - Direction. Help: shared `em_fdfd_conical.point_source.component`
- `amplitude` [A/m] (default 1) - Surface current
  Uniform surface current density K: each line cell carries K times its length (J = K / width across the line), along a periodic Bloch axis times exp(-j k s). A sheet across a whole period (or ending on cpml edges: it continues through the PML) launches plane waves (k along the line, +-k_normal, k_z) on both sides, k_normal^2 = k0^2 n^2 - k_along^2 - k_z^2 (evanescent when negative). Fields are linear in it. Sign: the current is minus the textbook impressed current, so phases (and powers from probe fields) are pi off textbook formulas; moduli and fluxes agree.
- `phase` [deg] (default 0) - Phase
  Phasor phase (0 = cos carrier, as the em_fdfd_* sources); with a single source it only rotates every phasor.

### Feature `em_fdfd_conical.field_probe` - Field probe

Phasor of one component in the containing cell per driven solve. Result 'xy' versus wavelength: abs (component unit), phase (rad); extras frequency, wavelength, component, unit.

- Category probe; selection point entities, object kinds point, exactly 1; result kind `xy`

Params:
- `component` (default "ez"; ex | ey | ez | hx | hy | hz) - Field component
  Complex phasor at the centre of the containing cell (face / corner points averaged, Bloch phases included) at z = 0, per driven solve.

### Feature `em_fdfd_conical.flux_monitor` - Flux monitor

Time-averaged power per unit z length [W/m] through an axis-aligned line per driven solve, 1/2 Re (E x H*) . n: horizontal line along +y, sum [dx E_z H_x* - dx_dual E_x H_z*] / 2; vertical along +x, sum [dy_dual E_y H_z* - dy E_z H_y*] / 2; E of the line cells, H on their hi face (the discrete Poynting boundary term: through lossless cells a line across a period or wall to wall carries the same power on every row, so the difference of two lines is exactly source power minus absorption between them); the end face pairs count half. A line reaching a mirror face counts its image (x mirror_factor, 2 per face). The z flux is the output field sz. Result 'flux_spectrum' [W/m], one entry per wavelength, sorted. The line covers cells [cell(start), cell(end) + 1) (an end exactly on a cell edge adds a cell); its hi face must be inside the grid (or wrap on a periodic axis).

- Category monitor; selection line entities, object kinds line, exactly 1; result kind `flux_spectrum`

Params: none

### Feature `em_fdfd_conical.pec_domain` - Perfect electric conductor

In cells whose centre lies in the domains E_z = 0, E_x / E_y = 0 on faces between two such cells (staircased as em_modes; no conformal option).

- Category domain_condition; selection domain entities, at least 1; mesh kinds tensor, triangles; result none

Params: none

### Feature `em_fdfd_conical.resonance_table` - Resonance table

Resonances of the last eigenfrequency solve at the k_z setting, nearest the target (wavelength setting) first; accurate only near it. Result 'table', one row per resonance: resonance_number, wavelength = 2 pi C0 / Re(omega) [m], frequency / frequency_imag = Re / Im(omega) / (2 pi) [Hz] (> 0 decays), q_factor = Re(omega) / (2 Im(omega)) (inf when lossless and closed), pml_fraction (share of |E|^2 dA in PML cells; > 0.5 dropped); extras target_wavelength [m], selected_resonance. At k_z = beta the resonances are the guided modes of propagation constant beta: a k_z sweep with a derived value of the frequency column gives the dispersion. Q versus a parameter: derived value source '<physics>.<this feature>', expression q_factor, operation at, at = 0.

- Category monitor; selection none (a selection is ignored with a warning); mesh kinds tensor, triangles; result kind `table`

Params: none

## Physics type `em_fdfd_ez` - Electromagnetic Waves, frequency domain (2D, electric field out of plane)

2D finite-difference frequency-domain (FDFD) solver for the E_z polarisation: E_z out of plane in V/m, H_x and H_y in plane in A/m, x to the right and y up, on the em_fdtd_ez Yee grid (E_z at cell centres, H_x / H_y on the +y / +x cell faces). e_abs / e_intensity / h_abs = |E|, |E|^2, |H| at the cell centres (in-plane face phasors averaged there first): peak amplitudes, where em_fdtd_* give instantaneous values. One sparse direct solve of the discrete Helmholtz equation per vacuum wavelength, exp(+j omega t): fields are complex phasors F (real field Re(F e^{j omega t})), every source a phasor (phase setting) with the calibrated, mesh-independent amplitude of the matching FDTD source. absorbed_power (state q_abs) = 1/2 omega eps0 (-Im eps) |E|^2 in W/m^3 (magnetic loss not counted), what em_heat_joule hands to heat. Solver roles (see solvers): linear = sparse_direct (scipy_splu: host SuperLU, ~1e6 unknowns nx * ny incl. PML; cusolver_qr ~1e5; cudss: cuDSS LDL^T, ~20 x SuperLU at 1e5 - 5e5 unknowns (cudss_mixed solves slower); mumps / mumps_mixed / pardiso / pardiso_mixed: the same factor on host cores; a Bloch phase, eps_xy or gyration_z makes it a general LU) or line_block (elongated grids), one factorisation per wavelength and material state, reused for every source; eigen = arpack_shift_invert (factor: SuperLU, cudss / cudss_mixed, mumps / mumps_mixed / pardiso / pardiso_mixed or the line_block one when that is the linear solver; a rejected solve redoes it on SuperLU). Studies: stationary at the wavelength setting (with heat, em_heat_joule and heat_em_thermo_optic iterate to a fixed point; plain Picard oscillates once the self-heating shift exceeds about one linewidth: set the study relaxation < 1); frequency_domain a wavelength list (with em_heat_joule each wavelength's fixed point, continued from the previous), one snapshot each; eigenfrequency the source-free resonances nearest the wavelength setting, one snapshot each plus resonance_table; optomechanics likewise when a solid_mechanics optomechanical_coupling names it (else a stationary background; no coupling or material may read it); optimization maximises the adjoint_objective sum over the design_region densities (L-BFGS-B); time_dependent (beside a time-stepped physics such as elastic_waves, never em_fdtd_*) re-solves on the frozen state every k steps (k = its every) when an input changed; monitors keep the last solve. Periodic faces take bloch_kx / bloch_ky. On a triangles mesh: Lagrange finite elements (see discretization; materials and state fields per element, the same output names on a display raster).

- Default instance name `em`; studies stationary, frequency_domain, eigenfrequency, optimization, time_dependent, optomechanics (default {"type": "stationary"})
- Backends gpu, cpu; mesh kinds tensor, triangles; refinement indicator fields ez_re; dispersion poles used
- Features: point_source, line_source, gaussian_beam, plane_wave_tfsf, mode_source, pec_domain, conducting_sheet, effective_index, phase_change_medium, field_probe, flux_monitor, mode_monitor, far_field, adjoint_objective, design_region, resonance_table

- `bc_x_lo`, `bc_x_hi`, `bc_y_lo`, `bc_y_hi` (default "cpml"; cpml | pec | pmc | periodic | symmetric | antisymmetric) - Left edge / Right edge / Bottom edge / Top edge. Help: shared `em_fdfd_ez.bc_x_lo`
- `pml_cells` [cells] (int; default 15; >= 1; visible when any of bc_x_lo, bc_x_hi, bc_y_lo, bc_y_hi in (cpml)) - Absorbing layer thickness. Help: shared `em_eme.pml_cells`
- `pml_order` (int; default 3; >= 1; visible when any of bc_x_lo, bc_x_hi, bc_y_lo, bc_y_hi in (cpml)) - Absorbing layer grading
  Polynomial order m of the CPML sigma / kappa grading; 3-4 typical.
- `pml_sigma_factor` [1] (default 1; > 0; visible when any of bc_x_lo, bc_x_hi, bc_y_lo, bc_y_hi in (cpml)) - Absorbing layer strength. Help: shared `em_eme.pml_sigma_factor`
- `pml_kappa_max` [1] (default 15; >= 1; visible when any of bc_x_lo, bc_x_hi, bc_y_lo, bc_y_hi in (cpml)) - Absorbing layer stretch
  Peak real CPML stretch (1 = none); larger damps evanescent and grazing waves; 5-15 typical.
- `pml_alpha_max` [S/m] (default 0; >= 0; visible when any of bc_x_lo, bc_x_hi, bc_y_lo, bc_y_hi in (cpml)) - Absorbing layer low-frequency damping. Help: shared `em_eme.pml_alpha_max`
- `wavelength` [m] (default 1.55e-06; > 0) - Wavelength. Help: shared `em_fdfd_ez.wavelength`
- `discretization` (default "quadratic"; quadratic | linear) - Discretization. Help: shared `em_fdfd_ez.discretization`
- `bloch_kx` [rad/m] (default 0; visible when bc_x_lo in (periodic)) - Bloch wave vector x. Help: shared `em_fdfd_ez.bloch_kx`
- `bloch_ky` [rad/m] (default 0; visible when bc_y_lo in (periodic)) - Bloch wave vector y. Help: shared `em_fdfd_ez.bloch_kx`

### Material properties (MaterialSpec.properties)

- `eps_r` [1] (default 1; >= 1) - Relative permittivity
  n^2 of a lossless dielectric (glass ~2.1-2.25, silicon ~12.1 at 1.55 um). E_z sees eps_zz instead when set. Solved as the complex eps(omega) = this value - j sigma_e / (omega eps0) + chi(omega) of every Drude / Lorentz pole (exp(+j omega t): loss has Im < 0). With poles it is the background eps_inf (an explicit permittivity wins over the Drude eps_inf). A state-dependent value (e.g. of T) is rewritten at every coupling update of a stationary study (once, after the background solve, in a frequency_domain study). Tabulated eps1 + j eps2 (eps2 <= 0) at one omega: eps1 >= 1: this value eps1, sigma_e = -eps2 omega eps0; a metal (eps1 < 1, below the >= 1 bound shared with em_fdtd_*): no permittivity, a Drude pole with eps_inf 1, a = 1 - eps1, omega_p = omega sqrt((a^2 + eps2^2) / a), gamma = -omega eps2 / a, exact at that omega only (gold -115 - 11j at 1.55 um: omega_p 1.31e16, gamma 1.15e14 rad/s).
- `eps_zz` [1] (default 1; >= 1; writes eps_r) - Relative permittivity, z (out of plane). Help: shared `em_fdfd_ez.eps_zz`
- `sigma_e` [S/m] (default 0; >= 0) - Electric conductivity
  Ohmic loss: eps gains -j sigma_e / (omega eps0). Weak absorber of index n, extinction kappa at omega: sigma_e = 2 n kappa omega eps0; model metals with a Drude pole, not their DC conductivity.
- `mu_r` [1] (default 1; >= 1) - Relative permeability
  mu_r - j sigma_m / (omega mu0) on the H_x / H_y faces, each from the cell it is the +y / +x face of; also sets the local impedance of line sources. 1 for practically every optical material.
- `sigma_m` [Ohm/m] (default 0; >= 0) - Magnetic conductivity
  Magnetic loss on H_x, H_y: mu_r gains -j sigma_m / (omega mu0); sigma_m / (mu0 mu_r) = sigma_e / (eps0 eps_r) is an impedance-matched absorber (no reflection at normal incidence).

### Feature `em_fdfd_ez.point_source` - Point source

z-directed filament current phasor I e^{j phase} in the cell containing the point (a coordinate exactly on a cell edge goes to the upper cell), radiating a mesh-independent cylindrical wave.

- Category source; selection point entities, object kinds point, exactly 1; mesh kinds tensor, triangles; result none

Params:
- `current` [A] (default 0.001) - Electric line current
  Peak z-directed filament current I; mesh-independent field |E_z| = omega mu0 I / 4 |H0^(2)(k r)| in a homogeneous non-magnetic medium of wavenumber k (1 mA at wavelength 1 um: ~2e5 V/m at r = 1 um). Sign: the current is minus the textbook impressed current, so phases (and powers from probe fields) are pi off textbook formulas; moduli and fluxes agree.
- `phase` [deg] (default 0) - Phase. Help: shared `em_fdfd_ez.point_source.phase`

### Feature `em_fdfd_ez.line_source` - Line source

Help: shared `em_fdfd_ez.line_source`

- Category source; selection line entities, object kinds line, exactly 1; result none

Params:
- `amplitude` [V/m] (default 1) - Amplitude
  E_z radiated to each side of the line in the local medium (a plane wave of this amplitude when the line spans a periodic axis); calibrated with the complex eps_r (sigma_e, dispersion) and mu of the line cells at the solved wavelength: exact in any homogeneous medium. Each line cell is calibrated to its own medium, so across several media (core / cladding) the current steps at the interfaces and diffracts (validation warns); keep the line in one medium. A recalibration (e.g. thermo-optic eps change in the line cells) keeps the amplitude, so the launched power ~ amplitude^2 n / (2 eta0) follows n (~0.5% for dn = 0.01 at n = 2.2).
- `phase` [deg] (default 0) - Phase. Help: shared `em_fdfd_ez.point_source.phase`

### Feature `em_fdfd_ez.mode_source` - Mode source

Port source launching one guided mode of the cross-section under an axis-aligned line in one direction. One-sided total-field / scattered-field line: total field from the line cells downstream, only the scattered field (what comes back) upstream; the interface is the lo face of the line cells for positive, their hi face for negative. The launch is exact and one-sided at every solved wavelength of a straight guide. Mode monitors normalise by it when it is the only enabled mode source of the physics. The 1D line eigenmodes use the FDFD discretisation (Yee widths, PML stretch, complex eps and mu of the line cells with poles, sigma_e, sigma_m), re-solved at every solved wavelength and after any material change (thermo-optic coupling, state-dependent permittivity). Put the line across a straight guide with the same cross-section a few cells on either side, on a locally uniform mesh (validation warns when the cell widths along the normal change by more than 1% around the line and when its face lies inside a CPML layer, i.e. the line is in the outermost window cell). Span ends: an end on a cpml domain edge continues the solve through the PML (open); an end on a pec domain edge takes E_z = 0, one on a pmc or symmetric edge dE_z/dn = 0 and one on an antisymmetric edge E_z odd about the plane; an end inside the domain, or a partial span of a periodic axis, is metal (E_z = 0 in the next cell), so extend the line well into the cladding (the build warns above 1% of the mode peak at a metal end); a span over a whole periodic axis is periodic. The line covers cells [cell(start), cell(end) + 1) (an end exactly on a cell edge adds a cell). Result 'table' of the latest port solve (frequency_domain: its last wavelength), one row per mode for the first max(mode_number + 2, 4) modes: mode_number, n_eff, n_eff_imag (< 0 = loss, exp(+j omega t)), loss_db_per_cm, n_group, edge_field (largest |field| at the line ends / peak; above 1e-2 at a metal end the line cuts the mode), selected (the launched mode); extras wavelength (m), power (W/m), direction, mode_number and phase (deg).

- Category source; selection line entities, object kinds line, exactly 1; result kind `table`

Params:
- `mode_number` (int; default 1; >= 1) - Mode number. Help: shared `em_fdfd_ez.mode_source.mode_number`
- `direction` (default "positive"; positive | negative) - Direction. Help: shared `em_fdfd_ez.mode_source.direction`
- `power` [W/m] (default 1; > 0) - Mode power. Help: shared `em_fdfd_ez.mode_source.power`
- `phase` [deg] (default 0) - Phase. Help: shared `em_fdfd_ez.point_source.phase`
