- Default instance name `magnetic`; studies stationary, time_dependent (default {"type": "stationary"})
- Backends gpu, cpu; mesh kinds tensor, tetrahedra; refinement indicator fields B_abs; dispersion poles not used
- Features: magnetic_insulation, symmetry, external_field, ideal_iron, coil, probe

### Settings (PhysicsSpec.settings)

- `nonlinear_tolerance` [1] (default 1e-06; > 0) - Saturation iteration tolerance. Help: shared `magnetostatics.nonlinear_tolerance`
- `nonlinear_max_iterations` (int; default 100; >= 1) - Saturation iteration limit. Help: shared `magnetostatics.nonlinear_max_iterations`
- `nonlinear_method` (default "auto"; auto | anderson | picard | newton) - Saturation iteration method. Help: shared `magnetostatics.nonlinear_method`
- `nonlinear_relaxation` [1] (default 0.5; [0.015625, 1]) - Saturation iteration damping. Help: shared `magnetostatics.nonlinear_relaxation`
- `discretization` (default "quadratic"; quadratic | linear) - Discretization. Help: shared `electric_currents.discretization`

### Material properties (MaterialSpec.properties)

- `mu_dc` [1] (> 0; nullable; writes mu_dc_xx, mu_dc_yy, mu_dc_zz) - Static relative permeability
  Sets mu_dc_xx, _yy and _zz (component entries override it); unset = 1 (vacuum). NOT the optical mu_r of the wave physics. Typical: air, copper, aluminium 1; ferrite 1e3 - 1e4; electrical steel 4e3; Metglas 1e4 - 1e5; mu-metal 5e4. A large contrast is exact; pcg multigrid needs a few hundred iterations at 1e5. With saturation_polarization: the initial permeability of the B-H curve.
- `mu_dc_xx`, `mu_dc_yy`, `mu_dc_zz` [1] (> 0; nullable) - Static relative permeability along x / Static relative permeability along y / Static relative permeability along z
  Overrides mu_dc for this axis.
- `remanence_x`, `remanence_y`, `remanence_z` [T] (nullable) - Remanence along x / Remanence along y / Remanence along z
  Remanent flux density B_r along the axis in its name, of a permanent magnet: B = mu0 mu_dc H + B_r, entered as face drives B_r / mu_dc (exact for a uniformly magnetised region). Typical: NdFeB 1.2 - 1.4 T with mu_dc 1.05, SmCo 1.0 T, ferrite 0.4 T with mu_dc 1.1. Unset = 0.
- `saturation_polarization` [T] (> 0; nullable) - Saturation polarisation
  Saturation polarisation J_s of an anhysteretic B-H curve: Frohlich-Kennelly B = mu0 H + J_s a H / (1 + a H), a = mu0 (mu_dc - 1) / J_s (initial permeability mu_dc, B -> mu0 H + J_s), no hysteresis. Isotropic: mu_dc_xx, _yy, _zz must be equal (validation error). A fixed point on ln of the secant permeability mu = B(|H|) / (mu0 |H|) at the cell-centre |H| (settings nonlinear_*); energy and coil inductances are then secant values. Unset = linear; mu_dc <= 1 stays linear. Not with a remanence or a bh_curve in the same material (validation error). Typical: iron 2.15, electrical steel 2.0, Metglas 0.6 - 1.6, Mn-Zn ferrite 0.4 - 0.5, NiFe (mu-metal) 0.8.
- `bh_curve` (table; columns H [A/m], B [T]; >= 2 rows, every column strictly increasing; >= 0; nullable; no x, y; no fields; writes no array) - B-H curve. Help: shared `magnetostatics.bh_curve`

### Fields

Output fields (primary B_abs; [state] = also a state field):
- `B_abs` - Magnetic flux density magnitude (T) [state]
- `B_x` - Magnetic flux density x (T) [state]
- `B_y` - Magnetic flux density y (T) [state]
- `B_z` - Magnetic flux density z (T) [state]
- `phi_m` - Magnetic scalar potential (A) [state]
- `H_x` - Magnetic field x (A/m) [state]
- `H_y` - Magnetic field y (A/m) [state]
- `H_z` - Magnetic field z (A/m) [state]
- `w_mag` - Magnetic energy density (J/m^3) [state]
- `J_x` - Coil current density x (A/m^2) [state]
- `J_y` - Coil current density y (A/m^2) [state]
- `J_z` - Coil current density z (A/m^2) [state]
- `mu_eff` - Effective relative permeability (1) [state]
- `mu_dc_xx` - Static relative permeability xx (1) [state]
- `mu_dc_yy` - Static relative permeability yy (1) [state]
- `mu_dc_zz` - Static relative permeability zz (1) [state]

Scalar outputs: energy [J]: field energy of the free cells, the sum over faces of B_n^2 / (2 mu0 mu_face) times the face volume (held cells and the external-field ring excluded, held-free faces count their free half cell; with remanence the energy of B alone; saturating: the secant value; tetrahedra: exact integrals of the element fields); <coil>_flux_linkage [Wb] and <coil>_inductance [H] of every enabled coil, as its table result.

### Source slots

- none

### Feature `magnetostatics_3d.magnetic_insulation` - Magnetic insulation

B.n = 0 on the selected outer faces (z_lo / z_hi included; the default of every face no feature sets): field lines run along the face (Neumann on phi_m); the mirror plane of a field parallel to it, or a distant boundary. Does not anchor: without a symmetry face, external field or ideal iron the window corner cell is held at phi_m = 0 (it reads B = 0; tetrahedra: the window node nearest the lower corner).

- Category boundary_condition; selection boundary entities, at least 1, outer faces only; mesh kinds tensor, tetrahedra; result none

Params: none

### Feature `magnetostatics_3d.symmetry` - Symmetry (field normal)

phi_m = 0 (Dirichlet) on the selected outer faces: no tangential H, field lines cross at right angles; the mirror plane of a field normal to it (midway between a magnet and its mirror image) or a face next to ideal iron. The reverse of 2D magnetostatics (this type solves for the scalar potential). Anchors the solve.

- Category boundary_condition; selection boundary entities, at least 1, outer faces only; mesh kinds tensor, tetrahedra; result none

Params: none

### Feature `magnetostatics_3d.external_field` - External magnetic field

Uniform applied flux density (B_x, B_y, B_z), selection 'all' only, one per physics: the outermost window cells (all six faces) are held at phi_m = -B . r / mu0 (r from the window corner), exact for a uniform field on any cell widths. Keep objects several object sizes from the window edges (error ~ (object size / distance)^3 of a dipole). The ring cells leave the solve (B, H read 0 there) and face features under it do nothing. Tetrahedra: phi_m held on the window faces, no ring (every element stays free; wins over face features). Anchors the solve. Typical: the Earth field ~5e-5 T, a Helmholtz coil 1e-4 - 1e-2 T.

- Category domain_condition; selection domain entities, exactly 1; mesh kinds tensor, tetrahedra; result none

Params:
- `B_x`, `B_y` [T] (default 0) - Applied flux density x / Applied flux density y
  Component of the uniform applied flux density.
- `B_z` [T] (default 0.0001) - Applied flux density z
  Component of the uniform applied flux density.

### Feature `magnetostatics_3d.ideal_iron` - Ideal iron (fixed magnetic potential)

Ideal iron (mu -> infinity): phi_m held on the selected cells for the whole run, H = 0 inside, B normal to its surface; the cells leave the solve (B, H read 0). Two regions at different potentials drive flux between them like yoke poles. The reverse of the 2D fixed vector potential (a flux excluder). Anchors the solve.

- Category domain_condition; selection domain entities, at least 1; mesh kinds tensor, tetrahedra; result none

Params:
- `potential` [A] (default 0) - Magnetic scalar potential
  Magnetomotive force against phi_m = 0; 0 for a single iron region.

### Feature `magnetostatics_3d.coil` - Coil

Stranded coil around the axis (param axis) on the selected winding objects, e.g. a circle prism minus a smaller one: every window slice normal to the axis through winding cells must close around a hole inside the window, else the build fails. Drive: the coil field T along the axis (H = T - grad phi_m), T = turns current / h in the hole (h the winding's axial length), ramping to 0 across the winding (uniform J in a circular ring), 0 outside; J = curl T in fields J_x / J_y / J_z. Result 'table': one row [feature, current, turns, flux_linkage, inductance] of the latest solve (also scalars <feature>_flux_linkage / _inductance): flux_linkage = integral of T . B / current over the coil's support (the flux through each turn, summed), inductance = flux_linkage / current (nan at zero current); with several coils a coil's value includes the mutual flux. W = flux_linkage current / 2 exactly for one coil with no held cells (ring, ideal iron, symmetry face). A core of mu_dc above ~1e3 in the hole needs pcg precision 'double' or 'mixed' (T - grad phi_m cancels; validation warns for 'single'). Tetrahedra: T as lowest-order edge integrals, so the coil current is exactly turns current and J is constant per element; the winding must be one piece along the axis, h its element extent.

- Category domain_condition; selection domain entities, at least 1; mesh kinds tensor, tetrahedra; result kind `table`

Params:
- `axis` (default "z"; x | y | z) - Coil axis
  Axis the winding circles.
- `current` [A] (default 1) - Current
  Per turn, > 0 counter-clockwise seen from +axis (B along +axis inside).
- `turns` [1] (int; default 1; >= 1) - Turns
  Spread over the winding.

### Feature `magnetostatics_3d.probe` - Magnetic probe

Value in the cell containing the point (z unset: mid-height; tetrahedra: at the point), one sample per re-solve plus one at the end of the run (stationary: all at t = 0).

- Category probe; selection point entities, object kinds point, exactly 1; mesh kinds tensor, tetrahedra; result kind `timeseries`

Params:
- `component` (default "B_abs"; B_abs | phi_m) - Quantity
  Field sampled at the point.

## Physics type `membrane` - Membrane

Tensioned film, optionally with plate bending (a tensioned Kirchhoff plate), time-harmonic (exp(+j omega t)): D (1 + j eta) del^4 w - div(T (1 + j eta) grad w) - rho_s omega^2 w = p, w the out-of-plane displacement [m], T the tension tensor [[tension_xx, tension_xy], [tension_xy, tension_yy]] (material + coupled_tension_* slots), D = bending_stiffness, rho_s = areal_density, eta = loss_factor, p the pressure load. Waves travel at c = sqrt(T / rho_s). 2D models on triangles (complex Lagrange P2 / P1; with D the C0 interior penalty plate form on P2, clamps holding dw/dn = 0 weakly); 1D models on line elements over the cells (Hermite cubic with D): a string / plate strip, or the cross-section of a guide along y with axial_wavenumber. An element with no tension, areal_density or bending_stiffness is a hole (its outline a free edge); edges are free unless held. eigenfrequency: resonances by shift-invert on the host; complex omega, Im > 0 decays, Q = Re omega / (2 Im omega) from the loss factor and the PML; one snapshot per resonance labelled "resonance k: f = <Hz> Hz[, Q = ...]", scaled to 1 m real at its peak dof. frequency_response: one complex sparse factorisation per frequency by the linear role (cuDSS on the gpu backend, triangles only, its plan kept over the sweep; back_end 'auto': cudss_mixed there with nvmath-python, else host SuperLU; ~1e6 unknowns practical, 2e6 refused, also for the opt-in MUMPS / PARDISO); one snapshot per frequency (study setting snapshots). Fields nodal on triangles, at cell centres in 1D; state() holds w_re / w_im / w_abs per element (1D: per cell).

- Default instance name `membrane`; studies eigenfrequency, frequency_response (default {"type": "eigenfrequency"})
- Backends gpu, cpu; mesh kinds tensor, triangles; refinement indicator fields w_re; dispersion poles not used
- Features: clamped, clamped_line, simply_supported_line, simply_supported, symmetry, antisymmetry, pressure_load, line_force, point_force, field_probe, resonance_table, squeeze_film_damping, port, mode_projection

### Settings (PhysicsSpec.settings)

- `discretization` (default "quadratic"; quadratic | linear) - Discretization
  Lagrange order of w on the triangles of a 2D model (P2 isoparametric on circle / ellipse edges) and on the cells of a 1D model. Resonance errors fall as (k h)^4 for P2, (k h)^2 for P1 (k = 2 pi f / c, c = sqrt(T / rho_s)).
- `target_frequency` [Hz] (default 0; >= 0) - Eigenfrequency target
  Eigenfrequency study only: the resonances nearest it (shift-invert about (2 pi target_frequency)^2, moved 1e-4 above so a target on a resonance still factors); 0 = the lowest, which needs a clamp (a free membrane has a 0 Hz mode). With a PML and no pml_frequency it sets the PML strength, so it must then be > 0.
- `axial_wavenumber` [rad/m] (default 0) - Axial wavenumber
  1D models only: w ~ W(x) exp(-j k_y y), the line the cross-section of a guide along y; adds T_yy (1 + j eta) k_y^2, so a strip of width W clamped at both ends has omega_n = c sqrt((n pi / W)^2 + k_y^2), c = sqrt(T / rho_s) (sweep a parameter for the dispersion; below the cut-off n pi c / W, k_y is imaginary). With a bending_stiffness D it adds D (1 + j eta) (W'''' - 2 k_y^2 W'' + k_y^4 W). 0 = uniform along y (a string or strip). A 2D model refuses a nonzero value (use periodic_y with bloch_ky).
- `pml_x_lo`, `pml_x_hi`, `pml_y_lo`, `pml_y_hi` (bool; default false) - PML on x_lo / PML on x_hi / PML on y_lo / PML on y_hi
  Triangle meshes only: a perfectly matched layer beyond this face, a ring of pml_cells x the mesh dx (MeshSpec pml_layers element layers across), material continued from the window edge, stretch s = 1 - j beta (d / w)^2 (d the depth, w the thickness); beta from pml_reflection for the fastest wave of the ring at the reference frequency omega_r (see pml_frequency): c = sqrt(T / rho_s), with bending_stiffness D the propagating plate wave c^2 = (T + sqrt(T^2 + 4 D rho_s omega_r^2)) / (2 rho_s). Outer side clamped (w = 0; with bending also dw/dn = 0). With bending the ring must resolve sqrt(D / T) like the window and needs one element layer per cell (MeshSpec pml_layers >= pml_cells, else strong reflection; validation warns). Absorbed waves give resonances frequency_imag > 0 and a radiation Q; resonances with more than half their energy in the layer are dropped as PML modes. Waves far below omega_r are absorbed less. Keep clamps, line forces and probes off the face; every physics sharing the mesh must ring the same faces.
- `pml_cells` [1] (int; default 8; [1, 100]) - PML thickness (elements)
  Ring thickness in mesh dx (h_max) on every pml_<face> face; a fair part of the longest wavelength c / f there (6-12 typical).
- `pml_reflection` [1] (default 1e-06; (0, 1]) - PML reflection
  Theoretical round-trip reflection R at normal incidence for the fastest speed c of the ring at omega_r: beta = 3 ln(1 / R) c / (2 omega_r w); oblique and slower waves are absorbed more in depth, less at grazing incidence. A very small R makes the profile steep, which the discretisation reflects instead: 1e-4 to 1e-8 typical.
- `pml_frequency` [Hz] (> 0; nullable) - PML reference frequency
  omega_r / (2 pi), fixed for the study (the resonance pencil stays linear in omega^2). Empty: target_frequency (eigenfrequency) or the first frequency solved (frequency_response: put the lowest first for the strongest absorption over the sweep).
- `periodic_x`, `periodic_y` (bool; default false) - Periodic x / Periodic y
  Triangle mesh, eigenfrequency study only: the lo / hi faces of this axis are one Bloch pair, w(hi) = w(lo) exp(-j bloch_k L) (L the window size along the axis); the mesher matches their nodes (no PML ring there). The modes of the reduced pencil P^H K P, P^H M P (complex Hermitian; real when every k L is a multiple of pi) are complex (w_re / w_im / w_abs). With bending the seam slope jump is penalised like any interior edge. Clamps, supports, line forces and ports stay off periodic faces; with every bloch_k 0 a cell without a clamp has a 0 Hz mode: set target_frequency > 0.
- `bloch_kx` [rad/m] (default 0; visible when periodic_x in (true)) - Bloch wave vector x
  Used only with periodic_x: phase step exp(-j k L) per period L; k and k + 2 pi / L are the same state; 0 = plain periodic. Swept by a parameter, one eigenfrequency study per k gives the band diagram (a strip clamped on two faces and periodic along the third: the guide dispersion f_n(k)). Typical: pi / L at the zone edge.
- `bloch_ky` [rad/m] (default 0; visible when periodic_y in (true)) - Bloch wave vector y
  Used only with periodic_y: phase step exp(-j k L) per period L; k and k + 2 pi / L are the same state; 0 = plain periodic. Swept by a parameter, one eigenfrequency study per k gives the band diagram (a strip clamped on two faces and periodic along the third: the guide dispersion f_n(k)). Typical: pi / L at the zone edge.

### Material properties (MaterialSpec.properties)

- `tension` [N/m] (nullable; writes tension_xx, tension_yy) - Tension
  Isotropic film tension = film stress x thickness (e.g. 1 GPa x 50 nm silicon nitride = 50 N/m); the coupled tension slots add to it. Wave speed c = sqrt(T / areal_density). An element with no tension and no areal_density is a hole (not solved, its outline a free edge). Compressive (negative) values give no restoring force: resonances with Re omega <= 0 are dropped.
- `tension_xx` [N/m] (nullable) - Tension xx
  N_xx; overrides tension along x (an anisotropic or coupled prestress).
- `tension_yy` [N/m] (nullable) - Tension yy
  N_yy; overrides tension along y. 1D models: the tension along the guide, read only by the axial_wavenumber term.
- `tension_xy` [N/m] (nullable) - Tension xy
  Shear N_xy (unset = 0, array allocated only when set); [[N_xx, N_xy], [N_xy, N_yy]] should be positive definite. Ignored in 1D models.
- `areal_density` [kg/m^2] (>= 0; nullable) - Areal density
  rho_s = rho h (e.g. 3100 kg/m^3 x 50 nm silicon nitride = 1.55e-4). Unset = 0: with no tension either the element is a hole.
- `loss_factor` [1] (>= 0; nullable) - Loss factor
  Structural loss eta: T becomes T (1 + j eta), so Q = 1 / eta (exactly Re s / (2 Im s), s = sqrt(1 + j eta)). Unset = 0 (array allocated only when set). Typical 1e-6 to 1e-3.
- `bending_stiffness` [N m] (>= 0; nullable) - Bending stiffness
  D = E h^3 / (12 (1 - nu^2)) (e.g. 250 GPa, 80 nm, nu 0.23: 1.13e-11 N m), adding D (1 + j eta) del^4 w (a tensioned Kirchhoff plate). Set in any material (0 included), it switches the whole physics to plate elements: Hermite cubic lines in 1D, on triangles the C0 interior penalty form (discretization quadratic; a PML stretches it too; ports take numeric plate strip modes; mode_projection is refused). Then clamped also holds dw/dn = 0, simply_supported and antisymmetry hold w only, symmetry the slope only. The clamped boundary layer sqrt(D / T) (0.38 um for the example at 80 N/m) must be resolved near clamps; even unresolved it moves a clamped wall inward by sqrt(D / T), so a tiny D is no film limit there (D = 1e-12 N m at 80 N/m lowered the transmission through a 44 um barrier near cut-off by 17 %).
- `plate_poisson_ratio` [1] (nullable) - Plate Poisson ratio
  nu of the bending moments M = D [(1 - nu) H(w) + nu tr H(w) I] (triangles; unset = 0): it changes only free and simply supported plate edges; D already holds its 1 / (1 - nu^2). 1D models ignore it (exact for clamped and simply supported ends). Must lie in (-1, 0.5].

### Fields

Output fields (primary w_re; [state] = also a state field):
- `w_re` - Out-of-plane displacement (real part) (m) [state]
- `w_im` - Out-of-plane displacement (imaginary part) (m) [state]
- `w_abs` - Out-of-plane displacement amplitude (m) [state]
- `w_phase` - Out-of-plane displacement phase (rad)
- `tension_xx` - Tension xx (N/m)
- `tension_yy` - Tension yy (N/m)
- `tension_xy` - Tension xy (N/m)
- `areal_density` - Areal density (kg/m^2)

### Source slots

- `coupled_tension_xx` (N/m): Coupled tension N_xx per element (1D: per cell), e.g. the relaxed prestress h sigma_xx of a solid; added to tension_xx, replaced by each transfer.
- `coupled_tension_yy` (N/m): Coupled tension N_yy, as coupled_tension_xx.
- `coupled_tension_xy` (N/m): Coupled shear tension N_xy, as coupled_tension_xx (ignored in 1D models).

### Feature `membrane.clamped` - Clamped

w = 0 on the selected outer faces (window edge) and object outlines (triangles; 1D: the ends x_lo / x_hi); with a bending_stiffness also dw/dn = 0 (1D: w' = 0; triangles: weakly, Nitsche, on each side of an outline). Unheld edges are free (zero transverse force and moment). A clamp beats a line force on the same face; not on a periodic face. Line objects: clamped_line.

- Category boundary_condition; selection boundary entities, at least 1, outer faces and object perimeters; mesh kinds tensor, triangles; result none

Params: none

### Feature `membrane.clamped_line` - Clamped line

w = 0 on the mesh edges of the selected line objects (any direction, the part inside the window; the mesher puts element edges on them); with a bending_stiffness also dw/dn = 0 weakly on each side. The sides stay one membrane otherwise: a line across a strip splits it into two clamped strips. Validation warns for a line end on a periodic side (unless the line spans the period: its image must be held too) and for a line reaching beyond the window.

- Category boundary_condition; selection line entities, object kinds line, at least 1; mesh kinds triangles; result none

Params: none

### Feature `membrane.simply_supported_line` - Simply supported line

w = 0 on the selected line objects (as clamped_line), the slope free: with a bending_stiffness it stays continuous across the line (a line support of a continuous plate). Without bending_stiffness the same as clamped_line.

- Category boundary_condition; selection line entities, object kinds line, at least 1; mesh kinds triangles; result none

Params: none

### Feature `membrane.simply_supported` - Simply supported

w = 0 on the selected outer faces and object outlines (1D: the ends), the slope free (M_nn = 0 with plate_poisson_ratio). Without bending_stiffness the same as clamped. Not on a periodic face. Line objects: simply_supported_line.

- Category boundary_condition; selection boundary entities, at least 1, outer faces and object perimeters; mesh kinds tensor, triangles; result none

Params: none

### Feature `membrane.symmetry` - Symmetry

Even mirror plane, w(mirrored) = w. Film: a free edge (T dw/dn = 0; needs tension_xy = 0 there, a mirrored shear tension changes sign). With a bending_stiffness: dw/dn = 0 (1D: w' = 0; triangles: weakly, Nitsche) with w free and zero transverse shear. On outer faces (1D: x_lo / x_hi) and straight object outlines; not on a PML or periodic face. A face also held by clamped / simply_supported / antisymmetry is held (warning). This run gives the even modes, a second with antisymmetry the odd ones. A port or mode_projection guide ending here takes the wall as free (half-guide profiles). Its outer faces are model mirror planes: fields unfold w even across them, integrals touching them count twice, and the study setting parity_sectors swaps symmetry / antisymmetry on them per sector run.

- Category boundary_condition; selection boundary entities, at least 1, outer faces and object perimeters; mesh kinds tensor, triangles; result none

Params: none

### Feature `membrane.antisymmetry` - Antisymmetry

Odd mirror plane, w(mirrored) = -w: the hold of simply_supported (w = 0, slope free). On outer faces (1D: x_lo / x_hi) and straight object outlines; not on a PML or periodic face. Its outer faces are model mirror planes: fields unfold w odd across them, integrals touching them count twice, parity_sectors swaps the feature per sector run. A squeeze_film_damping film vents on its faces (odd pressure).

- Category boundary_condition; selection boundary entities, at least 1, outer faces and object perimeters; mesh kinds tensor, triangles; result none

Params: none

### Feature `membrane.pressure_load` - Pressure load

p e^(j phase) on the selected elements (1D: cells), int p v dA; frequency_response only.

- Category source; selection domain entities, at least 1; mesh kinds tensor, triangles; result none

Params:
- `pressure` [Pa] (default 1; may use x, y) - Pressure amplitude
  Positive along +w; the PML ring takes none.
- `phase` [deg] (default 0) - Phase
  Drive phase (exp(+j omega t)).

### Feature `membrane.line_force` - Line force

F e^(j phase) along the selected outer faces (window edge) and object outlines (both sides of an interior outline share it); 1D: at its ends, per unit length along y. frequency_response only; not on a PML face.

- Category source; selection boundary entities, at least 1, outer faces and object perimeters; mesh kinds tensor, triangles; result none

Params:
- `force` [N/m] (default 1) - Force per length
  Positive along +w. Several on one face add; on a clamped face it does nothing.
- `phase` [deg] (default 0) - Phase
  Drive phase (exp(+j omega t)).

### Feature `membrane.point_force` - Point force

F e^(j phase) at each selected point (exact delta load of the element holding it); 1D: a line across the strip. frequency_response only.

- Category source; selection point entities, object kinds point, at least 1; mesh kinds tensor, triangles; result none

Params:
- `force` [N] (default 1e-06) - Force
  Positive along +w; 1D models: per unit length along y (N/m).
- `phase` [deg] (default 0) - Phase
  Drive phase (exp(+j omega t)).

### Feature `membrane.field_probe` - Displacement probe

Complex w at the point (triangles: its mesh node; 1D: x on the line) vs frequency [Hz]: series w_re, w_im, w_abs [m], w_phase [rad] (a repeated frequency replaces its sample); a two_wave_fit pairs w_re with w_im, a lorentz_fit of w_abs*w_abs gives Q. frequency_response only.

- Category probe; selection point entities, object kinds point, exactly 1; mesh kinds tensor, triangles; result kind `xy`

Params: none

### Feature `membrane.resonance_table` - Resonance table

Resonances of the last eigenfrequency solve, nearest target_frequency first: columns resonance_number, frequency [Hz], frequency_imag [Hz, > 0 decays], q_factor (inf when lossless), pml_fraction (energy share in the PML); extras target_frequency, selected_resonance. Frequency vs a parameter: a derived value with source '<physics>.<this feature>', expression frequency, operation at, at = 0. With squeeze_film_damping features it appends gas_damping, gas_stiffness, gamma_gas, q_gas: the totals over the enabled films.

- Category monitor; selection none (a selection is ignored with a warning); mesh kinds tensor, triangles; result kind `table`

Params: none

### Feature `membrane.squeeze_film_damping` - Squeeze-film damping

Gas damping of a thin film (gap H) between the selected domains (the footprint) and a fixed parallel wall, per resonance after the eigenfrequency solve (the modes are unchanged, a frequency_response is not damped by it; c and k are quadratic in w, so the side of the wall does not matter). Per mode the linearised compressible Reynolds equation div(H^3 / (12 mu_eff) grad p) - j omega (H / p_a) p = j omega w is solved on the footprint elements (holes excluded) with the membrane's own elements and order, w the mode shape (peak 1 m), p = 0 on vented edges, no flux on sealed ones. Columns per mode: resonance_number, frequency [Hz], effective_mass [kg], gas_damping c = -Re F [kg/s] and gas_stiffness k = omega Im F [N/m] of the modal gas force F = int p conj(w) dA per unit modal velocity (both scale with the square of the shape normalisation), gamma_gas = c / m_eff [1/s] (energy decay rate = linewidth in rad/s) and q_gas = omega m_eff / c, m_eff = int rho_s |w|^2 dA (gamma_gas and q_gas independent of the normalisation); extras area [m^2], gap [m], film_elements, vent_edges. Complex modes (PML, loss) use Re omega and m_eff = Re(w^H M w). On a half model (mirror faces) c, k and m_eff are those of the drawn part, not doubled (gamma_gas and q_gas are unchanged). Refused: Bloch cells, a footprint reaching a PML ring (build error), 1D models.

- Category monitor; selection domain entities, at least 1; mesh kinds triangles; result kind `table`

Params:
- `gap` [m] (default 2e-06; > 0) - Gap height
  Uniform gas gap H to the fixed facing wall, << the footprint (MEMS 0.5-10 um); damping ~ 1 / H^3.
- `viscosity` [Pa s] (default 1.81e-05; > 0) - Gas viscosity
  Dynamic viscosity mu (air at 20 C: 1.81e-5), pressure-independent; slip reduces it to mu_eff.
- `ambient_pressure` [Pa] (default 101325; >= 0) - Ambient pressure. Help: shared `membrane.squeeze_film_damping.ambient_pressure`
- `slip` (default "veijola"; none | veijola) - Gas slip
  veijola: mu_eff = mu / (1 + 9.638 Kn^1.159), Kn = mean_free_path / gap (Veijola 1995, Kn <= 880, ~5 %); none: mu_eff = mu (continuum, Kn << 0.01).
- `mean_free_path` [m] (default 6.8e-08; >= 0; visible when slip in (veijola)) - Mean free path
  At the ambient pressure, ~1 / p_a (air: 68e-9 at 101325 Pa, 6.8e-6 at 1013 Pa).
- `vents` (default "open_edges"; open_edges | all | none) - Vented edges
  Footprint edges venting to the ambient (p = 0; the others sealed, no flux). open_edges: free edges, hole outlines, footprint edges inside the membrane and antisymmetry faces (odd pressure) vent; window edges of clamped / simply_supported / symmetry faces, symmetry outlines and held edges with membrane on both sides (clamped_line / simply_supported_line, held object outlines inside the film) are sealed (a clamped outline with a hole outside vents as a hole outline). all: every footprint edge; none: a closed film (needs ambient_pressure > 0: a trapped gas spring). Holes vent without perforation flow resistance.

### Feature `membrane.port` - Port

Exact semi-infinite termination of a straight clamped strip guide on one outer face (frequency_response only; not ringed by a PML). Film: the analytic profiles phi_n = sin(n pi s / W) (s from the first wall, W the span of membrane elements on the face) with beta_n^2 = (rho_s omega^2 - T_ss (n pi / W)^2) / T_nn, Im beta <= 0, give the Dirichlet-to-Neumann term sum_n j beta_n T_nn (2 / W) (int phi_n w)(int phi_n v); incident_mode m > 0 adds the load of A phi_m entering. The guide must be uniform at the face (density and loss to 1e-6, tension and tension_xy to tension_tolerance; the mean tension of the port elements is used). A guide wall on a window face with the symmetry feature (and no hold) is free: phi_n = sin(k_n s) (free at s = W) or cos(k_n s) (free at s = 0), k_n = (n - 1/2) pi / W, the modes 2n - 1 of the unfolded guide of width 2 W; symmetry on both walls is refused. With a mirror (symmetry / antisymmetry) wall, incident modes are numbered on the unfolded guide and powers are those of the unfolded guide (x 2 per mirror wall; fractions unchanged). Result 'xy' vs frequency [Hz]: per mode the outgoing b_n = a_n - A delta_nm at the face (mode_<n>_re / _im / _abs [m], _phase [rad]), power_<n> = W omega Re(T_nn beta_n) |b_n|^2 / 4 [W], power_fraction_<n> = power_<n> / incident_power (the incident power of every port; NaN without one), incident_power [W] and port_incident_power (this port's own) [W]; lossless, the outgoing powers of all ports sum to the incident power. Extras: tension_spread, tension_tolerance, medium_warning ('' unless a spread above 1e-6 was accepted), free_walls ([at s = 0, at s = W]; None before a solve), mirror_walls (+1 symmetry, -1 antisymmetry, None per wall), sector_modes / sector_signs (unfolded number and sign of each half mode: symmetry wall 2k - 1, antisymmetry wall 2k, signed (-1)^(k-1) / (-1)^k with the wall at s = 0) and sector_drive_scale, for the parity_sectors combination (Results.sector_result(..., combined=True): unfolded modes, recomputed powers and fractions). Plate port (bending_stiffness > 0 at the port elements, D and plate_poisson_ratio uniform to 1e-6): the guide modes per frequency from a Hermite cubic strip on the port's edge nodes (walls from the holds: clamped face / outline w and dw/ds, simply_supported / antisymmetry w, symmetry dw/ds, an unheld face or hole outline free), the quadratic eigenproblem in beta^2 solved densely, Im beta <= 0, numbered by cut-off (Re beta^2 descending), peak |w| 1 with the first lobe positive; all are absorbed by the exact strip Dirichlet-to-Neumann map (V_n against w, M_nn against dw/dn) on every quadratic dof of the port elements; power_<n> = (omega / 2) Im(V_n conj(w) + M_n conj(dw/dn)) (lossless: exact balance). Extras plate_walls (None for a film port); sector_modes / sector_signs None (a plate port on a guide ending on a mirror face is refused under parity_sectors); mirror walls still double the powers.

- Category boundary_condition; selection boundary entities, exactly 1, outer faces only; mesh kinds triangles; result kind `xy`

Params:
- `mode_count` [1] (int; default 10; [1, 200]) - Modes
  Strip modes phi_n the port absorbs exactly (propagating and evanescent; see the description); higher modes see a free edge, so keep the port where their near field has decayed (exp(-n pi d / W)) or raise the count. A plate port absorbs every numeric strip mode (two per free strip dof); there mode_count is the number reported and allowed as incident modes (by cut-off: propagating first, then by decay; the bending-dominated evanescent family comes late) and must cover the propagating modes for the power balance.
- `incident_mode` [1] (int; default 0; [0, 400]) - Incident mode
  Mode m sent in (0 = none: the port only absorbs). On a guide with a symmetry / antisymmetry wall, m counts on the unfolded (full-width) guide: a symmetry wall admits odd m (half mode (m + 1) / 2), an antisymmetry wall even m (half mode m / 2); the other parity is a build error unless the study runs parity_sectors. A plate port numbers its modes on the drawn guide (by cut-off), also on a half guide.
- `amplitude` [m] (default 1e-09) - Incident amplitude
  A of the incident w profile A phi_m(s) at the port face.
- `phase` [deg] (default 0) - Phase
  Drive phase (exp(+j omega t)).
- `incident_modes` [1] (float_list; >= 1; nullable) - Incident modes
  Several incident modes (whole numbers, numbered as incident_mode); non-empty, it replaces incident_mode. Both parities about a mirror wall (e.g. 1 and 2 on a half guide) need parity_sectors.
- `incident_amplitudes` [m] (float_list; nullable) - Incident amplitudes
  Per entry of incident_modes (empty: amplitude for each).
- `incident_phases` [deg] (float_list; nullable) - Incident phases
  Per entry of incident_modes (empty: phase for each).
- `sector_drive` (bool; default false) - Parity-sector drive
  Set by the study setting parity_sectors on its sector copies (leave it off): an incident mode of a guide ending on a mirror face is driven at 2 A in the sector of its parity, not at all in the other (sector mean A).
- `tension_tolerance` [1] (default 1e-06; (0, 1]) - Tension tolerance
  Largest accepted relative tension variation along the port cut (spread of T_nn and T_ss over the face elements, |tension_xy| / T_nn); above it the first solve fails to build. Raise it (e.g. 1e-2) for a tension from a solid (solid_membrane_tension): the port uses the mean tension of its cut, a spread above 1e-06 gives a RuntimeWarning and the extras tension_spread / medium_warning, and the port reflects at about the level of the spread. Areal density and loss factor must stay uniform to 1e-06.

### Feature `membrane.mode_projection` - Mode projection

a_n(p) = (2 / W) int w(p, s) sin(n pi (s - cross_start) / W) ds at points positions p from start to end along guide_axis, s across from cross_start to cross_end (W their distance; a wall on a symmetry face is free: the port's half-guide profiles, extra free_walls); composite Gauss, sample points located once at build (a point outside the mesh is a build error). Result 'xy' vs position [m] of the shown solution (resonance or last frequency): mode_<n>_re / _im / _abs [m], _phase [rad]; a two_wave_fit or two_exp_fit of mode_1_re gives beta or kappa. A frequency_response run also records a_n(p) at every frequency (whatever the snapshots setting; host 16 B x points x mode_count per frequency): extras frequencies [Hz] (ascending, a repeated frequency replaces its row) and frequency_series {mode_<n>_re / _im / _abs / _phase: (n_frequencies, points) array} (results.npz result/<physics>.<feature>/frequency_series/<name>). result_axis 'frequency': result 'xy' vs those frequencies: mode_<n>_power = the mean of |a_n|^2 over the sampled positions in average_start .. average_end [m^2] (insensitive to standing-wave ripple), mode_<n>_rms its root [m], total_power the sum [m^2]; extras average_window [m], average_points, averaged_series {mode_<n>_re / _im: (n_frequencies, averaged points)}; an error before a frequency_response run. Output / input ratio: a derived curve dividing the mode_<n>_power of two projections. Extras mirror_walls / sector_modes / sector_signs as the port. Refused with bending_stiffness (plate guide modes are numeric: use ports or field probes).

- Category monitor; selection none (a selection is ignored with a warning); mesh kinds triangles; result kind `xy`

Params:
- `guide_axis` (default "y"; x | y) - Guide direction
  Axis the guide runs along; the projection integrates across the other axis.
- `cross_start` [m] (nullable) - Guide wall start
  First guide wall across the guide (empty: the window edge).
- `cross_end` [m] (nullable) - Guide wall end
  Second guide wall (empty: the window edge); W = cross_end - cross_start.
- `start` [m] (nullable) - First position
  First sampled position along the guide (empty: the window edge).
- `end` [m] (nullable) - Last position
  Last sampled position (empty: the window edge).
- `points` [1] (int; default 101; [2, 100000]) - Positions
  Equally spaced positions from start to end.
- `mode_count` [1] (int; default 3; [1, 200]) - Modes
  Profiles phi_n, n = 1 .. mode_count (a wall on a symmetry face: sin / cos((n - 1/2) pi (s - cross_start) / W)).
- `result_axis` (default "position"; position | frequency) - Result versus
  'position': a_n(p) of the shown solution vs position. 'frequency' (frequency_response only): the guide-averaged mode powers vs frequency (see the description).
- `average_start` [m] (nullable; visible when result_axis in (frequency)) - Averaging start
  First position of the averaging window (empty: start).
- `average_end` [m] (nullable; visible when result_axis in (frequency)) - Averaging end
  Last position of the averaging window (empty: end); a build error when no sampled position lies inside.

## Physics type `pressure_acoustics` - Pressure Acoustics, frequency domain

Frequency-domain pressure acoustics: -div(grad p / rho) - omega^2 p / (rho c^2) = j omega q (exp(+j omega t), peak amplitudes), p the complex pressure, rho / c the material rho and sound_speed (every fluid element needs both > 0; no losses but impedance and PML). Complex Lagrange P2 / P1 on triangles (planar or axisymmetric) or tetrahedra (3D). K and M are assembled once; each frequency is one complex symmetric factorisation by the linear role (back_end 'auto': cudss_mixed on the gpu backend when nvmath-python is installed, else host SuperLU; MUMPS / PARDISO opt-in). Outer faces default to sound hard (also mirror planes); boundary features act on the window edge of outer faces and on object outlines (2D) / interfaces (3D). Probe and surface series per frequency are complex: <c>_re / _im / _abs / _phase. v_* = j grad p / (omega rho) per element. Snapshots per frequency are labelled "f = <Hz> Hz".

- Default instance name `pressure_acoustics`; studies frequency_response (default {"type": "frequency_response", "settings": {"frequency_start": 100, "frequency_stop": 1000, "n_frequencies": 10}})
- Backends gpu, cpu; mesh kinds triangles, tetrahedra; refinement indicator fields p_abs; dispersion poles not used
- Features: background_pressure_field, rigid_obstacle, sound_hard, sound_soft, prescribed_pressure, impedance, vibrating_boundary, point_source, frequency_probe, surface_pressure

### Settings (PhysicsSpec.settings)

- `geometry` (default "planar"; planar | axisymmetric) - Geometry
  planar: a fluid uniform along z; point sources are line sources, surface results per metre of depth. axisymmetric (x = r, y = z; spec notes): azimuthal order 0; surface means are area-weighted, weighted integrals cover the whole ring; no PML on x_lo. 2D models only (validation errors on axisymmetric in 3D). x_lo is the axis (a boundary condition there does nothing; validation warns).
- `discretization` (default "quadratic"; quadratic | linear) - Discretization. Help: shared `electric_currents.discretization`
- `pml_x_lo`, `pml_x_hi`, `pml_y_lo`, `pml_y_hi`, `pml_z_lo`, `pml_z_hi` (bool; default false) - Absorbing layer beyond the left edge / Absorbing layer beyond the right edge / Absorbing layer beyond the bottom edge / Absorbing layer beyond the top edge / Absorbing layer beyond the lower z face / Absorbing layer beyond the upper z face
  Perfectly matched layer beyond this face: the mesh grows pml_cells x the mesh dx (h_max) there (triangles: pml_layers structured element layers; tetrahedra: a shell), material continued from the window edge, fixed complex stretch s = 1 - j beta (d / w)^2 (d the depth, w the thickness), beta from pml_reflection for the fastest sound speed in the layer at pml_frequency; outer side held at p = 0. Higher frequencies and slower waves are absorbed more. No boundary feature may select the face (the layer's inner side); z faces in 3D only; not on x_lo with geometry axisymmetric. Another physics on the same mesh must not request layers on other faces (the run fails).
- `pml_cells` [1] (int; default 8; [1, 100]) - Absorbing layer thickness
  In element sizes (x the mesh dx, h_max); about half a wavelength or more at the lowest frequency, 6-12 typical. Triangles: MeshSpec pml_layers sets the element layers across it.
- `pml_reflection` [1] (default 1e-06; (0, 0.5]) - Absorbing layer reflection
  Theoretical round-trip normal-incidence reflection R at pml_frequency for the fastest sound speed c of the layer: beta = 3 ln(1 / R) c / (2 omega w). A very small R makes the profile steep, which the elements reflect instead: 1e-3 to 1e-8 typical.
- `pml_frequency` [Hz] (> 0; nullable) - Absorbing layer frequency
  Where pml_reflection holds (the stretch is frequency-independent: K and M are assembled once); empty = the lowest study frequency (absorption only grows above it).

### Material properties (MaterialSpec.properties)

- `rho` [kg/m^3] (>= 0; nullable) - Density. Help: shared `elastic_waves.rho`
- `sound_speed` [m/s] (>= 0; nullable) - Sound speed (longitudinal). Help: shared `elastic_waves.sound_speed`

### Fields

Output fields (primary p_abs; [state] = also a state field):
- `p_abs` - Pressure amplitude (Pa) [state]
- `p_re` - Pressure, real part (Pa) [state]
- `p_im` - Pressure, imaginary part (Pa) [state]
- `spl` - Sound pressure level (dB)
- `p_s_abs` - Scattered pressure amplitude (Pa)
- `p_s_re` - Scattered pressure, real part (Pa)
- `p_s_im` - Scattered pressure, imaginary part (Pa)
- `v_abs` - Particle velocity amplitude (m/s)
- `v_x_re` - Particle velocity x (axisymmetric: r), real part (m/s)
- `v_x_im` - Particle velocity x (axisymmetric: r), imaginary part (m/s)
- `v_y_re` - Particle velocity y (axisymmetric: z), real part (m/s)
- `v_y_im` - Particle velocity y (axisymmetric: z), imaginary part (m/s)
- `v_z_re` - Particle velocity z (3D), real part (m/s)
- `v_z_im` - Particle velocity z (3D), imaginary part (m/s)
- `rho` - Density (kg/m^3)
- `sound_speed` - Sound speed (m/s)

### Source slots

- none

### Feature `pressure_acoustics.background_pressure_field` - Background pressure field

Scattered-field formulation: the unknown is p_s, total p = p_s + p_b in the window (a PML absorbs p_s only). p_b is assumed to solve the background medium exactly, so the source is only where the model differs: elements of other material (the contrast), rigid_obstacle outlines (n . grad p_s = -n . grad p_b), outer faces (every non-PML face is a total-field condition: 0 for a symmetry plane of p_b, e.g. the floor of a standing wave) and total-field impedance / held values (p_s = given - p_b). One per physics (the last wins). Probes and surface results add p_b exactly; p_* fields hold the nodal p_s + p_b, p_s_* the scattered part.

- Category domain_condition; selection none (a selection is ignored with a warning); mesh kinds triangles, tetrahedra; result none

Params:
- `wave` (default "plane_wave"; plane_wave | standing_wave | expression) - Background wave
  plane_wave: p_b = p0 exp(-j k d . x) along the unit direction d, k = 2 pi f / background_sound_speed; standing_wave: that wave reflected by a rigid plane normal to an axis direction, p_b = 2 p0 cos(k (u - plane_position)), u the coordinate along that axis (a floor: direction -y, plane_position 0 gives 2 p0 cos(k y)); expression: p_b = pressure_re + j pressure_im, the same at every frequency (sweep a parameter for a frequency-dependent one; its gradient on outer faces by central differences).
- `amplitude` [Pa] (default 1; visible when wave in (plane_wave, standing_wave)) - Amplitude
  Peak pressure p0 of the incident wave (a standing wave peaks at 2 p0).
- `phase` [deg] (default 0; visible when wave in (plane_wave, standing_wave)) - Phase
  Phase of p0: of the plane wave at the origin, of the standing wave everywhere.
- `direction` (default "-y"; +x | -x | +y | -y | +z | -z | custom; visible when wave in (plane_wave, standing_wave)) - Direction of travel
  Propagation direction d: an axis, or custom = (direction_x, direction_y, direction_z) normalised (plane_wave only). +z / -z need a 3D model; geometry axisymmetric: +y or -y only.
- `direction_x` [1] (default 0; visible when direction in (custom)) - Direction x
  Component of the custom direction (normalised; direction_z must be 0 in 2D).
- `direction_y` [1] (default -1; visible when direction in (custom)) - Direction y
  Component of the custom direction (normalised; direction_z must be 0 in 2D).
- `direction_z` [1] (default 0; visible when direction in (custom)) - Direction z
  Component of the custom direction (normalised; direction_z must be 0 in 2D).
- `plane_position` [m] (default 0; visible when wave in (standing_wave)) - Rigid plane position
  Coordinate of the rigid plane along the direction axis (y = plane_position for +y / -y).
- `pressure_re` [Pa] (default 0; may use x, y; visible when wave in (expression)) - Pressure, real part
  Real part of p_b (also z in 3D); it should solve the Helmholtz equation of the background medium, else the mismatch radiates.
- `pressure_im` [Pa] (default 0; may use x, y; visible when wave in (expression)) - Pressure, imaginary part
  Imaginary part of p_b (phasors exp(+j omega t)), as pressure_re.
- `background_density` [kg/m^3] (default 1.2; > 0) - Background density
  Density rho_b of the medium p_b travels in; elements whose 1 / rho or 1 / (rho c^2) differ from the background by more than 1e-6 (relative) are scatterers (the contrast source).
- `background_sound_speed` [m/s] (default 343; > 0) - Background sound speed
  c_b: sets k = 2 pi f / c_b of p_b and, with background_density, the medium the contrast is taken against. Air 343, water 1480.

### Feature `pressure_acoustics.rigid_obstacle` - Rigid obstacle

The selected elements are left out of the solve (fields 0 there); their outline is sound hard (n . grad p = 0 for the total field). For solids and thin plates (no structural back-action).

- Category domain_condition; selection domain entities, at least 1; mesh kinds triangles, tetrahedra; result none

Params: none

### Feature `pressure_acoustics.sound_hard` - Sound hard wall

n . grad p = 0 (total field): the default of every outer face without a PML or other condition, also a mirror plane. A later feature on the same face wins, so this resets an earlier one.

- Category boundary_condition; selection boundary entities, at least 1, outer faces only; mesh kinds triangles, tetrahedra; result none

Params: none

### Feature `pressure_acoustics.sound_soft` - Sound soft boundary

p = 0 (total field; with a background p_s = -p_b). The later held value wins shared nodes.

- Category boundary_condition; selection boundary entities, at least 1, outer faces and object perimeters; mesh kinds triangles, tetrahedra; result none

Params: none

### Feature `pressure_acoustics.prescribed_pressure` - Pressure

p = pressure exp(j phase) (total field); along a PML side the wall stays sound hard. The later held value wins shared nodes.

- Category boundary_condition; selection boundary entities, at least 1, outer faces and object perimeters; mesh kinds triangles, tetrahedra; result none

Params:
- `pressure` [Pa] (default 1; may use x, y) - Pressure amplitude
  Total pressure held (with a background: p_s = this - p_b); also z in 3D.
- `phase` [deg] (default 0) - Phase
  Phase of the held pressure (phasors exp(+j omega t)).

### Feature `pressure_acoustics.impedance` - Impedance

Robin condition n_out . grad p / rho = -j omega p / Z on the total field.

- Category boundary_condition; selection boundary entities, at least 1, outer faces and object perimeters; mesh kinds triangles, tetrahedra; result none

Params:
- `impedance` [Pa s/m] (> 0; nullable) - Acoustic impedance
  Specific impedance Z = p / v_n (v_n out of the fluid), real; empty = rho c of the adjacent fluid element, the first-order absorber (no reflection at normal incidence, growing with the angle). Air 413, water 1.48e6.

### Feature `pressure_acoustics.vibrating_boundary` - Vibrating wall

Inward normal motion as a load: n_out . grad p / rho = j omega v_in (velocity), = a_in (acceleration), = -omega^2 d_in (displacement); the wall is sound hard otherwise.

- Category boundary_condition; selection boundary entities, at least 1, outer faces and object perimeters; mesh kinds triangles, tetrahedra; result none

Params:
- `quantity` (default "velocity"; acceleration | velocity | displacement) - Given quantity
  Normal motion given, positive into the fluid: velocity v, acceleration a = j omega v or displacement d = v / (j omega).
- `velocity` [m/s] (default 0.001; may use x, y; visible when quantity in (velocity)) - Normal velocity amplitude
  Into the fluid; also z in 3D.
- `acceleration` [m/s^2] (default 1; may use x, y; visible when quantity in (acceleration)) - Normal acceleration amplitude
  Into the fluid; also z in 3D.
- `displacement` [m] (default 1e-09; may use x, y; visible when quantity in (displacement)) - Normal displacement amplitude
  Into the fluid; also z in 3D.
- `phase` [deg] (default 0) - Phase
  Phase of the wall motion (phasors exp(+j omega t)).

### Feature `pressure_acoustics.point_source` - Point source

Monopole Q exp(j phase): the load j omega Q phi_i(x0) (axisymmetric: divided by 2 pi, the per-radian solve). Must lie in a fluid element.

- Category source; selection point entities, object kinds point, exactly 1; mesh kinds triangles, tetrahedra; result none

Params:
- `flow_rate` [m^3/s, m^2/s planar] (default 1e-06) - Volume flow rate
  Peak Q; 3D free field p = j omega rho Q exp(-j k r) / (4 pi r). Planar: per metre of depth (a line source); axisymmetric: a point on the axis, else a ring of total rate Q.
- `phase` [deg] (default 0) - Phase
  Phase of the flow rate (phasors exp(+j omega t)).

### Feature `pressure_acoustics.frequency_probe` - Pressure probe

Complex pressure at the point vs frequency [Hz]: series p_re, p_im, p_abs, p_phase (total, p_b exact) and p_s_re ... (scattered; = p without a background) [Pa]; 0 in a rigid obstacle.

- Category probe; selection point entities, object kinds point, exactly 1; mesh kinds triangles, tetrahedra; result kind `xy`

Params: none

### Feature `pressure_acoustics.surface_pressure` - Surface pressure

Series vs frequency [Hz]: p_mean_re / _im / _abs / _phase = int p dA / int dA [Pa] and p_weighted_* = int p weight dA (Pa m^2; planar Pa m per metre of depth; axisymmetric whole rings) over the selected outer faces (window side) and object outlines / interfaces on side; extras area [m^2, planar m], weight_integral, side. p is continuous, so side picks faces, not a field side; p_b enters exactly. E.g. |<p_top> - <p_bottom>| / p_max by a derived curve of two features (side +y, -y).

- Category monitor; selection boundary entities, at least 1, outer faces and object perimeters; mesh kinds triangles, tetrahedra; result kind `xy`

Params:
- `side` (default "all"; all | +x | -x | +y | -y | +z | -z) - Side
  'all', or the selected pieces whose outward normal (out of the selected object; an outer face: out of the domain) has a positive component along the given axis, e.g. +y = the top face of a rectangle (axisymmetric: +y = +z). +z / -z need a 3D model.
- `weight` [1] (default 1; may use x, y) - Weight
  psi in int p psi dA (e.g. a mode shape expression); its unit multiplies p_weighted_*.

## Physics type `solid_mechanics` - Solid Mechanics (2D)

2D static linear elasticity, small strain: sigma = C (eps - alpha dT), C isotropic (youngs_modulus, poisson_ratio) or the c_ij entries (see c11), alpha per axis (alpha_xx / _yy / _zz), dT = temperature_rise (coupled, heat_solid_thermal_strain) + temperature_rise_ext (temperature_change features). Setting geometry: planar (setting out_of_plane: plane strain, plane stress, generalized plane strain) or axisymmetric (r, z); texts are written for plane strain. Forces and reactions per m of depth (N/m; see thickness). u_x, u_y (u_z) are the displacement [m], u_abs its magnitude; strain_xy the tensor shear strain (half the engineering strain); elastic_strain_* = strain - alpha dT (elastic_strain_zz = -alpha_zz dT); stress_zz the out-of-plane stress plane strain implies (nu (sigma_xx + sigma_yy) - E alpha_zz dT, in von_mises). Void cells (no youngs_modulus or c11 > 0) are not solved and output 0. Faces without a support or load are traction free; every solid region (cells joined through edges or corners) needs supports holding u_x, u_y and rotation, e.g. rollers on one x and one y face (validation checks the directions, the build each region). Tensor mesh: bilinear elements on the window cells, nodal displacement, outputs at the cell centres (u = mean of the 4 corners), edge-extended into an EM PML ring. Triangle mesh: Lagrange elements (setting discretization) on the elements with stiffness, sparse_direct; state() and coupled slots one value per element (centroid), displayed fields nodal (strain / stress node-averaged), the PML ring void unless an elastic PML. Only there: initial_stress_*, stress_stiffening, geometric_nonlinearity, Prescribed displacement (domain), damped modes (mechanical_loss_factor), free bodies at target_frequency > 0 and in frequency responses, frequency_probe, complex support reactions, pml_<face>, azimuthal_order, the energy densities; not there: piezoelectric (and admittance), guided modes, solid_em_strain_optic, optomechanics except axisymmetric with em_fdfd_bor optics. Studies: stationary (after the physics it reads); time_dependent quasi-static (re-solves when a material, support, load or coupled input changed; no inertia); eigenfrequency: undamped modes K u = omega^2 M u nearest target_frequency (consistent mass of rho, needed in every solid cell; supports held at 0, loads and thermal strain ignored without stress_stiffening), one snapshot per mode labelled "resonance k: f = <Hz> Hz", shape scaled to a peak node |u| of 1 m (no thermal part, no support reactions), listed by resonance_table; axial_wavenumber gives guided (2.5D) modes (dispersion branches of a waveguide); optomechanics: the same modes after an optical mode (em_modes, em_fdfd_ez, em_fdfd_hz, em_fdfd_bor) for optomechanical_coupling; frequency_response: (K (1 + j mechanical_loss_factor) - omega^2 M) u = f per frequency (loads, prescribed displacements and electrode voltages are phase-0 amplitudes; a temperature change or coupled temperature is static, never a drive, with stress_stiffening part of the prestress), one snapshot per frequency (real parts, u_abs = |u|). azimuthal_order m >= 1 (triangles, axisymmetric, isotropic, eigenfrequency): u_r = U_r cos(m phi), u_z = U_z cos(m phi), u_phi = U_phi sin(m phi), field u_z = U_phi, strain / stress the cos parts at phi = 0; the axis holds u_z = 0 and ties u_phi = -u_r at m = 1, holds all three at m >= 2; m = 1 keeps the sideways translation and tilt as rigid motions, m >= 2 none (supports optional); stress_stiffening takes the initial stress alone. strain_energy_density / kinetic_energy_density (triangles, J/m^3, not in state()): a static solve 1/2 sigma : eps_el (no initial stress) and 0, a shown mode or response the time averages 1/4 Re(sigma : eps_el*) and 1/4 rho omega^2 |u|^2 (azimuthal order: twice the phi mean, so ring integrals give totals); not physical in a PML ring. Bloch band diagrams: periodic_x / _y, template solid_bloch_band_diagram; on the tensor mesh also piezoelectric (an electrode grating of one IDT period gives the SAW stopband edges at the zone edge). A 3D model (size_z set) uses solid_mechanics_3d.

- Default instance name `solid`; studies stationary, time_dependent, eigenfrequency, optomechanics, frequency_response (default {"type": "stationary"})
- Backends gpu, cpu; mesh kinds tensor, triangles; refinement indicator fields u_abs; dispersion poles not used
- Features: fixed, roller, displacement, fixed_domain, prescribed_displacement_domain, boundary_load, segment_load, body_force, temperature_change, solid_probe, frequency_probe, resonance_table, thermoelastic_damping, optomechanical_coupling, electrode, electrode_domain, admittance

### Settings (PhysicsSpec.settings)

- `geometry` (default "planar"; planar | axisymmetric) - Geometry
  planar: a cross-section (out_of_plane sets the z condition), forces per m of depth (N/m). axisymmetric (x = r, y = z; spec notes): (r, z) deformation without torsion: u_r = u_x, u_z = u_y, hoop strain u_r / r, integrals weighted by 2 pi r, so operator, loads and reactions are whole rings: tractions and body forces keep their units (Pa, N/m^3), nodal forces and reactions are in N (a support's F_y = the axial force on its ring area, F_x = the integral of its radial traction, not a net force). _zz outputs are hoop components (stress_zz = sigma_theta theta, elastic_strain_zz = u_r / r - alpha_zz dT), _yy axial. Only u_z needs a support per solid region (the one rigid motion). out_of_plane unused; not with piezoelectric or axial_wavenumber; optomechanics only on triangles with em_fdfd_bor optics; eigenfrequency gives the torsion-free modes (m >= 1: azimuthal_order). x_lo is the axis (u_r = 0 is held there automatically; a support or load selecting x_lo acts on a line without area: validation warns).
- `azimuthal_order` (int; default 0; >= 0; visible when geometry in (axisymmetric)) - Azimuthal order. Help: shared `electric_currents.azimuthal_order`
- `out_of_plane` (default "plane_strain"; plane_strain | plane_stress | generalized_plane_strain; visible when geometry in (planar)) - Out-of-plane condition
  Planar geometry only. plane_strain: eps_zz = 0, a cross-section of a long structure with clamped ends; stress_zz = lambda (eps_xx + eps_yy) - beta_z dT holds eps_zz at 0 (overestimates the thermal stress of a waveguide with free ends). plane_stress: sigma_zz = 0, a thin plate in the drawing plane (top view of a film): reduced stiffness lambda -> 2 mu lambda / (lambda + 2 mu); eps_zz = (beta_z dT - lambda (eps_xx + eps_yy)) / (lambda + 2 mu) enters elastic_strain_zz = eps_zz - alpha_zz dT, stress_zz = 0; forces per m of thickness. generalized_plane_strain: eps_zz = e0 + e1 x + e2 y over the drawn cross-section, e0 set by axial_force (0 = free ends), e1 / e2 (setting bending) by bending_moment_x / _y: thermal stress of a long waveguide or fibre with free ends; superposition (one extra solve per free term and assembly), force and moment conditions exact; outputs stress_zz, elastic_strain_zz = eps_zz - alpha_zz dT. Piezoelectric, axial_wavenumber and optomechanics need plane_strain; eigenfrequency plane_strain or plane_stress.
- `thickness` [m] (>= 0; nullable; visible when geometry in (planar)) - Thickness
  Planar only: out-of-plane thickness d (a plate, or the length of a long part). Empty: everything per m of depth (reactions N/m). Set: support reactions in N and admittance Y in S for thickness d; the solution, tractions, body forces, axial_force (always the cross-section total), electrode charges (C/m) and the optomechanical length do not change. Plane stress: the film thickness.
- `axial_force` [N] (default 0; visible when out_of_plane in (generalized_plane_strain)) - Axial force
  Generalized plane strain: net force along +z on the drawn cross-section (integral of stress_zz over the solid cells; a mirrored model: of the drawn part). 0 = free ends; > 0 pulls.
- `bending` (default "xy"; xy | x | y | none; visible when out_of_plane in (generalized_plane_strain)) - Out-of-plane bending
  Generalized plane strain: free terms of eps_zz = e0 + e1 x + e2 y. xy: e1 and e2 (set by bending_moment_y / _x); x: e1 only; y: e2 only; none: uniform e0. A mirrored model (moments and force of the drawn part) holds the term across a mirror plane at 0: mirror on an x face: y; on a y face: x; on both: none. Each free term adds one solve per assembly.
- `bending_moment_x` [N m] (default 0; visible when out_of_plane in (generalized_plane_strain)) - Bending moment about x
  Generalized plane strain, bending xy or y: M_x = integral of y stress_zz dA over the drawn solid cells, about the drawing origin (x = y = 0); an axial force F through (x_F, y_F) gives M_x = y_F F.
- `bending_moment_y` [N m] (default 0; visible when out_of_plane in (generalized_plane_strain)) - Bending moment about y
  Generalized plane strain, bending xy or x: M_y = -(integral of x stress_zz dA) over the drawn solid cells, about the drawing origin (right-hand rule: a force F through (x_F, y_F) gives M_y = -x_F F).
- `target_frequency` [Hz] (default 0; >= 0) - Eigenfrequency target
  Eigenfrequency study: the modes nearest this frequency (shift-invert about (2 pi f)^2, moved 1e-4 above so a target on a resonance factors); 0 = the lowest (a strain-free motion then fails: check the supports). A target > 0 also allows a free body on triangles (no supports; axisymmetric: no held u_z) and a free periodic cell with every bloch_k 0 (both meshes): their rigid-body modes (f < 1e-4 x target) are dropped.
- `stress_stiffening` (bool; default false) - Stress stiffening. Help: shared `solid_mechanics.stress_stiffening`
- `geometric_nonlinearity` (bool; default false) - Geometric nonlinearity. Help: shared `solid_mechanics.geometric_nonlinearity`
- `load_steps` (int; default 1; >= 1; visible when geometric_nonlinearity in (true)) - Load steps. Help: shared `solid_mechanics.load_steps`
- `nonlinear_tolerance` [1] (default 1e-08; > 0; visible when geometric_nonlinearity in (true)) - Nonlinear tolerance. Help: shared `solid_mechanics.nonlinear_tolerance`
- `nonlinear_max_iterations` (int; default 25; >= 1; visible when geometric_nonlinearity in (true)) - Nonlinear iteration limit
  Geometric nonlinearity: Newton iterations per load step; then a warning, and the next step continues from the damped state.
- `tangent_update` (default "when_slow"; every_iteration | when_slow; visible when geometric_nonlinearity in (true)) - Tangent update. Help: shared `solid_mechanics.tangent_update`
- `axial_wavenumber` [rad/m] (>= 0; nullable) - Axial wavenumber
  Eigenfrequency study, tensor mesh. Empty: in-plane plane-strain modes (u_x, u_y). k_z: guided (2.5D) modes of a structure long along z, u ~ exp(i (k_z z - omega t)), all three components coupled (isotropic cells only: solved in the real form u_z -> -i u_z). Physical displacement (u_x cos phi, u_y cos phi, u_z sin phi), phi = k_z z - omega t: field u_z is the quadrature amplitude, strains / stresses the phi = 0 values (elastic_strain_zz = k_z u_z enters stress_* and von_mises; shears xz / yz not output). k_z > 0: no rigid motion, supports optional. k_z = 0: plane-strain plus antiplane (pure u_z) modes, which need u_z held on every solid region (Fixed and Fixed (domain) hold it, Roller and Displacement do not). Backward Brillouin: k_z = 2 beta = 4 pi n_eff / lambda (~2.5e7 rad/m, silicon wire at 1550 nm). Sweep it for a dispersion f(k_z). The optomechanics study refuses it (scattering backward sets k_z itself).
- `piezoelectric` (bool; default false) - Piezoelectric
  Tensor mesh, plane strain: a nodal potential phi (bilinear, every window node; void cells are dielectric) coupled through the piezo_e* arrays (solid cells), clamped permittivity eps0 eps_dc (every window cell, unset = 1): T = c S - e^T E, D = e S + eps E, E = -grad phi, div D = 0. Electrode features hold phi (connection voltage; at least one, the ground, except in a Bloch cell with bloch_k != 0) or float with a net charge; other outer faces are insulating (D . n = 0). The symmetric indefinite coupled operator takes one host SuperLU (float64, counters piezo_*), not the pcg: ~10^6 dofs at most (3 per node). Eigenfrequency: the coupled pencil, voltage electrodes at 0 = short circuit (resonances f_r), floating at charge 0 = open circuit (antiresonances f_a); k_eff^2 = (f_a^2 - f_r^2) / f_a^2 from two runs. frequency_response: electrode values as amplitudes (losses mechanical_loss_factor, dielectric_loss_tangent), the admittance feature fits Y(f). Outputs electric_potential, electric_field_x / _y; stress includes -e^T E (stress_zz with piezo_e13 / _e23). A {'model': 'crystal'} entry sets c_ij, piezo_e*, eps_dc*. Not with axial_wavenumber or the optomechanics study.
- `discretization` (default "quadratic"; quadratic | linear) - Discretization
  Triangle meshes only (a tensor mesh ignores it: bilinear cells). quadratic: P2, isoparametric on curved boundaries, linear strain per element; linear: P1, constant strain (stiff in bending, locks toward poisson_ratio 0.5). ~2 (quadratic) or ~0.5 (linear) unknowns per element and component. Displayed strain / stress are node averages over the solid elements (an interface smears over one element; displacements and state() element values do not).
- `pml_x_lo`, `pml_x_hi`, `pml_y_lo`, `pml_y_hi` (bool; default false) - PML on x_lo / PML on x_hi / PML on y_lo / PML on y_hi
  Triangle mesh, eigenfrequency study, target_frequency > 0: an elastic PML ring beyond this face, pml_cells x the mesh dx thick, material continued from the window edge, stretch s = 1 - j beta (d / w)^2 (d depth, w thickness; axisymmetric: the stretched radius beyond x_hi), beta from pml_reflection at the target for the fastest wave sqrt(c_II / rho); outer side clamped. Modes become complex: frequency_imag > 0, radiation Q = f / (2 frequency_imag) in the Resonance table, shapes shown as real part and |u|; modes with over half their |u|^2 in the ring are dropped. beta is frequency independent, so absorption weakens far below the target. stress_stiffening treats the ring as an unstretched elastic continuation, clamped outside (its K_sigma stretched like K). Supports and loads stay off this face; not on x_lo of an axisymmetric solid (the axis).
- `pml_cells` [1] (int; default 8; [1, 100]) - PML thickness (elements)
  PML ring thickness in mesh dx (h_max) on every pml_<face> face (MeshSpec pml_layers sets the element layers across it); the profile needs ~6-10 layers and the ring a fair part of the longest wavelength (c / f at the target).
- `pml_reflection` [1] (default 1e-06; (0, 1]) - PML reflection. Help: shared `solid_mechanics.pml_reflection`
- `periodic_x`, `periodic_y` (bool; default false) - Periodic x / Periodic y
  Eigenfrequency study (a plain periodic cell, every bloch_k 0, on triangles also stationary / time_dependent): the lo and hi faces of this axis are one Bloch-periodic pair, u (with phi when piezoelectric, the u_z amplitude with axial_wavenumber) on hi = on lo times exp(-j k L) (k its bloch_k, L the window size along it, exp(+j omega t)). Tensor mesh: corner nodes paired by index (plane strain or plane stress, also piezoelectric or axial_wavenumber); triangles: matching side nodes (planar; no PML ring on these faces, an elastic PML on the other axis makes a surface-wave cell). Modes of P^H K P, P^H M P (complex Hermitian; real when every k L is a multiple of pi), shown as real part (phase 0) and u_abs = |u|. Supports and electrodes stay off these faces (one on the other axis may reach their corners); floating electrodes must not touch them. Every bloch_k 0: a cell without supports keeps its rigid translations: set target_frequency > 0 (drops them) or hold it; piezoelectric then needs a ground electrode (k != 0: none). A static triangle cell solves K_r = P^T K P (zero mean strain along the axis: one cell of an infinite array; hold it, e.g. Fixed on the other axis). Not with axisymmetric, generalized plane strain, stress_stiffening, geometric_nonlinearity or frequency_response.
- `bloch_kx` [rad/m] (default 0; visible when periodic_x in (true)) - Bloch wave vector x. Help: shared `solid_mechanics.bloch_kx`
- `bloch_ky` [rad/m] (default 0; visible when periodic_y in (true)) - Bloch wave vector y. Help: shared `solid_mechanics.bloch_kx`

### Material properties (MaterialSpec.properties)

- `youngs_modulus` [Pa] (>= 0; nullable) - Young's modulus. Help: shared `elastic_waves.youngs_modulus`
- `poisson_ratio` [1] ((-1, 0.499]; nullable) - Poisson ratio. Help: shared `elastic_waves.poisson_ratio`
- `alpha` [1/K] (nullable; writes alpha_xx, alpha_yy, alpha_zz) - Thermal expansion coefficient
  Linear thermal expansion coefficient; also read by heat_em_thermo_optic (see the heat type).
- `alpha_xx`, `alpha_yy` [1/K] (nullable) - Thermal expansion along x / Thermal expansion along y
  Overrides alpha for this axis.
- `alpha_zz` [1/K] (nullable) - Thermal expansion along z. Help: shared `solid_mechanics.alpha_zz`
- `photoelastic_p11` [1] (nullable) - Photoelastic coefficient p11. Help: shared `elastic_waves.photoelastic_p11`
- `photoelastic_p12` [1] (nullable) - Photoelastic coefficient p12. Help: shared `elastic_waves.photoelastic_p12`
- `rho` [kg/m^3] (>= 0; nullable) - Density. Help: shared `solid_mechanics.rho`
- `photoelastic_p44` [1] (nullable) - Photoelastic coefficient p44
  Shear strain-optic coefficient: Delta(1/n^2)_xy = p44 x 2 strain_xy (Voigt; cubic axes along x, y, z). Read only by optomechanical_coupling (the strain-optic couplings have no shear term). Unset = the isotropic (p11 - p12) / 2 per cell. Typical: silicon -0.051, silica -0.075.
- `piezo_e11` [C/m^2] (nullable) - Piezoelectric e11. Help: shared `solid_mechanics.piezo_e11`
- `piezo_e12` [C/m^2] (nullable) - Piezoelectric e12
  Piezoelectric stress constant e_12: row x, Voigt column yy; rules: piezo_e11.
- `piezo_e16` [C/m^2] (nullable) - Piezoelectric e16
  Piezoelectric stress constant e_16: row x, Voigt column xy; rules: piezo_e11.
- `piezo_e21` [C/m^2] (nullable) - Piezoelectric e21
  Piezoelectric stress constant e_21: row y, Voigt column xx; rules: piezo_e11.
- `piezo_e22` [C/m^2] (nullable) - Piezoelectric e22
  Piezoelectric stress constant e_22: row y, Voigt column yy; rules: piezo_e11.
- `piezo_e26` [C/m^2] (nullable) - Piezoelectric e26
  Piezoelectric stress constant e_26: row y, Voigt column xy; rules: piezo_e11.
- `piezo_e13` [C/m^2] (nullable) - Piezoelectric e13
  Piezoelectric stress constant e_13: row x, Voigt column zz; rules: piezo_e11. 2D plane strain (S_zz = 0): it enters only stress_zz -= e_13 E_x.
- `piezo_e23` [C/m^2] (nullable) - Piezoelectric e23
  Piezoelectric stress constant e_23: row y, Voigt column zz; rules: piezo_e11. 2D plane strain (S_zz = 0): it enters only stress_zz -= e_23 E_y.
- `eps_dc` [1] (>= 1; nullable; writes eps_dc_xx, eps_dc_yy) - Static relative permittivity
  Isotropic static relative permittivity: sets eps_dc_xx and eps_dc_yy (components override); unset = 1. Same arrays as electrostatics / drift_diffusion; read only with piezoelectric on, as the clamped permittivity eps^S of every window cell (void included). Not the optical eps_r: lithium niobate eps^S 44 / 29 (along the optic axis), silica 3.9.
- `eps_dc_xx`, `eps_dc_yy` [1] (>= 1; nullable) - Static relative permittivity along x / Static relative permittivity along y
  Overrides eps_dc for this axis.
- `eps_dc_xy` [1] (nullable) - Static relative permittivity, cross term. Help: shared `solid_mechanics.eps_dc_xy`
- `c11` [Pa] (>= 0; nullable) - Stiffness c11. Help: shared `solid_mechanics.c11`
- `c12` [Pa] (nullable) - Stiffness c12
  Stiffness entry c12 (xx-yy) of the Voigt matrix in model axes; unset = lambda. Rules: c11.
- `c13` [Pa] (nullable) - Stiffness c13
  Stiffness entry c13 (xx-zz) of the Voigt matrix in model axes; unset = lambda. Rules: c11.
- `c22` [Pa] (>= 0; nullable) - Stiffness c22
  Stiffness entry c22 (yy-yy) of the Voigt matrix in model axes; unset = lambda + 2 mu. Rules: c11.
- `c23` [Pa] (nullable) - Stiffness c23
  Stiffness entry c23 (yy-zz) of the Voigt matrix in model axes; unset = lambda. Rules: c11.
- `c33` [Pa] (>= 0; nullable) - Stiffness c33
  Stiffness entry c33 (zz-zz) of the Voigt matrix in model axes; unset = lambda + 2 mu. Rules: c11.
- `c16` [Pa] (nullable) - Stiffness c16
  Stiffness entry c16 (xx-xy) of the Voigt matrix in model axes; unset = 0. Rules: c11.
- `c26` [Pa] (nullable) - Stiffness c26
  Stiffness entry c26 (yy-xy) of the Voigt matrix in model axes; unset = 0. Rules: c11.
- `c36` [Pa] (nullable) - Stiffness c36
  Stiffness entry c36 (zz-xy) of the Voigt matrix in model axes; unset = 0. Rules: c11.
- `c66` [Pa] (>= 0; nullable) - Stiffness c66
  Stiffness entry c66 (xy-xy) of the Voigt matrix in model axes; unset = mu. Rules: c11.
- `mechanical_loss_factor` [1] (>= 0; nullable) - Mechanical loss factor. Help: shared `solid_mechanics.mechanical_loss_factor`
- `dielectric_loss_tangent` [1] (>= 0; nullable) - Dielectric loss tangent. Help: shared `solid_mechanics.dielectric_loss_tangent`
- `initial_stress_xx` [Pa] (nullable) - Initial stress xx. Help: shared `solid_mechanics.initial_stress_xx`
- `initial_stress_yy` [Pa] (nullable) - Initial stress yy
  Initial stress sigma0_yy; 2D: in-plane yy (axisymmetric: zz, along the axis). Rules: initial_stress_xx.
- `initial_stress_xy` [Pa] (nullable) - Initial stress xy
  Initial stress sigma0_xy; 2D: in-plane shear (axisymmetric: rz). Rules: initial_stress_xx.
- `initial_stress_zz` [Pa] (nullable) - Initial stress zz. Help: shared `solid_mechanics.initial_stress_zz`
- `k` [W/(m K)] (>= 0; nullable; writes k_xx, k_yy, k_zz) - Thermal conductivity. Help: shared `solid_mechanics.k`
- `k_xx`, `k_yy` [W/(m K)] (>= 0; nullable) - Thermal conductivity along x / Thermal conductivity along y
  Overrides k for this axis.
- `k_zz` [W/(m K)] (>= 0; nullable) - Thermal conductivity along z
  Overrides k for this axis (3D only).
- `cp` [J/(kg K)] (>= 0; nullable) - Specific heat capacity. Help: shared `solid_mechanics.cp`

### Fields

Output fields (primary u_abs; [state] = also a state field):
- `u_abs` - Displacement magnitude (m) [state]
- `u_x` - Displacement x (m) [state]
- `u_y` - Displacement y (m) [state]
- `u_x_im` - Displacement x, imaginary part (m) [frequency_response study only]
- `u_y_im` - Displacement y, imaginary part (m) [frequency_response study only]
- `u_z` - Displacement z (guided modes) (m) [state]
- `von_mises` - von Mises stress (Pa) [state]
- `strain_energy_density` - Strain energy density (J/m^3)
- `kinetic_energy_density` - Kinetic energy density (time average) (J/m^3)
- `stress_xx` - Stress xx (Pa) [state]
- `stress_yy` - Stress yy (Pa) [state]
- `stress_xy` - Shear stress xy (Pa) [state]
- `stress_zz` - Stress zz (out of plane) (Pa) [state]
- `strain_xx` - Strain xx (1) [state]
- `strain_yy` - Strain yy (1) [state]
- `strain_xy` - Shear strain xy (1) [state]
- `elastic_strain_xx` - Elastic strain xx (1) [state]
- `elastic_strain_yy` - Elastic strain yy (1) [state]
- `elastic_strain_zz` - Elastic strain zz (out of plane) (1) [state]
- `temperature_rise` - Coupled temperature rise (K) [state]
- `temperature_rise_ext` - Applied temperature change (K) [state]
- `body_force_x` - Coupled body force x (N/m^3) [state]
- `body_force_y` - Coupled body force y (N/m^3) [state]
- `electric_potential` - Electric potential (piezoelectric) (V) [state]
- `electric_field_x` - Electric field x (piezoelectric) (V/m) [state]
- `electric_field_y` - Electric field y (piezoelectric) (V/m) [state]
- `youngs_modulus` - Young's modulus (Pa) [state]
- `poisson_ratio` - Poisson ratio (1) [state]
- `om_integrand` - Optomechanical moving-boundary density (rad/s/m^3) [optomechanics study only]

### Source slots

- `temperature_rise` (K): Coupled temperature above the stress-free state (heat_solid_thermal_strain: heat T - T0), added to the temperature_change features (field temperature_rise_ext); each transfer replaces it.
- `body_force_x` (N/m^3): Coupled body force density along x (optical or Lorentz force; such couplings add), added to the body_force features; each transfer replaces it; void cells drop it.
- `body_force_y` (N/m^3): Coupled body force density along y, as body_force_x.

### Feature `solid_mechanics.fixed` - Fixed

u_x = u_y = 0 (and u_z of guided modes). Outer faces only (on an object boundary use Fixed (domain)); every node of the face, corners included. Result 'table' of the latest solve, row [feature, F_x, F_y], extras F_x, F_y: the force the support exerts on the solid, sum of K u - f over its held dofs (0 for unheld components; a dof held by two supports counts in both, the later value holds it); N/m per m of depth, N with the thickness setting or axisymmetric (whole ring). After a frequency_response on triangles: the complex reaction per frequency instead (columns frequency, F_x_re, F_x_im, F_y_re, F_y_im).

- Category boundary_condition; selection boundary entities, at least 1, outer faces only; mesh kinds tensor, triangles; result kind `table`

Params: none

### Feature `solid_mechanics.roller` - Roller

Normal displacement 0 (u_x on x faces, u_y on y faces), tangential free (zero shear traction; u_z of guided modes free); a mirror plane. Rollers on one x and one y face hold a solid. Outer faces only (on an object boundary use Fixed (domain)); every node of the face, corners included. Result: the reaction table, as fixed.

- Category boundary_condition; selection boundary entities, at least 1, outer faces only; mesh kinds tensor, triangles; result kind `table`

Params: none

### Feature `solid_mechanics.displacement` - Displacement

Prescribed u_x and / or u_y; an empty component stays free (both empty: validation error; u_z of guided modes free). A later support on the same component sets its value (warning). Outer faces only (on an object boundary use Fixed (domain)); every node of the face, corners included. Result: the reaction table, as fixed.

- Category boundary_condition; selection boundary entities, at least 1, outer faces only; mesh kinds tensor, triangles; result kind `table`

Params:
- `u_x`, `u_y` [m] (nullable) - Displacement x / Displacement y
  Prescribed displacement component; empty leaves it free.

### Feature `solid_mechanics.fixed_domain` - Fixed (domain)

u_x = u_y = 0 (and u_z of guided modes) on every corner node of the selected cells (triangles: every node of the selected elements): a rigid region clamped to the solid around it, whatever its own stiffness. Result: the reaction table, as fixed.

- Category domain_condition; selection domain entities, at least 1; mesh kinds tensor, triangles; result kind `table`

Params: none

### Feature `solid_mechanics.prescribed_displacement_domain` - Prescribed displacement (domain)

Prescribed u_x and / or u_y on every node of the selected elements; an empty component stays free (both empty: validation error), e.g. u_x = 0, u_y free on a strip that may deflect but not slide (with geometric nonlinearity a no-slip string). Holding u_x across a member locks the rotation of its cross-sections (bending becomes shear). A later support on the same component sets its value. Result: the reaction table, as fixed.

- Category domain_condition; selection domain entities, at least 1; mesh kinds triangles; result kind `table`

Params:
