- `u_x`, `u_y` [m] (nullable) - Displacement x / Displacement y
  Prescribed displacement component; empty leaves it free.

### Feature `solid_mechanics.boundary_load` - Boundary load

Traction (t_x, t_y) in model axes (not the face normal) on outer faces as consistent nodal forces, per m of depth (axisymmetric: whole rings in N; x_hi the cylinder r = R, a y face the annulus). Several add; on a held component it only enters the reaction.

- Category boundary_condition; selection boundary entities, at least 1, outer faces only; mesh kinds tensor, triangles; result none

Params:
- `t_x` [Pa] (default 0) - Traction x
  Along +x (a pressure p pushing into x_hi: t_x = -p).
- `t_y` [Pa] (default -1e+06) - Traction y
  Along +y (a pressure p on y_hi: t_y = -p). Typical 1e5-1e8.

### Feature `solid_mechanics.segment_load` - Boundary load (segment)

Traction (t_x, t_y) on part of a boundary or along an interior line (a line force: a traction jump). Tensor mesh: each line horizontal or vertical (validation error otherwise), acting on the nearest node line (validation warns beyond 1/100 cell); consistent nodal forces of the segment clipped to the window, so the total is exactly t x length per m of depth, ends inside cells too (axisymmetric: whole rings in N, a horizontal segment the annulus pi (r_1^2 - r_0^2), a vertical one 2 pi r h). Triangle mesh: any direction, element edges lie on it (int t N ds). Several add.

- Category boundary_condition; selection line entities, object kinds line, at least 1; mesh kinds tensor, triangles; result none

Params:
- `t_x` [Pa] (default 0) - Traction x
  Along +x (model axes).
- `t_y` [Pa] (default -1e+06) - Traction y
  Along +y (a pressure p pressing down on a top face: t_y = -p). Typical 1e5-1e8.

### Feature `solid_mechanics.body_force` - Body force

Body force density on the selected cells as consistent nodal forces (axisymmetric: ring-weighted, f_x radial); void cells drop it. Several add; the coupled slots body_force_x / _y are separate.

- Category domain_condition; selection domain entities, at least 1; mesh kinds tensor, triangles; result none

Params:
- `f_x` [N/m^3] (default 0; may use x, y) - Body force x
  Along +x.
- `f_y` [N/m^3] (default -21600; may use x, y) - Body force y
  Along +y; gravity along -y is -rho g (silica -2.16e4).

### Feature `solid_mechanics.temperature_change` - Temperature change

Help: shared `solid_mechanics.temperature_change`

- Category domain_condition; selection domain entities, at least 1; mesh kinds tensor, triangles; result none

Params:
- `delta_T` [K] (default 10; may use x, y) - Temperature change
  Temperature above the stress-free state (several add); thermal strain alpha delta_T.

### Feature `solid_mechanics.solid_probe` - Solid probe

Samples one output field at the point per re-solve, stationary iteration or end-of-run flush (t = 0 in a stationary study): the containing cell on a tensor mesh, the node there on triangles (strain / stress node-averaged).

- Category probe; selection point entities, object kinds point, exactly 1; mesh kinds tensor, triangles; result kind `timeseries`

Params:
- `component` (default "u_abs"; u_x | u_y | u_z | u_abs | strain_xx | strain_yy | strain_xy | elastic_strain_xx | elastic_strain_yy | elastic_strain_zz | stress_xx | stress_yy | stress_xy | stress_zz | von_mises | electric_potential | electric_field_x | electric_field_y | strain_energy_density | kinetic_energy_density) - Quantity
  Sampled field (its unit); the energy densities on triangle meshes only.

### Feature `solid_mechanics.frequency_probe` - Frequency probe

frequency_response study only: the complex displacement (exp(+j omega t), phase 0 = the drive) at the point per solved frequency (triangles: a node is put there; 0 off the solid). Result 'xy' versus frequency [Hz]: u_x_re / _im / _abs / _phase, u_y_re / _im / _abs / _phase (m; phase rad in (-pi, pi]); derived value two_wave_fit pairs a _re series with its _im. Restarts with each frequency_response run.

- Category probe; selection point entities, object kinds point, exactly 1; mesh kinds triangles; result kind `xy`

Params: none

### Feature `solid_mechanics.resonance_table` - Resonance table

Vibration modes of the last eigenfrequency solve, nearest target_frequency first (search targets / band: in frequency order). Result 'table', one row per mode: resonance_number, frequency, angular_frequency (1-based rank, Hz, rad/s); damped modes (elastic PML, loss factor, resistive_load electrode) append frequency_imag, q_factor, energy_decay_rate (Hz, > 0 decays; Re omega / (2 Im omega); 1/s, 2 Im omega = kappa_e of a resistive load). Extras target_frequency (Hz; NaN for several targets or a band), targets, band, expected_count, selected_resonance, axial_wavenumber (rad/m; None = plane strain). Frequency versus a parameter: a derived value with source '<physics>.<this feature>', expression frequency, operation at, at = 0 (the first mode).

- Category monitor; selection none (a selection is ignored with a warning); mesh kinds tensor, triangles; result kind `table`

Params: none

### Feature `solid_mechanics.thermoelastic_damping` - Thermoelastic damping

Thermoelastic damping (TED) of every mode of the last eigenfrequency (or optomechanics) solve, plane strain, plane stress or axisymmetric; perturbative and one-way (the modes stay isothermal). Per mode (omega = Re omega, exp(+j omega t)) the strain-rate heat source q = -j omega T0 (beta : eps), beta = C : alpha the thermal stress per kelvin, drives j omega rho cp theta - div(k grad theta) = q on the solid, adiabatic on its whole boundary (theta on its own nodes: bilinear on a tensor mesh, P1 / P2 on element meshes); d = -int beta : eps* theta dV gives 1 / Q_TED = Im d / (u^H K u) (> 0) and ted_frequency_shift = Re d / (2 u^H K u) (> 0: toward the adiabatic stiffness). Thin-beam flexure reproduces Zener (Delta = E alpha^2 T0 / (rho cp), tau = h^2 rho cp / (pi^2 k)) and Lifshitz-Roukes within 2 %. Materials: k (k_xx, k_yy, k_zz), rho, cp (library silicon, silica, silicon_nitride have them), alpha, the stiffness; every solid cell needs rho > 0 and cp > 0. Result 'table', one row per mode: resonance_number, frequency, q_ted, ted_frequency_shift, q_other, q_total (Hz; Q inf without loss): q_other = the other losses (a damped pencil's Q: elastic PML and, on element meshes, mechanical_loss_factor; tensor mesh: the loss factor perturbatively, 1 / Q = u^H (eta K) u / u^H K u; tetrahedra: also q_gas), 1 / q_total = 1 / q_ted + 1 / q_other. Extras T0, selected_resonance. Complex modes use Re omega and Re(u^H M u). One complex host SuperLU per mode at the first read. Not modelled: piezoelectric, guided modes, azimuthal_order >= 1, Bloch cells; PML elements take no part. Q_TED versus a parameter: derived value source '<physics>.<this feature>', expression q_ted, operation at, at = 0.

- Category monitor; selection none (a selection is ignored with a warning); mesh kinds tensor, triangles; result kind `table`

Params:
- `T0` [K] (default 293.15; > 0) - Reference temperature
  Absolute temperature of the vibrating solid (the heat type's T0 default); 1 / Q_TED scales with it (Delta = E alpha^2 T0 / (rho cp)).

### Feature `solid_mechanics.optomechanical_coupling` - Optomechanical coupling

Help: shared `solid_mechanics.optomechanical_coupling`

- Category monitor; selection none (a selection is ignored with a warning); mesh kinds tensor, triangles, tetrahedra; result kind `table`

Params:
- `optical_physics` (ref: physics name; default "") - Optical physics. Help: shared `solid_mechanics.optomechanical_coupling.optical_physics`
- `optical_mode` (int; default 1; >= 1) - Optical mode
  em_modes mode number (descending Re beta^2) or resonance number of the em_fdfd_ez / _hz / _bor eigen-solve (nearest its wavelength first).
- `length` [m] (default 6.28319e-05; > 0) - Out-of-plane length. Help: shared `solid_mechanics.optomechanical_coupling.length`
- `moving_boundary` (bool; default true) - Moving boundary
  Include the moving-boundary part (permittivity jumps carried by the mode shape).
- `photoelastic` (bool; default true) - Photoelastic
  Include the photoelastic part (photoelastic_p11 / _p12 / _p44, or a crystal entry's rotated p).
- `normalisation` (default "max"; max | point) - Displacement reference. Help: shared `solid_mechanics.optomechanical_coupling.normalisation`
- `reference_x`, `reference_y` [m] (default 0; visible when normalisation in (point)) - Reference x / Reference y
  Reference point coordinate (normalisation point).
- `mechanical_quality_factor` [1] (> 0; nullable) - Mechanical quality factor. Help: shared `solid_mechanics.optomechanical_coupling.mechanical_quality_factor`
- `quality_from` (str; default "") - Quality factor from damping feature. Help: shared `solid_mechanics.optomechanical_coupling.quality_from`
- `scattering` (default "forward"; forward | backward) - Brillouin scattering. Help: shared `solid_mechanics.optomechanical_coupling.scattering`
- `prescribed_normal_displacement` [m] (nullable) - Prescribed boundary motion. Help: shared `solid_mechanics.optomechanical_coupling.prescribed_normal_displacement`
- `axis_x` [m] (default 0) - Axis x (3D solid). Help: shared `solid_mechanics.optomechanical_coupling.axis_x`
- `axis_y` [m] (default 0) - Axis y (3D solid)
  y of the BOR axis point (see axis_x).

### Feature `solid_mechanics.electrode` - Electrode

Electrode on outer faces (every node, corners included). Piezoelectric only (else ignored, validation warning): one equipotential, connection voltage or floating. Two electrodes must not share a node (adjacent faces share a corner: build error; select both in one feature). Its nodes keep their supports and loads (a thin film without stiffness). Result 'table' of the latest static solve, row [feature, V, Q] (V, C/m), extras V, Q: the potential and the net free charge per m of depth (Q = -sum of the phi rows of A x over its nodes, the discrete Gauss law; a driven electrode against ground: Q / V = capacitance per m). Not after an eigenfrequency solve.

- Category boundary_condition; selection boundary entities, at least 1, outer faces only; result kind `table`

Params:
- `connection` (default "voltage"; voltage | floating) - Connection. Help: shared `solid_mechanics.electrode.connection`
- `voltage` [V] (default 0) - Voltage
  Potential of a voltage electrode in a static solve; ignored by floating electrodes and the eigenfrequency study (0 there).
- `charge` [C/m] (default 0) - Charge
  Net free charge per m of depth on a floating electrode in a static solve (its voltage follows); ignored otherwise (eigenfrequency: 0).

### Feature `solid_mechanics.electrode_domain` - Electrode (domain)

Electrode on every corner node of the selected cells (a drawn metal electrode: give it stiffness and density, or none). Rules and result as electrode.

- Category domain_condition; selection domain entities, at least 1; result kind `table`

Params:
- `connection` (default "voltage"; voltage | floating) - Connection. Help: shared `solid_mechanics.electrode.connection`
- `voltage` [V] (default 0) - Voltage
  Potential of a voltage electrode in a static solve; ignored by floating electrodes and the eigenfrequency study (0 there).
- `charge` [C/m] (default 0) - Charge
  Net free charge per m of depth on a floating electrode in a static solve (its voltage follows); ignored otherwise (eigenfrequency: 0).

### Feature `solid_mechanics.admittance` - Admittance

Help: shared `solid_mechanics.admittance`

- Category monitor; selection none (a selection is ignored with a warning); result kind `xy`

Params:
- `electrode` (str; default "") - Electrode
  Driven electrode feature (connection voltage, voltage != 0) whose Y is reported; empty = the only such electrode (error when several).
- `fit_frequency_min` [Hz] (>= 0; nullable) - Fit band start
  Fit band start; empty = the lowest solved frequency. Bracket one resonance / antiresonance pair (other modes bias the fit).
- `fit_frequency_max` [Hz] (>= 0; nullable) - Fit band stop
  Fit band stop; empty = the highest solved frequency.
- `load_impedance` [Ohm] (default 50; > 0) - Load impedance
  Resistive load Z of the external circuit for the extras kappa_e and omega_C0_Z; needs 3D or the 2D thickness setting (else NaN).

## Physics type `solid_mechanics_3d` - Solid Mechanics (3D)

3D static linear elasticity, small strain: sigma = C (eps - alpha dT), C isotropic (youngs_modulus, poisson_ratio) or, on tetrahedra, the 21 c_IJ entries (see c11), alpha per axis (alpha_xx / _yy / _zz), dT = temperature_rise (coupled, heat_solid_thermal_strain) + temperature_rise_ext (temperature_change features). Forces and reactions in N. u_x, u_y, u_z are the displacement [m], u_abs its magnitude; strain_xy / _xz / _yz tensor shear strains (half the engineering strain); elastic_strain_* = strain - alpha dT. Void cells (no stiffness) are not solved and output 0. Faces without a support or load are traction free; every solid region needs supports stopping all six rigid motions, e.g. rollers on one x, one y and one z face (validation checks the directions, the build the rank per region; regions touching along an edge or at a corner count as joined, so a hinge there shows as an unconverged solve). Tensor mesh: trilinear bricks on the window cells, matrix-free block-Jacobi pcg (~20 iterations per cell along the longest axis; the cpu backend is much slower per iteration), outputs at the cell centres (u = mean of the 8 corners), edge-extended into a PML shell; bricks are stiff in bending (>= 4 cells through a film). Its eigenfrequency study finds the n_resonances LOWEST modes only (no target_frequency, search targets / band or free bodies): matrix-free shift-invert Lanczos at 0, each step one pcg solve by the 'linear' solver (double or mixed), whose tolerance sets the frequency accuracy (1e-8: ~1e-8 relative; the Lanczos tolerance is >= 1000 x it); an eigen node block_eigen (opt-in) instead runs LOBPCG preconditioned by one multigrid V-cycle (or block Jacobi) per vector and iteration, its own residual tolerance setting the accuracy (frequency error ~ its square), 9 system-size vectors per block row. Tetrahedron mesh: Lagrange elements (setting discretization; linear P1 locks in bending and toward poisson_ratio 0.5) on the elements with stiffness (a PML shell is void), sparse_direct; state() and coupled slots one value per element (centroid), displayed fields nodal (strain / stress node-averaged: an interface smears over one element). Only there: c_IJ, supports and loads on domain objects, eigenfrequency about target_frequency (free bodies at target > 0, search targets / band, damped modes by mechanical_loss_factor), frequency_response, initial_stress_*, stress_stiffening, geometric_nonlinearity, piezoelectric, Bloch cells (periodic_* with bloch_k*, band diagram template solid_bloch_band_diagram_3d), pml_<face>, squeeze_film_damping, thermoelastic_damping, mode_shapes, frequency_probe, complex support reactions, the electric and energy-density outputs (0 on the tensor mesh); sizes and estimates there are uncalibrated. Studies: stationary (after the physics it reads); time_dependent quasi-static (re-solves when a material, support, load or coupled input changed; no inertia); eigenfrequency: K u = omega^2 M u (consistent mass of rho, needed in every solid cell; supports held at 0, loads and thermal strain ignored without stress_stiffening), one snapshot per mode labelled "resonance k: f = <Hz> Hz", shape scaled to a peak node |u| of 1 m (no thermal part, no support reactions), listed by resonance_table; frequency_response: (K (1 + j eta) - omega^2 M) u = f per frequency (loads, prescribed displacements and electrode voltages are phase-0 amplitudes; thermal loads static), one snapshot per frequency (real parts, u_abs = |u|); optomechanics: em_fdfd_bor optics, optomechanical_coupling samples the modes on rings about the BOR axis (piezoelectric and periodic axes off). The strain-optic and optical-force couplings are 2D only.

- Default instance name `solid`; studies stationary, time_dependent, eigenfrequency, frequency_response, optomechanics (default {"type": "stationary"})
- Backends gpu, cpu; mesh kinds tensor, tetrahedra; refinement indicator fields u_abs; dispersion poles not used
- Features: fixed, roller, displacement, fixed_domain, prescribed_displacement_domain, boundary_load, body_force, temperature_change, solid_probe, frequency_probe, resonance_table, mode_shapes, squeeze_film_damping, thermoelastic_damping, electrode, electrode_domain, admittance, optomechanical_coupling

### Settings (PhysicsSpec.settings)

- `discretization` (default "quadratic"; quadratic | linear) - Discretization. Help: shared `electric_currents.discretization`
- `target_frequency` [Hz] (default 0; >= 0) - Eigenfrequency target
  Eigenfrequency study on tetrahedra: the modes nearest this frequency (shift-invert about (2 pi f)^2, moved 1e-4 above so a target on a resonance factors); 0 = the lowest. A free body (supports leaving a rigid motion free) or free Bloch cell (every bloch_k 0) needs a target > 0, below the first elastic mode is fine: its rigid-body modes (f < 1e-4 x target) are dropped; static solves of a free body stay refused. Tensor mesh: lowest modes only, a nonzero value is a validation error.
- `stress_stiffening` (bool; default false) - Stress stiffening. Help: shared `solid_mechanics.stress_stiffening`
- `geometric_nonlinearity` (bool; default false) - Geometric nonlinearity. Help: shared `solid_mechanics.geometric_nonlinearity`
- `load_steps` (int; default 1; >= 1; visible when geometric_nonlinearity in (true)) - Load steps. Help: shared `solid_mechanics.load_steps`
- `nonlinear_tolerance` [1] (default 1e-08; > 0; visible when geometric_nonlinearity in (true)) - Nonlinear tolerance. Help: shared `solid_mechanics.nonlinear_tolerance`
- `nonlinear_max_iterations` (int; default 25; >= 1; visible when geometric_nonlinearity in (true)) - Nonlinear iteration limit
  Geometric nonlinearity: Newton iterations per load step; then a warning, and the next step continues from the damped state.
- `tangent_update` (default "when_slow"; every_iteration | when_slow; visible when geometric_nonlinearity in (true)) - Tangent update. Help: shared `solid_mechanics.tangent_update`
- `piezoelectric` (bool; default false) - Piezoelectric
  Tetrahedron mesh only: the full 3D piezoelectric solid. A potential phi (elements of setting discretization) on every window element (void ones dielectric) couples through the 18 piezo_e* entries (solid elements), clamped permittivity eps0 eps_dc (six eps_dc_* entries, unset = 1): T = c S - e^T E, D = e S + eps E, E = -grad phi, div D = 0. Electrode features hold phi (connection voltage; at least one, the ground), float with a net charge [C] or load a resistor (resistive_load); other boundaries are insulating (D . n = 0). The symmetric indefinite operator is factorised once per assembly by the 'linear' sparse_direct solver (potential scaled to balance the blocks). With every e = 0: 3D anisotropic electrostatics (capacitance with fringing). Outputs electric_potential, electric_field_*, electric_displacement_*; stress includes -e^T E. Eigenfrequency: modes of the coupled pencil (massless potential) nearest target_frequency, voltage electrodes at 0 V (short circuit: resonances f_r), floating ones at zero charge (open circuit: antiresonances f_a), k_eff^2 = (f_a^2 - f_r^2) / f_a^2 from two runs; each mode shows its potential and E / D; resistive_load damps the modes (kappa_e = 2 Im omega). frequency_response: eps (1 - j dielectric_loss_tangent), electrode values as phase-0 amplitudes, admittance Y = j omega Q / V in S. A {'model': 'crystal', 'plane': 'full'} entry sets c_IJ, piezo_e*, eps_dc*.
- `electrode_edge_size` [m] (default 0; >= 0; visible when piezoelectric in (true)) - Electrode edge size
  Piezoelectric, mesher 'gmsh': element size along the edges of every domain object an enabled electrode feature selects (box edges, cylinder rims), growing by the mesh max_ratio; 0 = off. The field is singular at electrode edges, so C0 and k_eff^2 converge slowly without it; typical a fifth to a tenth of the film thickness. Not for outer-face electrodes, spheres or shapes gmsh does not mesh conformally; the builtin mesher ignores it.
- `periodic_x`, `periodic_y`, `periodic_z` (bool; default false) - Periodic x / Periodic y / Periodic z
  Tetrahedron mesh, eigenfrequency study: the lo and hi faces of this axis are one Bloch-periodic pair, u and phi on hi = on lo times exp(-j k L) (k its bloch_k, L the mesh extent along it, exp(+j omega t)). The faces must be meshed alike node for node (the builtin mesher does; gmsh writes periodic surfaces); supports and electrodes stay off them. Modes of P^H K P, P^H M P (complex Hermitian; real when every k L is a multiple of pi), shown as real part (phase 0) and u_abs = |u|; no electrode tables. Every bloch_k 0: a free cell keeps its rigid translations (and the rotation about a single periodic axis): set target_frequency > 0 (drops them) or hold it; piezoelectric then needs a ground electrode (k != 0: none).
- `bloch_kx` [rad/m] (default 0; visible when periodic_x in (true)) - Bloch wave vector x. Help: shared `solid_mechanics_3d.bloch_kx`
- `bloch_ky` [rad/m] (default 0; visible when periodic_y in (true)) - Bloch wave vector y. Help: shared `solid_mechanics_3d.bloch_kx`
- `bloch_kz` [rad/m] (default 0; visible when periodic_z in (true)) - Bloch wave vector z. Help: shared `solid_mechanics_3d.bloch_kx`
- `pml_x_lo`, `pml_x_hi`, `pml_y_lo`, `pml_y_hi`, `pml_z_lo`, `pml_z_hi` (bool; default false) - PML on x_lo / PML on x_hi / PML on y_lo / PML on y_hi / PML on z_lo / PML on z_hi
  Tetrahedron mesh, eigenfrequency study, target_frequency > 0, piezoelectric off: an elastic PML shell of pml_cells element layers beyond this face, material continued from the window edge, stretch s = 1 - j beta (d / w)^2 (d depth, w thickness), beta from pml_reflection at the target for the fastest wave sqrt(c_II / rho); outer side clamped. Modes become complex: frequency_imag > 0, radiation Q = f / (2 frequency_imag) in the Resonance table, shapes shown as real part and |u|; modes with over half their |u|^2 in the shell are dropped. beta is frequency independent, so absorption weakens far below the target. Supports and loads stay off this face.
- `pml_cells` (int; default 8; [1, 100]) - PML element layers
  PML shell thickness in element layers of the mesh dx (h_max) on every pml_<face> face; the profile needs ~6-10 layers and the shell a fair part of the longest wavelength (c / f at the target).
- `pml_reflection` [1] (default 1e-06; (0, 1]) - PML reflection. Help: shared `solid_mechanics.pml_reflection`

### Fields

Output fields (primary u_abs; [state] = also a state field):
- `u_abs` - Displacement magnitude (m) [state]
- `u_x` - Displacement x (m) [state]
- `u_y` - Displacement y (m) [state]
- `u_z` - Displacement z (m) [state]
- `u_x_im` - Displacement x, imaginary part (m) [frequency_response study only]
- `u_y_im` - Displacement y, imaginary part (m) [frequency_response study only]
- `u_z_im` - Displacement z, imaginary part (m) [frequency_response study only]
- `von_mises` - von Mises stress (Pa) [state]
- `stress_xx` - Stress xx (Pa) [state]
- `stress_yy` - Stress yy (Pa) [state]
- `stress_zz` - Stress zz (Pa) [state]
- `stress_xy` - Shear stress xy (Pa) [state]
- `stress_xz` - Shear stress xz (Pa) [state]
- `stress_yz` - Shear stress yz (Pa) [state]
- `strain_xx` - Strain xx (1) [state]
- `strain_yy` - Strain yy (1) [state]
- `strain_zz` - Strain zz (1) [state]
- `strain_xy` - Shear strain xy (1) [state]
- `strain_xz` - Shear strain xz (1) [state]
- `strain_yz` - Shear strain yz (1) [state]
- `elastic_strain_xx` - Elastic strain xx (1) [state]
- `elastic_strain_yy` - Elastic strain yy (1) [state]
- `elastic_strain_zz` - Elastic strain zz (1) [state]
- `temperature_rise` - Coupled temperature rise (K) [state]
- `temperature_rise_ext` - Applied temperature change (K) [state]
- `body_force_x` - Coupled body force x (N/m^3) [state]
- `body_force_y` - Coupled body force y (N/m^3) [state]
- `body_force_z` - Coupled body force z (N/m^3) [state]
- `electric_potential` - Electric potential (piezoelectric) (V)
- `electric_field_x` - Electric field x (piezoelectric) (V/m)
- `electric_field_y` - Electric field y (piezoelectric) (V/m)
- `electric_field_z` - Electric field z (piezoelectric) (V/m)
- `electric_displacement_x` - Electric displacement x (piezoelectric) (C/m^2)
- `electric_displacement_y` - Electric displacement y (piezoelectric) (C/m^2)
- `electric_displacement_z` - Electric displacement z (piezoelectric) (C/m^2)
- `strain_energy_density` - Strain energy density (J/m^3)
- `kinetic_energy_density` - Kinetic energy density (time average) (J/m^3)
- `youngs_modulus` - Young's modulus (Pa) [state]
- `poisson_ratio` - Poisson ratio (1) [state]

### Source slots

- `temperature_rise` (K): Coupled temperature above the stress-free state (heat_solid_thermal_strain: heat T - T0), added to the temperature_change features (field temperature_rise_ext); each transfer replaces it.
- `body_force_x` (N/m^3): Coupled body force density along x, added to the body_force features; each transfer replaces it; void cells drop it.
- `body_force_y` (N/m^3): Coupled body force density along y, as body_force_x.
- `body_force_z` (N/m^3): Coupled body force density along z, as body_force_x.

### Feature `solid_mechanics_3d.fixed` - Fixed

u_x = u_y = u_z = 0. Outer faces and, on tetrahedra, domain objects (their interface and outer boundary faces; a tensor mesh refuses objects: use Fixed (domain)); every node of the faces, edges and corners included. Result 'table' of the latest solve, row [feature, F_x, F_y, F_z] (N), extras F_x, F_y, F_z: the force the support exerts on the solid, sum of K u - f over its held dofs (0 for unheld components; a dof held by two supports counts in both, the later value holds it). After a frequency_response on tetrahedra: the complex reaction per frequency instead (columns frequency, F_x_re, F_x_im, F_y_re, F_y_im, F_z_re, F_z_im).

- Category boundary_condition; selection boundary entities, at least 1, outer faces and object perimeters; mesh kinds tensor, tetrahedra; result kind `table`

Params: none

### Feature `solid_mechanics_3d.roller` - Roller

Normal displacement 0 (u_x on x faces, u_y on y, u_z on z), tangential free (zero shear traction); a mirror plane (warning on a face of a crystal not mirror symmetric there). Rollers on one x, one y and one z face hold a solid. Outer faces only (on an object boundary use Fixed (domain)); every node of the face, edges and corners included. Result: the reaction table, as fixed.

- Category boundary_condition; selection boundary entities, at least 1, outer faces only; mesh kinds tensor, tetrahedra; result kind `table`

Params: none

### Feature `solid_mechanics_3d.displacement` - Displacement

Prescribed u_x, u_y and / or u_z; an empty component stays free (all empty: validation error). A later support on the same component sets its value (warning). Outer faces and, on tetrahedra, domain objects (their interface and outer boundary faces; a tensor mesh refuses objects: use Fixed (domain)); every node of the faces, edges and corners included. Result: the reaction table, as fixed.

- Category boundary_condition; selection boundary entities, at least 1, outer faces and object perimeters; mesh kinds tensor, tetrahedra; result kind `table`

Params:
- `u_x`, `u_y`, `u_z` [m] (nullable) - Displacement x / Displacement y / Displacement z
  Prescribed displacement component; empty leaves it free.

### Feature `solid_mechanics_3d.fixed_domain` - Fixed (domain)

u_x = u_y = u_z = 0 on every corner node of the selected cells (tetrahedra: every node of the selected elements): a rigid region clamped to the solid around it, whatever its own stiffness. Result: the reaction table, as fixed.

- Category domain_condition; selection domain entities, at least 1; mesh kinds tensor, tetrahedra; result kind `table`

Params: none

### Feature `solid_mechanics_3d.prescribed_displacement_domain` - Prescribed displacement (domain)

Prescribed u_x, u_y and / or u_z on every corner node of the selected cells (tetrahedra: every node of the selected elements); an empty component stays free (all empty: validation error), e.g. u_x = u_y = 0, u_z free for a no-slip film. Held so through its whole thickness a solid cannot rotate its cross-sections: bending turns into transverse shear and, with geometric nonlinearity, membrane stretching is partly relieved by thickness change (not a shell model's no-slip mid-surface). A later support on the same component sets its value. Result: the reaction table, as fixed.

- Category domain_condition; selection domain entities, at least 1; mesh kinds tensor, tetrahedra; result kind `table`

Params:
- `u_x`, `u_y`, `u_z` [m] (nullable) - Displacement x / Displacement y / Displacement z
  Prescribed displacement component; empty leaves it free.

### Feature `solid_mechanics_3d.boundary_load` - Boundary load

Traction (t_x, t_y, t_z) in model axes (not the face normal) on outer faces as consistent nodal forces [N]; on tetrahedra also on domain objects (their interface faces: between two solid elements a sheet force on both; a tensor mesh refuses objects). Several add; on a held component it only enters the reaction.

- Category boundary_condition; selection boundary entities, at least 1, outer faces and object perimeters; mesh kinds tensor, tetrahedra; result none

Params:
- `t_x` [Pa] (default 0) - Traction x
  Along +x (a pressure p pushing into x_hi: t_x = -p).
- `t_y` [Pa] (default 0) - Traction y
  Along +y (a pressure p on y_hi: t_y = -p).
- `t_z` [Pa] (default -1e+06) - Traction z
  Along +z (a pressure p on z_hi: t_z = -p). Typical 1e5-1e8.

### Feature `solid_mechanics_3d.body_force` - Body force

Body force density on the selected cells as consistent nodal forces (tetrahedra: f per element at its centroid); void cells drop it. Several add; the coupled slots body_force_x / _y / _z are separate.

- Category domain_condition; selection domain entities, at least 1; mesh kinds tensor, tetrahedra; result none

Params:
- `f_x` [N/m^3] (default 0; may use x, y) - Body force x
  Along +x (may use z too).
- `f_y` [N/m^3] (default 0; may use x, y) - Body force y
  Along +y (may use z too).
- `f_z` [N/m^3] (default -21600; may use x, y) - Body force z
  Along +z (may use z too); gravity along -z is -rho g (silica -2.16e4).

### Feature `solid_mechanics_3d.temperature_change` - Temperature change

Help: shared `solid_mechanics.temperature_change`

- Category domain_condition; selection domain entities, at least 1; mesh kinds tensor, tetrahedra; result none

Params:
- `delta_T` [K] (default 10; may use x, y) - Temperature change
  Temperature above the stress-free state (several add); thermal strain alpha delta_T; may use z too.

### Feature `solid_mechanics_3d.solid_probe` - Solid probe

Samples one output field at the point per re-solve, stationary iteration or end-of-run flush (t = 0 in a stationary study): the containing cell on a tensor mesh (z: its z param, mid-height when unset), the nodal field on tetrahedra (strain / stress node-averaged).

- Category probe; selection point entities, object kinds point, exactly 1; mesh kinds tensor, tetrahedra; result kind `timeseries`

Params:
- `component` (default "u_abs"; u_x | u_y | u_z | u_abs | strain_xx | strain_yy | strain_zz | strain_xy | strain_xz | strain_yz | elastic_strain_xx | elastic_strain_yy | elastic_strain_zz | stress_xx | stress_yy | stress_zz | stress_xy | stress_xz | stress_yz | von_mises | electric_potential | electric_field_x | electric_field_y | electric_field_z | electric_displacement_x | electric_displacement_y | electric_displacement_z | strain_energy_density | kinetic_energy_density) - Quantity
  Sampled field (its unit); electric_* (0 without piezoelectric) and *_energy_density on tetrahedra only.

### Feature `solid_mechanics_3d.frequency_probe` - Frequency probe

frequency_response study only: the complex displacement (exp(+j omega t), phase 0 = the drive) at the point per solved frequency (triangles: a node is put there; 0 off the solid). Result 'xy' versus frequency [Hz]: u_x_re / _im / _abs / _phase, u_y_re / _im / _abs / _phase, u_z_re / _im / _abs / _phase (m; phase rad in (-pi, pi]); derived value two_wave_fit pairs a _re series with its _im. Restarts with each frequency_response run.

- Category probe; selection point entities, object kinds point, exactly 1; mesh kinds tetrahedra; result kind `xy`

Params: none

### Feature `solid_mechanics_3d.resonance_table` - Resonance table

Vibration modes of the last eigenfrequency solve, the lowest first on a tensor mesh (target_frequency reads 0), nearest target_frequency first on tetrahedra (search targets / band: in frequency order). Result 'table', one row per mode: resonance_number, frequency, angular_frequency (1-based rank, Hz, rad/s); damped modes (elastic PML, loss factor, resistive_load electrode) append frequency_imag, q_factor, energy_decay_rate (Hz, > 0 decays; Re omega / (2 Im omega); 1/s, 2 Im omega = kappa_e of a resistive load). Extras target_frequency (Hz; NaN for several targets or a band), targets, band, expected_count, selected_resonance, axial_wavenumber (rad/m; None = plane strain). Frequency versus a parameter: a derived value with source '<physics>.<this feature>', expression frequency, operation at, at = 0 (the first mode). With squeeze_film_damping features the table appends gas_damping, gas_stiffness, gamma_gas, q_gas: the totals over the enabled films (c, k and gamma add; defined in squeeze_film_damping).

- Category monitor; selection none (a selection is ignored with a warning); mesh kinds tensor, tetrahedra; result kind `table`

Params: none

### Feature `solid_mechanics_3d.mode_shapes` - Mode shapes

Complex surface displacement of every resonance of the last eigenfrequency (or optomechanics) solve; one result per sweep value (Results.sweep_result). Surface = faces with exactly one solid window element (stiffness: youngs_modulus or c11). Quadratic: nodes = vertices and edge midpoints of each face, split into 4 triangles; linear: vertices and faces as they are; triangles counter-clockwise seen from outside. Result 'mode_shapes': nodes (n, 3) m, triangles (m, 3), resonance_number / frequency [Hz] / q_factor (NaN undamped) in resonance_table order, displacement_re / _im (r, n, 3) float32 m (peak node |u| = 1 m, its largest component real positive; real modes _im = 0), bloch_k (3,) rad/m (0 off periodic axes), periodic (3,) 0 / 1, period (3,) m, phase_convention (the neighbour cell at x + L = this times exp(-j k L), time exp(+j omega t)), density (n,) kg/m^3 (node mean). fields stress adds stress_re / _im (r, n, 6) float32 Pa and, piezoelectric, potential_re / _im (r, n) V; stress_strain also strain_re / _im (r, n, 6): components xx, yy, zz, xy, xz, yz (tensor shear), the node averages the selected mode shows (no thermal part, no initial stress), in the displacement normalisation and phase. Size ~ r x n x 24 bytes for the displacement, 48 more per tensor. A GUI Compute adds one (default fields) for View in browser; headless runs (api.run, CLI) keep only the model's features.

- Category monitor; selection none (a selection is ignored with a warning); mesh kinds tetrahedra; result kind `mode_shapes`

Params:
- `fields` (default "stress"; displacement | stress | stress_strain) - Kept fields
  Kept besides the displacement: stress adds the complex modal stress (the web page colours by components, von Mises, principal stresses, pressure); stress_strain also the strain (components, volumetric strain, strain energy density); displacement is smallest.

### Feature `solid_mechanics_3d.squeeze_film_damping` - Squeeze-film damping

Gas damping of a thin film (gap H) between one flat face of the solid and a fixed parallel wall, per resonance after the modal solve (it does not change the modes). Selection: one outer face, or domain objects with gap_side (curved or stepped: build error). On the footprint (P2 triangles of the tetrahedron faces) the linearised compressible Reynolds equation div(H^3 / (12 mu_eff) grad p) - j omega (H / p_a) p = j omega w is solved per mode, w = -u . n_out the gap opening, p = 0 on vented rim edges, no flux on sealed ones. Result 'table', one row per mode: resonance_number, frequency [Hz], effective_mass [kg], gas columns for the mode shape (peak |u| = 1 m): gas_damping c = -Re F [kg/s] and gas_stiffness k = omega Im F [N/m] of the modal gas force F = int p conj(w) dA per unit modal velocity (both scale with the normalisation squared), gamma_gas = c / m_eff [1/s] (energy decay rate = linewidth in rad/s), q_gas = omega m_eff / c, m_eff = int rho |u|^2 dV (gamma_gas, q_gas normalisation free); extras area [m^2], gap [m], surface_elements, vent_edges. The Resonance table appends the gas columns summed over the enabled films (select each face once). Complex modes (PML, loss, resistive loads): Re omega and m_eff = Re(u^H M u); Bloch cells refuse it. Not evaluated in frequency_response.

- Category monitor; selection boundary entities, at least 1, outer faces and object perimeters; mesh kinds tetrahedra; result kind `table`

Params:
- `gap` [m] (default 2e-06; > 0) - Gap height
  Uniform gas gap H to the fixed facing wall, << the footprint (MEMS 0.5-10 um); damping ~ 1 / H^3.
- `viscosity` [Pa s] (default 1.81e-05; > 0) - Gas viscosity
  Dynamic viscosity mu (air at 20 C: 1.81e-5), pressure-independent; slip reduces it to mu_eff.
- `ambient_pressure` [Pa] (default 101325; >= 0) - Ambient pressure. Help: shared `membrane.squeeze_film_damping.ambient_pressure`
- `slip` (default "veijola"; none | veijola) - Gas slip
  veijola: mu_eff = mu / (1 + 9.638 Kn^1.159), Kn = mean_free_path / gap (Veijola 1995, Kn <= 880, ~5 %); none: mu_eff = mu (continuum, Kn << 0.01).
- `mean_free_path` [m] (default 6.8e-08; >= 0; visible when slip in (veijola)) - Mean free path
  At the ambient pressure, ~1 / p_a (air: 68e-9 at 101325 Pa, 6.8e-6 at 1013 Pa).
- `gap_side` (default "auto"; auto | x_lo | x_hi | y_lo | y_hi | z_lo | z_hi) - Gap side
  Side of the solid the gap is on: auto = the selected outer face (gap outside the window); domain objects: the outward normal (z_lo: bottom of a plate over a substrate, z_hi: under a lid); their interface faces flat on that plane, beside a solid element, facing that side, on the outermost such plane form the footprint.
- `vents` (default "all"; all | window_sealed | x_sealed | y_sealed | z_sealed | none) - Vented rim
  Rim edges venting to the ambient (p = 0; the others sealed, no flux): all; window_sealed = those on the domain boundary planes sealed (mirror planes of a half / quarter model); x_sealed / y_sealed / z_sealed = only those on that axis' boundary planes sealed (e.g. a strip vented on two sides); none = a closed film (needs ambient_pressure > 0: a gas spring).

### Feature `solid_mechanics_3d.thermoelastic_damping` - Thermoelastic damping

Thermoelastic damping (TED) of every mode of the last eigenfrequency (or optomechanics) solve, tetrahedra only (a tensor mesh refuses it: matrix-free modes); perturbative and one-way (the modes stay isothermal). Per mode (omega = Re omega, exp(+j omega t)) the strain-rate heat source q = -j omega T0 (beta : eps), beta = C : alpha the thermal stress per kelvin, drives j omega rho cp theta - div(k grad theta) = q on the solid, adiabatic on its whole boundary (theta on its own nodes: bilinear on a tensor mesh, P1 / P2 on element meshes); d = -int beta : eps* theta dV gives 1 / Q_TED = Im d / (u^H K u) (> 0) and ted_frequency_shift = Re d / (2 u^H K u) (> 0: toward the adiabatic stiffness). Thin-beam flexure reproduces Zener (Delta = E alpha^2 T0 / (rho cp), tau = h^2 rho cp / (pi^2 k)) and Lifshitz-Roukes within 2 %. Materials: k (k_xx, k_yy, k_zz), rho, cp (library silicon, silica, silicon_nitride have them), alpha, the stiffness; every solid cell needs rho > 0 and cp > 0. Result 'table', one row per mode: resonance_number, frequency, q_ted, ted_frequency_shift, q_other, q_total (Hz; Q inf without loss): q_other = the other losses (a damped pencil's Q: elastic PML and, on element meshes, mechanical_loss_factor; tensor mesh: the loss factor perturbatively, 1 / Q = u^H (eta K) u / u^H K u; tetrahedra: also q_gas), 1 / q_total = 1 / q_ted + 1 / q_other. Extras T0, selected_resonance. Complex modes use Re omega and Re(u^H M u). One complex host SuperLU per mode at the first read. Not modelled: piezoelectric, guided modes, azimuthal_order >= 1, Bloch cells; PML elements take no part. Q_TED versus a parameter: derived value source '<physics>.<this feature>', expression q_ted, operation at, at = 0.

- Category monitor; selection none (a selection is ignored with a warning); mesh kinds tetrahedra; result kind `table`

Params:
- `T0` [K] (default 293.15; > 0) - Reference temperature
  Absolute temperature of the vibrating solid (the heat type's T0 default); 1 / Q_TED scales with it (Delta = E alpha^2 T0 / (rho cp)).

### Feature `solid_mechanics_3d.electrode` - Electrode

Electrode on outer faces and domain objects (their interface and outer boundary faces): every node, edges and corners included. Piezoelectric only (else ignored, validation warning): one equipotential, connection voltage, floating or resistive_load. Two electrodes must not share a node (adjacent faces share edge nodes: build error; select both in one feature). Its nodes keep their supports and loads (a thin film without stiffness). Result 'table' of the latest static solve or shown mode (per its 1 m peak displacement), row [feature, V, Q] (V, C), extras V, Q: the potential and the net free charge (Q = -sum of the potential rows of A x over its nodes, the discrete Gauss law; a driven electrode against ground: Q / V = its capacitance, fringing included; a mode: the short-circuit charge of a voltage electrode, the open-circuit voltage of a floating one).

- Category boundary_condition; selection boundary entities, at least 1, outer faces and object perimeters; mesh kinds tetrahedra; result kind `table`

Params:

- `voltage` [V] (default 0) - Voltage
  Potential of a voltage electrode in a static solve; ignored by floating electrodes and the eigenfrequency study (0 there).
- `charge` [C] (default 0) - Charge
  Net free charge on a floating electrode in a static solve (its voltage follows); ignored otherwise (eigenfrequency: 0).
- `load_resistance` [Ohm] (default 50; >= 0; visible when connection in (resistive_load)) - Load resistance
  Resistance of a resistive_load electrode to ground, > 0 (typical: 50 Ohm, a matched line).

## Coupling type `acoustics_em_acousto_optic` - Acousto-optic effect (elastic waves -> electromagnetic waves)

Each transfer writes, per permittivity component ii of the EM physics (E_z: zz via eps_r_update; H_z: xx and yy), dn_ii = -1/2 n0_ii^3 (photoelastic_p11 e_ii + photoelastic_p12 (e_jj + e_kk)) of the acoustic strain (elastic_strain_xx / _yy: the in-plane stiffness inverted at the cell centres, fluids half the volumetric strain each, e_zz = 0; with piezo arrays the accumulated total strain; solid_em_strain_optic's math without deformation). A crystal (photoelastic_p16 .. _p66 from a {"model": "crystal"} entry) gets the in-plane row of its model-axis tensor, dn_ii = -1/2 n0_ii^3 (p_i1 e_xx + p_i2 e_yy + p_i6 g), g = 2 e_xy at the cell centre (mean of its 4 corners), unset entries isotropic. em_fdfd_hz also gets Delta eps_xy = -n0_xx^2 n0_yy^2 (p_61 e_xx + p_62 e_yy + p_66 g) in eps_xy_update (a sum contributor), isotropic p_66 = (p11 - p12) / 2 (photoelastic_p44 is not read: library silicon gets -0.0555 instead of p44 = -0.051; set photoelastic_p66 = p44 for the cubic shear with cube axes along x, y). The anti-plane change is dropped (validation warns for crystals). An E13 index contributor: the slot gets eps = (n0 + the sum of dn of every index coupling into it)^2, n0 the shared reference index recorded before the first transfer, all with one every (validation error otherwise); no overwriting field_transfer or state-dependent permittivity property on the slot. time_dependent study: the EM physics re-solves on the frozen strain every k acoustic steps (its every, inherited by this coupling: transfer just before each re-solve), a stroboscopic sequence; an optical FDTD in the same run is refused. Choose k so k dt samples the acoustic period finely; each re-solve is a sparse direct solve.

- Source physics type elastic_waves; target physics type em_fdfd_ez or em_fdfd_hz; across meshes: not allowed (one mesh)

Params (CouplingSpec.params): none

## Coupling type `currents_heat_joule` - Joule heating (electric currents -> heat)

Resistive heating: q_joule [W/m^3] of the last electric_currents solve (J.E per cell: each face's dissipation split between its two cells by their half-cell resistances, outer Dirichlet faces to their cell) becomes the heat source Q (heat ignores the PML ring). Additive heat source (volumetric_power): every em_heat_joule / currents_heat_joule / fluid_heat_convection / magnetic_heat_induction coupling into one heat physics sums, all with the same every (validation error otherwise); no field_transfer into volumetric_power beside them. Its window integral equals the sum of V * current over the voltage / terminal features exactly (planar: per m of depth). Fixed point currents -> Q -> T -> sigma_dc(T): give the material a sigma_dc expression of heat_T (no coupling needed; the currents re-solve after each heat step that changes it). Time-dependent study: leave every null or equal to the heat every and the currents every at 1. Transient heat: each step uses the q_joule at its start temperature; the first step has no Joule source.

- Source physics type electric_currents; target physics type heat; across meshes: its result moves to the target mesh (conservative)

Params (CouplingSpec.params): none

## Coupling type `electrostatics_acoustics_piezo` - Piezoelectric coupling (electrostatics <-> elastic waves)

Planar, sagittal plane: each transfer hands the electrostatics E_x / E_y (cell centres) to the electric_field_x / _y slots of elastic_waves, which adds T = -e^T (E - E_last) to its stresses at once (piezo_e* arrays in reduced Voigt form, usually from a crystal entry; the first transfer only records the field: the initial state is its equilibrium). Transfers right after the physics step; a time-varying field comes from voltage / terminal waveforms (superposed static solves at each step's end time), so the stress at t_n uses E(t_n). bound_charge: rho_b = -div(e S) of the accumulated strain S in face form (the mean P = e S of the two cells per face; at a Dirichlet / Robin outer face of the electrostatics the cell P, its surface charge landing on the electrode; insulating outer faces none), so D = eps E + e S is source-free. Not modelled: pyroelectric and thermal-strain charge, the anti-plane coupling of cuts whose model plane is no crystal mirror plane (validation warns).

- Source physics type electrostatics; target physics type elastic_waves; across meshes: not allowed (one mesh)

Params (CouplingSpec.params):
- `back_action` (default "bound_charge"; bound_charge | none) - Back-action on the field
  bound_charge (two-way): after every acoustic step the strain's bound charge goes into the electrostatics slot 'charge_density', the electrostatics re-solves (warm-started CG; driven terminals: only the DC part) and its E returns in the same transfer, so the waves are stiffened without lag (acoustic dt from c^D = c^E + e^T eps^-1 e); one CG solve per acoustic step, needs the coupling every equal to the acoustics' every and writes charge_density alone. none (one-way): wave speeds about K^2 / 2 low (~2 % for a YZ lithium niobate SAW).

## Coupling type `electrostatics_em_pockels` - Pockels effect (electrostatics -> electromagnetic waves)

Each transfer writes, per permittivity component ii of the EM type (E_z: zz via eps_r_update; H_z: xx and yy via eps_xx_update / eps_yy_update; em_modes: all three), dn_ii = -1/2 n0_ii^3 r_ii E_k (E = -grad V; r_xx / r_yy / r_zz the material Pockels coefficients of the electrostatics vocabulary, isotropic r sets all three, 0 where unset; dispersive cells: n0 from eps_inf, the poles never change: validation warning). An E13 index contributor: the slot gets eps = (n0 + the sum of dn of every index coupling into it)^2, n0 the shared reference index recorded before the first transfer, all with one every (validation error otherwise); no overwriting field_transfer or state-dependent permittivity property on the slot. This is the Pockels diagonal for one applied direction: x-cut lithium niobate in top view (crystal z along model x, electrodes either side of a waveguide along y, field_component x) has r_xx = r33 = 30.8e-12 (E_x of the H_z types sees n_e) and r_yy = r_zz = r13 = 8.6e-12 (clamped r^S, library lithium_niobate_x_cut); a positive E_k with r > 0 lowers n. A crystal (a {"model": "crystal"} entry: clamped r^S in model axes, pockels_r11 .. _r62) adds -1/2 n0_ii^3 (r_i1 E_x + r_i2 E_y) from both components, so a rotated cut's opposite-sign r22 terms are included; clamped because a piezoelectric elastic_waves run adds its strain index change via acoustics_em_acousto_optic (a slow drive of a free crystal sees the larger r^T). em_fdfd_hz also gets Delta eps_xy = -n0_xx^2 n0_yy^2 (r_61 E_x + r_62 E_y) in eps_xy_update (r51 of YZ lithium niobate); other in-plane types drop it, every type drops the anti-plane change (validation warns for crystals). The field is that of the last electrostatics solve: stationary per fixed-point iteration (one behind, as thermo-optic); frequency_domain / mode_analysis once after the background solve. eps_dc matters: a high-eps_dc core (lithium niobate eps_c 28) between low-eps_dc cladding (silica 3.9) takes only a small share of the voltage.

- Source physics type electrostatics; target physics type em_eme or em_eme_3d or em_fdfd_3d or em_fdfd_bor or em_fdfd_conical or em_fdfd_ez or em_fdfd_hz or em_fdfd_nonlinear or em_fdfd_sphere or em_fdtd_3d or em_fdtd_bor or em_fdtd_ez or em_fdtd_hz or em_modes; across meshes: not allowed (one mesh)

Params (CouplingSpec.params):
- `field_component` (default "x"; x | y) - Applied field direction
  E_k (E_x or E_y of the source) driving every dn_ii = -1/2 n0_ii^3 r_ii E_k; the other component is ignored, so align the material's r_ii with it (x-cut lithium niobate in top view: x, its optic axis). Crystal tensor entries pockels_r11 .. _r62 always use both components.

## Coupling type `em_acoustics_photoacoustic` - Photoacoustic heating (electromagnetic waves -> elastic waves)

q_abs [W/m^3] of the last EM solve (time-averaged 1/2 omega eps0 (-Im eps) |E|^2, as em_heat_joule) is added to the heating_power slot of elastic_waves, which multiplies it by its heating_envelope (gaussian: a pulse of energy density q sqrt(pi) heating_pulse_width; instantaneous: steady heating for the whole run, validation warns) and adds -gruneisen q to d(sxx)/dt and d(syy)/dt. Additive: several (e.g. one per wavelength) sum; no field_transfer into heating_power beside them. Transferred after each EM re-solve (normally only the first, unless its permittivity changes).

- Source physics type em_fdfd_ez or em_fdfd_hz; target physics type elastic_waves; across meshes: its result moves to the target mesh (conservative)

Params (CouplingSpec.params): none

## Coupling type `em_heat_joule` - Joule heating (electromagnetic waves -> heat)

The absorbed power density J.E [W/m^3] (sigma_e conduction plus Drude / Lorentz currents) of the EM physics (take_absorbed_power: the mean over the EM steps since the last transfer; FDFD: the time average of its last solve) becomes the heat source Q, e.g. E_z plus H_z physics for unpolarised light. Additive heat source (volumetric_power): every em_heat_joule / currents_heat_joule / fluid_heat_convection / magnetic_heat_induction coupling into one heat physics sums, all with the same every (validation error otherwise); no field_transfer into volumetric_power beside them. FDFD: a stationary study for one wavelength, a frequency_domain study for a list (each wavelength a stationary fixed point of every physics, continued from the previous one; no em_modes or time-domain physics beside it). em_fdtd_hz puts each E_x / E_y face loss into its lossy neighbour cells (sigma_e by conductivity, poles to the dispersive cells); em_fdfd_hz uses each cell's loss with |E_x|^2, |E_y|^2 averaged over its two faces. Time-stepped EM: leave every null or equal to the heat every (validation warns otherwise); the final flush sends the last partial window merged with the previous full one (a study shorter than every * dt_EM delivers its power only there). A cw window W = every * dt_EM averages cos^2 exactly only over whole half optical periods, else up to T_opt / (2 pi W) off, varying per cell (validation warns above 1 % naming the nearest whole-half-period every). Transient heat lags one window: its step over [kW, (k+1)W] uses the power of [(k-1)W, kW] (no source in the first, the last window never stepped). Pulsed EM sources feeding steady heat, transient heat or such a short study: validation warning. A second reader of the absorbed power of the same time-stepped EM physics (em_heat_joule, em_semiconductor_generation): validation error (each transfer resets the window).

- Source physics type em_eme or em_eme_3d or em_fdfd_bor or em_fdfd_conical or em_fdfd_ez or em_fdfd_hz or em_fdfd_nonlinear or em_fdfd_sphere or em_fdtd_3d or em_fdtd_ez or em_fdtd_hz; target physics type heat; across meshes: its result moves to the target mesh (conservative)

Params (CouplingSpec.params): none

## Coupling type `em_semiconductor_generation` - Photogeneration (electromagnetic waves -> semiconductor)

G = quantum_efficiency * q_abs / (hbar omega) [1/(m^3 s)], q_abs the absorbed power density via take_absorbed_power (em_fdfd: the time average of the last solve; em_fdtd: the mean since the last transfer, which a second reader of the same source would reset: validation error). Overwrites the drift_diffusion slot 'generation' (one writer; generation features add separately), only on free semiconductor cells (n_intrinsic > 0, not held by an ohmic contact). Every absorbing cell counts: give the semiconductor its band-to-band loss (sigma_e / Im eps) at the wavelength (library silicon is lossless). Use a stationary study (with a plasma-dispersion coupling back it iterates to the fixed point); frequency_domain is a validation error.

- Source physics type em_eme or em_eme_3d or em_fdfd_bor or em_fdfd_conical or em_fdfd_ez or em_fdfd_hz or em_fdfd_nonlinear or em_fdfd_sphere or em_fdtd_3d or em_fdtd_ez or em_fdtd_hz; target physics type drift_diffusion; across meshes: its result moves to the target mesh (conservative)

Params (CouplingSpec.params):
- `photon_wavelength` [m] (> 0; nullable) - Photon wavelength
  Vacuum wavelength of the absorbed light: hbar omega = 2 pi hbar c / wavelength; null = the em_fdfd solve wavelength. Required for an em_fdtd source (validation error).
- `quantum_efficiency` [1] (default 1; [0, 1]) - Quantum efficiency
  Electron-hole pairs per absorbed photon; 1 for band-to-band absorption. Free-carrier or metal absorption creates no pairs: keep such cells non-semiconductor (ignored) or lower it.

## Coupling type `em_solid_optical_force` - Optical force (electromagnetic waves -> solid mechanics)

Optical (Maxwell-stress) force density f = -(eps0 / 4) |E_z|^2 grad eps_r, time-averaged (peak phasor E_z of the last em_fdfd_ez solve; non-magnetic; electrostriction, the absorption force and the sigma_e / pole part of eps ignored), as a face jump: each cell face carries -(eps0 / 4) |E_z|^2 (eps_r jump) x its length, split between its solid cells (c11 > 0, else youngs_modulus > 0) per area, so a dielectric boundary's force lands in full in the solid beside it (|E_z|^2 is continuous there). Adds into body_force_x / _y (sums with magnetic_solid_lorentz_force, one every; no field_transfer into those slots). em_fdfd_ez only (em_fdfd_hz's in-plane E has a discontinuous normal part). Use a stationary study (frequency_domain does not feed harmonic solutions back).

- Source physics type em_fdfd_ez; target physics type solid_mechanics; across meshes: its result moves to the target mesh (conservative)

Params (CouplingSpec.params): none

## Coupling type `field_transfer` - Field transfer

Generic transfer: the expression is written into target_slot of the target physics, replacing it (heat volumetric_power replaces Q; the EM permittivity slots replace their whole array, PML included; EM ez_source / hz_source add the buffer to E_z / H_z every EM step until the next transfer: a raw V/m or A/m increment per step, so its effect scales with 1/dt). Slot units: the target physics type's source slots.

- Source physics type any; target physics type any; across meshes: the source field is interpolated onto the target mesh

Params (CouplingSpec.params):
- `source_field` (str; default "") - Source field
  State field of the source physics read at every transfer (full grid, PML ring included), e.g. T of heat. EM q_accum is an accumulated energy density, not a power: use em_heat_joule.
- `target_slot` (str; default "") - Target input
  Source slot of the target physics, overwritten at every transfer: no other coupling may write it, not even an additive one (validation error).
- `expression` (expression; default "value") - Transform expression
  Of value (the source field), x, y (3D: z; cell centres, PML cells take the nearest window centre) and parameters, e.g. 1e-3*value; no other fields, no t. Written as float32 into one persistent full-grid buffer (a constant fills it).

## Coupling type `fluid_heat_convection` - Convective heat transport (laminar flow -> heat)

q = -rho cp u . grad T [W/m^3] on the fluid cells (rho, cp of the material, u of the flow, T of heat), re-transferred whenever the flow or the temperature changed. Additive heat source (volumetric_power): every em_heat_joule / currents_heat_joule / fluid_heat_convection / magnetic_heat_induction coupling into one heat physics sums, all with the same every (validation error otherwise); no field_transfer into volumetric_power beside them. Face fluxes: interior fluid faces with the mean of the two cells' velocities and temperatures (central, oscillation-free for a cell Peclet number rho cp u dx / k < 2); faces to solid cells carry nothing; outer faces only where heat holds a temperature (the inflow temperature: set a Temperature condition on the inflow face), other outer faces are zero-gradient outlets. It vanishes for uniform T, so energy is conserved only to the accuracy of the flow. Explicit (lagged): a stationary study iterates heat and this coupling, converging only while transverse conduction damps every mode (temperature held on the walls: Picard gain ~ Pe / (2 pi), Pe = rho cp U H / k over the channel height H). With only the inflow face holding T the axial mode has gain ~ 2 Pe L / (pi H) over the length L and no study relaxation helps: march a time_dependent study instead (steady flow, transient heat, a few flow-through times). Transient heat steps with the source of the previous state (stable for u dt / dx < ~1).

- Source physics type laminar_flow; target physics type heat; across meshes: not allowed (one mesh)

Params (CouplingSpec.params): none

## Coupling type `heat_em_phase_change` - Phase change (heat -> electromagnetic waves)

Right after every heat step it hands the end-of-step temperature and the heat time to every phase_change_medium feature of the EM physics, which advances its crystallinity and rewrites eps / sigma_e on its cells. Only in a time_dependent study with transient heat (validation errors otherwise); leave every blank. It overwrites those cells' permittivity: no other coupling into the permittivity slots of the same EM physics (heat_em_thermo_optic, electrostatics_em_pockels, field_transfer) and no state-dependent permittivity material there (validation error). The absorbed power reaches heat through em_heat_joule. em_fdfd_*: re-solves after every update (stroboscopic, the GST switching time scale); em_fdtd_*: each heat window of every * dt_EM advances it (femtoseconds: only very fast test kinetics or melting act).

- Source physics type heat; target physics type em_fdfd_ez or em_fdfd_hz or em_fdtd_ez or em_fdtd_hz; across meshes: the source field is interpolated onto the target mesh

Params (CouplingSpec.params): none

## Coupling type `heat_em_thermo_optic` - Thermo-optic effect (heat -> electromagnetic waves)

Each transfer rewrites the EM permittivity from the heat temperature: dT = T - T0 (T0 of the heat physics), n0 = sqrt of the built permittivity component (dispersive: of eps_inf). An E13 index contributor: the slot gets eps = (n0 + the sum of dn of every index coupling into it)^2, n0 the shared reference index recorded before the first transfer, all with one every (validation error otherwise); no overwriting field_transfer or state-dependent permittivity property on the slot. Alone: E_z types eps_zz = (n0_zz + dndT_zz dT)^2 (1 + alpha_xx dT)(1 + alpha_yy dT) (eps_r_update); H_z types eps_xx and eps_yy likewise with n0_xx / dndT_xx and n0_yy / dndT_yy (eps_xx_update / eps_yy_update); em_modes all three, the alpha factor on eps_zz only (eps_xx = (n0_xx + dndT_xx dT)^2; transverse to the propagation the exact stretch image also scales mu_zz, which cannot be held, so the transverse expansion is only partly counted; the axial path term n_eff alpha_zz dT is post-processing). The alpha factor maps the in-plane expansion onto the fixed grid (a structure stretched by s_x s_y is a medium with eps_zz s_x s_y), so the optical path grows as the real one; H_z: only the phase index matches (the exact image scales mu_zz). Per cell it is first order, exact only for alpha uniform over the mode: cells with alpha 0 (cladding, air) miss their share, under-counting the expansion shift by the mode energy fraction outside the expanding material. An enabled solid_em_strain_optic (deformation on) into the same EM physics drops the alpha factor (the solid strain supplies the deformation). Dispersive materials: the pole susceptibility never changes, so dndT shifts eps by 2 n0 dndT dT instead of 2 n(omega) dndT dT (scale dndT by n(omega) / n0) and alpha scales only the background; validation warns for a dndT on them or an alpha with a Lorentz pole. An isotropic dndT sets dndT_xx, _yy and _zz; no off-diagonal dndT / alpha. time_dependent (every = the heat every): right after each heat step, so one heat interval's EM steps see the temperature of the previous interval's power; stationary: per fixed-point iteration; frequency_domain: once after the heat solve, before the wavelengths (a coupled wavelength scan: per iteration of each wavelength); mode_analysis: once before the mode solve.

- Source physics type heat; target physics type em_eme or em_eme_3d or em_fdfd_3d or em_fdfd_bor or em_fdfd_conical or em_fdfd_ez or em_fdfd_hz or em_fdfd_nonlinear or em_fdfd_sphere or em_fdtd_3d or em_fdtd_bor or em_fdtd_ez or em_fdtd_hz or em_modes; across meshes: the source field is interpolated onto the target mesh

Params (CouplingSpec.params): none

## Coupling type `heat_solid_thermal_strain` - Thermal expansion (heat -> solid mechanics)

Thermal strain: each transfer writes dT = T - T0 of the heat physics (T0 = the stress-free temperature; the rise in solve precision) into the temperature_rise slot of a solid_mechanics (2D heat) or solid_mechanics_3d (3D heat), which re-solves with the thermal load C alpha dT (alpha_zz: see that property). Window only (the PML ring of the slot reads 0). Stationary: after the heat solve; time_dependent: after each heat step. One writer of the slot (a second, or a field_transfer to temperature_rise, is a validation error); temperature_change features add to it. 2D optics: with solid_em_strain_optic deformation on, heat_em_thermo_optic on the same EM physics drops its (1 + alpha dT) factor (the strain supplies the deformation).

- Source physics type heat; target physics type solid_mechanics or solid_mechanics_3d; across meshes: its result moves to the target mesh (interpolate)

Params (CouplingSpec.params): none

## Coupling type `magnetic_heat_induction` - Induction heating (magnetic fields AC -> heat)

q_eddy + q_magnetic [W/m^3] of the last magnetic_fields_ac solve (period averages) become the heat source. Additive heat source (volumetric_power): every em_heat_joule / currents_heat_joule / fluid_heat_convection / magnetic_heat_induction coupling into one heat physics sums, all with the same every (validation error otherwise); no field_transfer into volumetric_power beside them. Its window integral is eddy_loss plus the integral of q_magnetic (W/m planar, W axisymmetric: use the same geometry for both physics, else a validation warning). Stranded coils carry no eddy current, and their resistive loss is not transferred. Transfers after each magnetic solve, which repeats only when a material or source changed, e.g. a sigma_dc expression of heat_T (each change may cost a host refactorisation). Stationary study: one Picard fixed point; time-dependent: heat steps with the loss of the latest solve.

- Source physics type magnetic_fields_ac; target physics type heat; across meshes: its result moves to the target mesh (conservative)

Params (CouplingSpec.params): none

## Coupling type `magnetic_solid_lorentz_force` - Lorentz force (magnetic fields -> solid mechanics)

f = J x B [N/m^3] of a planar magnetic physics: f_x = -J_z B_y, f_y = J_z B_x; magnetostatics J = J_coupled + J_applied, magnetic_fields_ac the time average Re(J_total B*) / 2 (the 2 omega part is dropped). Handed per cell to body_force_x / _y, additive (sums with em_solid_optical_force, one every; no field_transfer into those slots beside it); void solid cells (youngs_modulus 0) drop it, so a winding modelled as air carries no load. Axisymmetric magnetic physics: validation error. No magnetisation force (permeable or magnetised material, Maxwell stress at mu_dc jumps) and no magnetostriction. Transfers after each magnetic solve.

- Source physics type magnetostatics or magnetic_fields_ac; target physics type solid_mechanics; across meshes: its result moves to the target mesh (conservative)

Params (CouplingSpec.params): none

## Coupling type `semiconductor_em_plasma_dispersion` - Free-carrier plasma dispersion (semiconductor -> electromagnetic waves)

dn = -(electron_coefficient N + hole_coefficient P^hole_exponent) from the electron / hole densities of the last drift_diffusion solve (0 outside the semiconductor; edge-extended into the PML ring), the same for every permittivity component (E_z: eps_r_update; H_z: eps_xx_update / eps_yy_update; em_modes: all three). An E13 index contributor: the slot gets eps = (n0 + the sum of dn of every index coupling into it)^2, n0 the shared reference index recorded before the first transfer, all with one every (validation error otherwise); no overwriting field_transfer or state-dependent permittivity property on the slot. Densities are absolute (dn relative to carrier-free material; library silicon is undoped). Free-carrier absorption (Soref-Bennett dalpha = 8.5e-18 N + 6.0e-18 P [1/cm], N, P in 1/cm^3) is not included (no loss slot): give the material a state-dependent sigma_e = n eps0 c0 dalpha, for silicon at 1.55 um sigma_e = 7.85e-24 * semiconductor_N + 5.54e-24 * semiconductor_P [S/m] (N, P in 1/m^3; plus any background loss). Stationary study: one fixed-point iteration behind; mode_analysis / frequency_domain: once after the background solve.

- Source physics type drift_diffusion; target physics type em_eme or em_eme_3d or em_fdfd_3d or em_fdfd_bor or em_fdfd_conical or em_fdfd_ez or em_fdfd_hz or em_fdfd_nonlinear or em_fdfd_sphere or em_fdtd_3d or em_fdtd_bor or em_fdtd_ez or em_fdtd_hz or em_modes; across meshes: the source field is interpolated onto the target mesh

Params (CouplingSpec.params):
- `electron_coefficient` [m^3] (default 8.8e-28; >= 0) - Electron index coefficient
  a in dn = -(a N + b P^c), N [1/m^3]; default = Soref-Bennett silicon at 1.55 um (8.8e-22 cm^3); 6.2e-28 at 1.31 um.
- `hole_coefficient` [m^2.4] (default 1.34716e-22; >= 0) - Hole index coefficient
  b, P [1/m^3]; default 8.5e-18 * (1e-6)^0.8 = Soref-Bennett silicon at 1.55 um (8.5e-18 with P in cm^-3); 6.0e-18 * (1e-6)^0.8 = 9.51e-23 at 1.31 um.
- `hole_exponent` [1] (default 0.8; >= 0) - Hole exponent
  c; 0.8 for silicon. Changing it changes the unit of hole_coefficient.

## Coupling type `solid_em_strain_optic` - Strain-optic effect (solid mechanics -> electromagnetic waves)

Strain-optic effect: each transfer writes, per permittivity component ii of the EM type (E_z types: zz; H_z types: xx, yy; em_modes: all three), dn_ii = (n0_ii + dn_pe) sqrt(1 + w (strain_xx + strain_yy)) - n0_ii, dn_pe = -1/2 n0_ii^3 (photoelastic_p11 e_ii + photoelastic_p12 (e_jj + e_kk)) of the elastic strain e = elastic_strain_* (strain - alpha dT, e_zz = -alpha_zz dT: a measured dn/dT already contains the free thermal expansion), w = 1 with deformation (void cells: 0). Isotropic or cubic (axes along x, y, z) p11 / p12; the shear term p44 strain_xy is not modelled. An E13 index contributor: with heat_em_thermo_optic / electrostatics_em_pockels on the same physics the slot gets eps = (n0 + sum of dn)^2, all with one every. Plane strain is exact for a cross-section (em_modes); an in-plane EM target gets a validation info. Stationary: after the solid solve; frequency_domain / mode_analysis: once after the background solve. Source solid_mechanics only (solid_mechanics_3d: not modelled).

- Source physics type solid_mechanics; target physics type em_eme or em_eme_3d or em_fdfd_3d or em_fdfd_bor or em_fdfd_conical or em_fdfd_ez or em_fdfd_hz or em_fdfd_sphere or em_fdtd_3d or em_fdtd_bor or em_fdtd_ez or em_fdtd_hz or em_modes; across meshes: not allowed (one mesh)

Params (CouplingSpec.params):
- `deformation` (bool; default true) - Include deformation
  Also map the deformation onto the fixed grid: n x sqrt(1 + strain_xx + strain_yy) (total strain; the phase-index convention of heat_em_thermo_optic, which then drops its (1 + alpha dT) factor on the same EM physics). Off: the photoelastic part only. Exact for isotropic in-plane strain only: a stretch e_xx != e_yy has an anisotropic image (E_z: mu_xx, mu_yy x (1 -/+ (e_xx - e_yy)); H_z: eps_xx, eps_yy alike) no index slot holds, so the phase along a stretched axis (a strip under uniaxial tension, a ring's hoop strain) is off to first order in e_xx - e_yy.

## Coupling type `solid_membrane_tension` - Film prestress (solid mechanics -> membrane)

Plane-stress solid -> membrane on the same triangle mesh: each transfer writes N_ij = h stress_ij [N/m] (xx, yy, xy) per element into coupled_tension_xx / _yy / _xy (overwriting), which the membrane adds to its material tension (leave that unset when the solid gives the whole prestress; validation info otherwise). stress_ij = the total static solid stress (initial_stress + C (strain - thermal strain)) at the element centroid (the element mean on straight P1 / P2), so the tension integral is exact; void elements (no youngs_modulus) give 0: with areal_density 0 they are holes (free edges), with areal_density > 0 mass without stiffness. The solid must be planar plane_stress on the membrane's mesh (validation errors). eigenfrequency / frequency_response: set StudySpec.solved_physics to the membrane only, so the solid runs first as a stationary background physics and the coupling transfers once; otherwise the coupling is a validation error. A membrane PML ring gets no tension (warning). Linearised about the relaxed state: no stress stiffening of the solid, no bending.

- Source physics type solid_mechanics; target physics type membrane; across meshes: not allowed (one mesh)

Params (CouplingSpec.params):
- `thickness` [m] (> 0; nullable) - Film thickness
  h in N_ij = h sigma_ij. Empty: the thickness setting of the solid (validation error when that is empty too); a value overrides it (warning when both are set and differ).

## Study type `eigenfrequency` - Eigenfrequency

Source-free resonances of every eigen-capable physics (em_fdfd_ez, em_fdfd_hz, em_fdfd_bor, em_fdfd_conical, em_fdfd_sphere, em_fdfd_3d, solid_mechanics, solid_mechanics_3d or membrane; StudySpec.solved_physics restricts them, the others then run as stationary background physics). Background physics iterate to a stationary fixed point, then their couplings into the eigen-solved physics apply once; couplings or material properties reading an eigen-solved physics: validation error. Results: complex omega, Im > 0 decaying (exp(+j omega t)), Q = Re(omega) / (2 Im(omega)) (radiation into the PML plus material loss), the resonance_table feature, one snapshot per resonance k (several physics: names and values joined; mirror faces add the parity), nearest the target first; afterwards each physics shows resonance 1; ticks = the resonance snapshots. Sources and monitors play no part (their results stay empty). Q or the wavelength versus a parameter: a sweep with a derived value of resonance_table. em_fdfd_ez / _hz: near omega_t = 2 pi C0 / lambda_t of the wavelength setting, L u = -(omega / C0)^2 M u (M = eps cells for E_z, mu cells for H_z) by host shift-invert Arnoldi (scipy eigs on SuperLU, the eigen role arpack_shift_invert whatever the linear back end: ~1e6 unknowns at most; the shift sits 1e-4 above the target). Accuracy: dispersion (sigma_e, poles) and the PML stretch are frozen at omega_t, so a resonance far from the target errs to first order in |omega / omega_t - 1| (exact only without dispersion and PML): set the wavelength near the resonance and re-run (one or two steps converge). Each field is scaled to 1 (V/m E_z, A/m H_z) real at its peak, in-plane fields from the curl at omega_t. em_fdfd_bor: at its azimuthal order m, or n_resonances per order of azimuthal_orders from one assembly (labels "resonance k: m = <m>, lambda = ..."), on the full-vector (r, z) curl-curl operator (M = eps ring volumes). em_fdfd_conical: at its k_z on the three-component operator; at k_z = beta the resonances are the guided modes of propagation constant beta. em_fdfd_3d: the 3D Yee curl-curl operator (M = face eps), snapshots its z cut planes, host factor ~ n^(4/3) (size rule 1e6 / 4e6 E unknowns). These three drop static gradient solutions (|k^2| < 1e-6 k_t^2) and scale each resonance to 1 V/m real at its largest component. solid_mechanics (plane strain): undamped K u = omega^2 M u (consistent mass) nearest target_frequency (0 = the lowest) by host shift-invert Lanczos, exact for the discretisation, Q infinite; with axial_wavenumber k_z the guided (2.5D) modes u ~ exp(i (k_z z - omega t)); labels "resonance k: f = <Hz> Hz", shapes scaled to a peak |u| of 1 m; loads and thermal strain play no part unless stress_stiffening (triangles, tetrahedra: the geometric stiffness K_sigma of the static state joins K; a free body, Bloch cell or elastic PML takes initial_stress alone). Triangles / tetrahedra: a mechanical_loss_factor eta makes K_el (1 + j eta) complex (K_sigma stays real). solid_mechanics_3d: tensor mesh the n_resonances lowest only (matrix-free shift-invert Lanczos at 0 on PCG solves of its double 'linear' solver, accuracy by the CG tolerance); tetrahedra nearest target_frequency (> 0 also for a free body, its 0 Hz modes dropped). membrane: -div(T (1 + j eta) grad w) = rho_s omega^2 w nearest target_frequency (complex with loss_factor / PML), labels "resonance k: f = <Hz> Hz[, Q = ...]", scaled to 1 m real at the peak; clamps held at 0, loads ignored. em_fdfd_sphere (1D spherical): shift-invert per multipole term (each listed order, er before hr) on its radial operator with the outgoing-wave term frozen at the target, then every resonance refined with the exact outgoing condition at its own complex omega (no PML; materials at the target), labels "resonance k: l = <l> <family>, lambda = ...", fields scaled to a peak sphere-RMS |E| of 1 V/m.

- Needs a physics that steps in time: no; background study stationary; StudySpec.adaptation allowed

Params (StudySpec.settings):
- `n_resonances` (int; default 6; [1, 100]) - Number of resonances
  Resonances kept per eigen-solved physics (fewer may come back, with a warning; 1-10 typical; targets: per target; band: per shift of the march, more = fewer, larger shifts). EM: the 2 n + 10 eigenvalues k^2 nearest k_t^2 are found, those with over half their |field|^2 in PML cells (and static ones) dropped, the rest ranked by |omega - omega_t|: with PML ask for a few more. solid_mechanics, solid_mechanics_3d on tetrahedra and membrane: the n + 4 eigenvalues omega^2 nearest (2 pi target_frequency)^2 (2 n + 4 complex ones with a loss factor or PML; a free solid adds its rigid motions, dropped); solid_mechanics_3d on a tensor mesh: the n + 4 lowest.
- `search` (default "nearest"; nearest | targets | band) - Search
  'nearest': n_resonances nearest each solved physics' own target (wavelength or target_frequency setting). 'targets': the union of the n_resonances nearest each of target_frequencies, from one build (one shift-invert factorisation per target; duplicates merged). 'band': every resonance with frequency_min <= Re f <= frequency_max (at most max_resonances, the lowest): shifts march upward; a real symmetric pencil (an undamped solid without Bloch phase, a lossless membrane without PML) is counted per interval by Sylvester inertia (the summary gives the count, a short interval gets a repair shift, a mismatch warns); damped, PML, loaded or complex Bloch pencils march with half-overlapping shifts and no count (warning: modes may be missing). targets and band list in frequency order and leave the resonance_table's target_frequency NaN (it carries targets / band / expected_count). They serve solid_mechanics and solid_mechanics_3d on tetrahedra (piezoelectric: targets only) and membrane (PML strength at pml_frequency, else the mean target / the band centre); the other types take nearest only.
- `target_frequencies` [Hz] (float_list; >= 0; nullable; visible when search in (targets)) - Target frequencies
  0 = the lowest modes of a supported solid; a damped, PML or loaded pencil needs > 0. Overrides the target_frequency setting of every solved physics.
- `frequency_min` [Hz] (default 0; >= 0; visible when search in (band)) - Band start
  Resonances with Re f >= it are kept; a free body's 0 Hz rigid-body modes are dropped.
- `frequency_max` [Hz] (default 1e+06; > 0; visible when search in (band)) - Band end
  Must exceed frequency_min.
- `max_resonances` (int; default 200; >= 1; visible when search in (band)) - Most resonances in the band
  The march stops once reached (warning). Bounds the run time and the stored mode shapes (one host vector each).
- `max_iterations` (int; default 50; >= 1) - Maximum coupling iterations. Help: shared `eigenfrequency.max_iterations`
- `tolerance` [1] (default 0.0001; > 0) - Relative tolerance. Help: shared `eigenfrequency.tolerance`
- `relaxation` [1] (default 1; > 0) - Coupling relaxation. Help: shared `eigenfrequency.relaxation`
- `anderson_depth` (int; default 0; >= 0) - Coupling acceleration depth. Help: shared `eigenfrequency.anderson_depth`
- `warm_start` (bool; default false) - Sweep warm start. Help: shared `eigenfrequency.warm_start`
- `live_update_hz` [Hz] (default 5; >= 0) - Live update rate
  Maximum rate of the GUI live field frames; 0 disables them. Never changes results (headless api.run sets 0).
- `parity_sectors` (bool; default false) - Parity sectors. Help: shared `eigenfrequency.parity_sectors`
